izzyondroid:com.starry.myne.name: Myne: Download & Read eBooks
izzyondroid:com.starry.myne.summary: Android application to download & read ebooks from the Project GutenBerg.
izzyondroid:com.starry.myne.description:
Myne is a FOSS Android application for downloading and reading ebooks from Project Gutenberg. It uses the GutenDex API to fetch metadata for ebooks in the backend. Additionally, it functions as an EPUB reader, allowing you to easily import and immerse yourself in your favorite EPUB books!
 Highlights:
 Clean & beautiful UI based on Google's material design three guidelines.
 Browse and download over 70k free ebooks available in multiple languages and updated daily.
 Comes with inbuilt ebook reader while also having an option to use third-party ebook readers
 Compatible with Android 7.0 and above (API 24+)
 Supports Material You theming in devices running on Android 12+
 Comes in both light and dark mode.
 MAD: UI and logic written with pure Kotlin. Single activity, no fragments, only composable destinations.
 PS: The name of the app is inspired from the main character of an anime called Ascendance of a Bookworm. 
 Note: The app also uses the Google Books API to fetch some extra data like book summary and pages count etc, as the GutenBerg project don't include those values in their metadata. It tries it's best to map the data received from Google books with Gutenberg's metadata but the mapping is not 100% accurate and not all books available on GutenBerg is also available on Google books or is available but with different title, so you may find some books without summary or page count etc.

izzyondroid:eu.darken.sdmse.name: SD Maid 2/SE - System Cleaner
izzyondroid:eu.darken.sdmse.summary: A trusted assistant for your Android, to keep it clean and tidy.
izzyondroid:eu.darken.sdmse.description:
SD Maid 2/SE is your Android’s trusted assistant, to keep it clean and tidy.
 Nobody is perfect and neither is Android.
 Apps you have already removed leave something behind.
 Logs, crash reports and other files you don't want are constantly being created.
 Your storage is collecting files and folders you don't recognize.
 Duplicate photos in your gallery.
 Let’s not go on here… Let SD Maid 2/SE help you!
 SD Maid 2/SE is an app and file manager that knows which apps created files on your device. It compares files with installed apps to help you safely free up storage space.
 ✨ Clean up after uninstalling apps
 If apps create files outside their designated folders then files can remain even after uninstalling the apps. The "CorpseFinder" tool finds app remnants, tells you to which app they belonged and helps you delete them.
 🔍 Search your device the smart way
 Filter for empty folders, temporary files, already installed apps and more. You can even create your own search criteria. The "SystemCleaner" tool automatically searches and deletes files based on various criteria.
 🧹 Delete expendable files and hidden caches
 Thumbnails, trash bins, offline caches and more: If apps don't clean up after themselves, then this app will. The "AppCleaner" tool finds apps with expendable files.
 📦 Manage all of your apps
 Get a comprehensive list of all apps installed on your device. Enabled, disabled, user or system app: no app can hide from you. The "AppControl" tool is an app manager that lets you search, sort and control your apps.
 📊 What is using all your space
 Storage management can be complex with apps, media, system, and other files across device storage, SD cards, and USB devices. "StorageAnalyzer" is a file manager that displays how space is used on your device, simplifying your storage management.
 📷 Find duplicate data
 Duplicate downloads, photos sent through social media or just similar pictures of the same scene: Over time copies can accumulate. The "Deduplicator" tool finds files that are exactly the same or similar and helps you delete extra copies.
 👆 Declutter with a swipe
 Pick a folder and go through files one by one with simple swipes to keep, delete, or skip. The "Swiper" tool lets you review all decisions before anything is deleted, and you can save a session to continue later.
 🗜️ Save space without deleting photos
 Photos can take up a lot of storage, but you don't always want to remove them. The "Media Squeeze" tool compresses your images with adjustable quality settings to free up space while keeping your pictures.
 This app is ad-free. Some features require a paid upgrade.
 SD Maid 2/SE is the successor to SD Maid 1/Legacy. Optimized for newer Android versions and focused on cleaning up.
 This app has optional features that utilize the AccessibilityService API to automate tedious actions. Using the AccessibilityService API, this app can click buttons for you to perform operations on multiple apps, e.g. deleting caches. This app does not use the AccessibilityService API to collect information.
 SD Maid 2/SE is a File Manager & Cleaner App.

fdroid:app.brix.name: Brix
fdroid:app.brix.summary: Free and open IRL streaming from your phone, on the move
fdroid:app.brix.description:
A free app for streaming from your phone while you move around. It publishes to Twitch and to any server that speaks RTMP, SRT or WHIP.
And when one network isn't enough, it can bond several links into a single stream, so the broadcast survives the walk from Wi-Fi to cellular instead of falling apart on the way. That part needs your own SRTLA-capable receiver.
An open alternative to the closed IRL apps on Android.
THIS IS A BETA
It works and has been used on air, but on a single device — a Samsung S21. Untested: MP4 recording over long sessions, Moblink with a real second phone. WHIP sometimes fails to connect on the first try — starting again helps. A Bluetooth headset microphone does not work yet: recording stays on the built-in one. The full list of limitations is in the project description on GitHub.
TRANSPORT
* SRTLA — bonds several links into one stream. The SRT and SRTLA client is written from scratch, not a wrapper around someone else's library.
* Plain SRT for receivers without SRTLA; the URL scheme picks the mode.
* RTMP and WHIP for when bonding isn't needed.
* Per-link priorities and weights, reconnect after a drop.
* Adaptive bitrate: RTT and its jitter, send buffer size, window-forced losses. Three aggressiveness profiles.
VIDEO AND AUDIO
* 720p and 1080p, H.264 and HEVC, hardware encoder.
* Scenes: camera, a "be right back" still, or screen capture. Each carries its own overlays, camera side and audio mode.
* Lens selection, zoom, torch, tap to focus, optical and electronic stabilisation controlled separately.
* Microphone selection: built-in, wired or USB.
* On-screen microphone level meter: clipping and mute are visible at a glance.
* A first-run wizard; settings offer only the capture modes your phone actually supports.
AUDIENCE
* Twitch, Kick and VK Video Live chat in one feed, anonymously, with emotes. Shown to the streamer only, never in the stream.
* Donation overlays for DonationAlerts, DonatePay, iHAQ, Donatty and donate.stream: image and caption drawn straight into the frame, with the donation sound optionally mixed in.
* Any web page as a source of picture in the frame.
ALSO
* Moblink: another phone contributes its link as an extra uplink.
* MP4 recording alongside the broadcast, from the same encoder.
* Configurable HUD and quick buttons on the streamer screen.
* Session log: power, temperature and transport figures once per second, for outings where no debugger can be attached.
REQUIREMENTS
Android 10 or newer and a hardware encoder. Bonding needs a receiver that speaks SRTLA and several networks at once.

fdroid:chat.simplex.app.name: SimpleX Chat
fdroid:chat.simplex.app.summary: SimpleX Chat - e2e encrypted messenger without any user IDs - private by design!
fdroid:chat.simplex.app.description:
SimpleX - the first messaging platform that has no user identifiers, not even random numbers!
 Security assessment was done by Trail of Bits in November 2022.
 SimpleX Chat features:
 end-to-end encrypted messages, with editing, replies and deletion of messages.
 sending end-to-end encrypted images and files.
 single-use and long-term user addresses.
 secret chat groups - only group members know it exists and who is the member.
 end-to-end encrypted audio and video calls.
 private instant notifications.
 portable chat profile - you can transfer your chat contacts and history to another device (terminal or mobile).
 SimpleX Chat advantages:
 Full privacy of your identity, profile, contacts and metadata : unlike any other existing messaging platform, SimpleX uses no phone numbers or any other identifiers assigned to the users - not even random numbers. This protects the privacy of who you are communicating with, hiding it from SimpleX platform servers and from any observers.
 Complete protection against spam and abuse : as you have no identifier on SimpleX platform, you cannot be contacted unless you share a one-time invitation link or an optional temporary user address.
 Full ownership, control and security of your data : SimpleX stores all user data on client devices, the messages are only held temporarily on SimpleX relay servers until they are received.
 Decentralized network : you can use SimpleX with your own servers and still communicate with people using the servers that are pre-configured in the apps or any other SimpleX servers.
 You can connect to anybody you know via link or scan QR code (in the video call or in person) and start sending messages instantly - no emails, phone numbers or passwords needed.
 Your profile and contacts are only stored in the app on your device - our servers do not have access to this information.
 All messages are end-to-end encrypted using open-source double-ratchet protocol; the messages are routed via our servers using open-source SimpleX Messaging Protocol.
 Please send us any questions via the app (connect to the team via settings!), email us or submit an issue on GitHub .
 Follow us on Mastodon ( @simplex@mastodon.social ), Twitter ( @SimpleXChat ) and Reddit ( r/SimpleXChat ) for the latest updates.
 Once you install SimpleX Chat, join the group of users via this link to share your ideas and feedback.

fdroid:com.dtsykunov.pause.name: Pause
fdroid:com.dtsykunov.pause.summary: A short, timed pause before chosen apps open, so opening is deliberate.
fdroid:com.dtsykunov.pause.description:
Pause adds a short, timed pause before you open the apps you choose. When you launch a selected app, the screen is covered by a panel with a countdown. Only after it finishes can you choose Open anyway or Cancel. It turns an automatic tap into a deliberate choice. It is friction, not a hard block.
The pause screen also shows how many times you have opened that app in the last 24 hours and when you last opened it.
Features:
* Timed pause: a short countdown before the app opens, with a length you choose.
* Per app: pick which apps get a pause; everything else opens normally.
* Open count: see how many times you have opened that app in the last 24 hours.
* Adjustable: set the pause length, a custom message, and whether the countdown is shown.
* Local stats: per-app pauses, opens, and cancels, plus total time paused.
* No network access: everything stays on your phone. No account, no analytics. The app cannot reach the internet.
How it works:
Pause uses an Accessibility Service to detect when a chosen app opens and an accessibility overlay to draw the pause screen, so it needs no "draw over other apps" permission. An accessibility-based gate is best-effort, not a hard block: it is meant to make impulsive opens deliberate, not to be tamper-proof.
Check your phone first:
Recent Android versions may already do this. Android 17's Pause Point adds a built-in delay before selected apps on some Pixel and Samsung phones, and Digital Wellbeing offers app timers and Focus mode. If your phone has those, prefer them. Pause is for older devices, custom ROMs, and phones that ship without Google's Digital Wellbeing.

fdroid:com.foxdebug.acode.name: Acode IDE: Terminal & AI Code
fdroid:com.foxdebug.acode.summary: Code editor for Android with Linux terminal, Git, plugins and AI tools.
fdroid:com.foxdebug.acode.description:
Acode is an open-source code editor and web IDE for Android. Edit projects, manage files, use a Linux terminal, work with Git and SSH, and extend your setup with community plugins.
LINUX TERMINAL
Acode includes an Alpine Linux terminal powered by proot, with no root required. Use apk to install supported command-line packages, keep multiple terminal tabs, customize your shell, and back up or restore your terminal setup.
AI CODING SUPPORT
Use the terminal and plugin ecosystem with AI-assisted coding tools where supported. Generate code, review errors, refactor files, and ask for explanations while working from your phone or tablet.
JAVASCRIPT AND WEB DEVELOPMENT
Set up mobile web projects with Node.js and npm, run package scripts, build APIs with server-side JavaScript, preview HTML and Markdown, and test front-end projects inside Acode.
PROFESSIONAL CODE EDITOR
- Syntax highlighting for 100+ programming languages
- Multi-file editing with tabs
- Command palette (Ctrl+Shift+P)
- File search across projects (Ctrl+P)
- Code completion and IntelliSense via LSP plugins
- Keyboard shortcuts for common editor actions
- Emmet support for fast HTML and CSS authoring
- Interactive JavaScript console for debugging
- Live HTML and Markdown preview
- Customizable themes and fonts
- Smooth editing for large files
GIT, SSH AND REMOTE TOOLS
- Git workflows including clone, commit, push, pull and branch management
- SSH access for remote server work
- FTP and SFTP file management
- GitHub integration for project sync
- Tools for editing, previewing and deploying web projects from Android
COMMUNITY PLUGINS
Extend Acode with plugins from the in-app Plugin Store:
- Language servers for IntelliSense
- Themes and icon packs
- AI-assisted coding tools
- Build tools and formatters
- Framework support for modern web development
- JavaScript and TypeScript plugin development
OPEN SOURCE
Acode is free and open source under the MIT license. Source code is available at github.com/Acode-Foundation/Acode. Documentation and community links are available at acode.app.
Pro version is available with ad removal and premium themes. In-app purchases may vary by region.
GET STARTED
1. Install Acode
2. Open the terminal and complete the one-time setup
3. Install the packages and plugins you need
4. Start editing, previewing and managing projects from your Android device
Acode requires Android 7.0+. The free version contains ads.

fdroid:com.xmrchat.xmrpod.name: XMRPod
fdroid:com.xmrchat.xmrpod.summary: Podcast player with Monero tipping support.
fdroid:com.xmrchat.xmrpod.description:
XMRPod is an open-source Android podcast player with Monero tipping support for creators on XMRChat. No tracking, no analytics, no ads.
The playback screen includes a Tip action for podcasts whose creators have an XMRChat page. Discovery happens entirely on your device: XMRPod downloads a single generic list of public creator pages and matches your subscribed feeds against it locally. Sending a tip is the only user-initiated call to XMRChat. XMRPod creates a tip payment address with the listener name, amount, and optional message, then hands the payment URI to a Monero wallet such as Cake Wallet.

fdroid:de.jeanlucmakiola.calendula.name: Calendula: Calendar
fdroid:de.jeanlucmakiola.calendula.summary: A Material 3 Expressive calendar for Android with no network access.
fdroid:de.jeanlucmakiola.calendula.description:
Calendula is an open-source calendar app for Android. It works directly on the system calendar provider, so anything synced to your device (Nextcloud via DAVx5, Google, local calendars, WebCal subscriptions) shows up in Calendula, and changes you make sync back the same way.
It has month, week, day and agenda views. You can create, edit and delete events, including recurring ones, and set repeats from presets or your own rules. When you change a recurring event, you choose whether the change applies to that one event, to it and all following ones, or to the whole series.
Calendula shows your event reminders as notifications. Tap one to open the event.
If you turn it on, Calendula also shows your contacts' birthdays, anniversaries and other dates. Contacts are read on your device and are never uploaded or changed. Calendula copies the dates into local calendars that you control.
The design is Material 3 Expressive throughout, with dynamic color and expressive motion and shapes.
Calendula has no telemetry, no analytics and no network access. Your data never leaves the device.

fdroid:de.musivum.notenkladde.name: Notenkladde
fdroid:de.musivum.notenkladde.summary: Photograph and import sheet music, read it while you play, write notes on it
fdroid:de.musivum.notenkladde.description:
Notenkladde photographs and imports sheet music and shows it for reading while you play, with your handwritten notes. All your music stays in one folder that you can take to any device.
• Photograph pages: the app straightens and crops them. A piece can have many pages.
• Import PDF and MusicXML scores and song lyrics (ChordPro, Markdown or plain text).
• Read without distractions: one, two or three pages side by side; MusicXML scores and lyrics are laid out anew for your screen. Turn pages with a tap at the edge or with a Bluetooth page turn pedal.
• Read two works together, such as a score and its lyrics, on one screen, each turning on its own.
• Chords stand above the words, with chord diagrams for guitar, ukulele or piano.
• Write on the music with a stylus or a finger, on layers such as “Fingering” or “Teacher”, each in its own colour. Your notes stay in place at every zoom.
• Keep the details of each piece: composer or author, dates, tags, license, work number, publications and linked works.
• Put pieces together in sets for concerts and rehearsals, with their dates, who you play with and the instrument for each piece.
• Make a PDF of pieces or of a set, with a table of contents, to print or share.
Your folder, your files: the music is kept as ordinary files (photos, PDF, MusicXML, lyrics), its details in an open JSON file, so other programs can use them too. Rename the folder, back it up or take it to another device. No account, no internet access, no ads.
Made for every language and script, right to left included. The app speaks English, German, French, Spanish, Hebrew and Japanese.

fdroid:eu.veldsoft.house.of.cards.name: House of Cards
fdroid:eu.veldsoft.house.of.cards.description:
The game starts with a standard deck of 52 cards. There are also four
Houses each “coloured” by one of the four suits. You put one by one
the random cards, that the dealer randomly deals from the deck, to one
of the different Houses (it is of no importance the cards to be of the
same suit with the House), trying to achieve a total of 31 in the house.
The total is calculated adding the cards (Ace counts for 11, Kings,
Queens, Jacks for 10 and the rest as they are, i.e. the 8 of Spades
counts for 8). Every time you manage to achieve a 31 in one of the
houses you get a bonus regarding the House in which you achieved that
(10 for Spades, 20 for Clubs, 30 for Diamonds, 40 for Hearts) and the
House becomes empty (total = 0). If in one of the Houses the total will
exceed 31 then this House is closed and you cannot use it any more adding
cards to it. In order to win you should add all 52 cards in the Houses
and only then your score counts in the hall of fame. You lose if all the
four Houses will be closed.
If the number of cards in a House will be six (6) and the total is less
than 31, it counts as a 31, the player gets 50 points and the House
becomes empty.
This rule adds 4 Jokers to the deck (each with a different suit). If
you add it to the House “coloured” with the same suit (e.g. the Heart
special card to the Heart House) then it is like having 31 no matter
what was the total there and the player gets 100 points, but if you
add it to a House “coloured” with another suit (e.g. the Heart card
to the Diamond House) you lose immediately.

flathub:com.github.makhber.Makhber.name: Makhber
flathub:com.github.makhber.Makhber.summary: Visualization and Analysis of Scientific Data
flathub:com.github.makhber.Makhber.description:
Makhber is a free interactive application aimed at data analysis and publication-quality plotting. It combines a shallow learning curve and an intuitive, easy-to-use graphical user interface with powerful features such as scriptability and extensibility. Makhber runs on GNU/Linux, Windows and MacOS X; possibly also on other platforms like *BSD, although this is untested.
 Makhber is similar in its field of application to proprietary Windows applications like Origin and SigmaPlot as well as free applications like Labplot and Gnuplot.
 More information, including screenshots, reviews, current contributors can be found on the GitHub project webpage.

flathub:dev.edfloreshz.WritingTools.name: Writing Tools
flathub:dev.edfloreshz.WritingTools.description:
Writing Tools provides private, local AI writing assistance right on your desktop,
 integrating seamlessly with backends like Ollama and LM Studio. Proofread text,
 improve grammar, and rewrite content securely without sending data to the cloud.

flathub:io.github.GGalya1.RiscvAdventure.name: RISC-V Adventure
flathub:io.github.GGalya1.RiscvAdventure.summary: This is a quest through the layers of computer architecture
flathub:io.github.GGalya1.RiscvAdventure.description:
Players must master various components to eventually understand and build the "Great and Terrible" Multi-cycle Processor. 31 Levels across 8 Educational Chapters:
 Register - The basics of data storage.
 Multiplexer - The art of selection.
 ALU - The core of calculations.
 Memory - Where instructions and data reside.
 Extender - Preparing data for processing.
 Register File - Managing multiple registers.
 Single-Cycle Processor - Putting it all together in a single cycle. (Work in Progress) 
 Multi-Cycle Processor - The ultimate goal!
 Companion System: Meet Charlie , your digital assistant. She provides hints, explains theory, and allows players to choose between deep-dive explanations or jumping straight into the action.
 Interactive Learning: Concepts are taught through gameplay mechanics rather than just passive reading.

flathub:io.github.fragglet.sdl_sopwith.name: Sopwith
flathub:io.github.fragglet.sdl_sopwith.description:
Sopwith is a modern port of the classic 1980s shoot 'em up game of the
 same name. The game has a World War I aviation theme. The object of
 Sopwith is to destroy all enemy targets with a somewhat limited airforce.
 It can be played both in single player and multiplayer mode over a TCP/IP network.

flathub:io.github.friesi23.mhabit.name: Table Habit
flathub:io.github.friesi23.mhabit.description:
"Table Habit" is an app that helps you establish and track your own micro habit. It includes
 a complete set of growth curves and charts to help you build habits more effectively, and keeps
 your data in sync across devices (currently via WebDAV, with more options coming soon).
 Moreover, this app is completely open source and comes with these features:
 A scoring system to help develop your own micro habits.
 Support both positive and negative habit.
 An easy-to-use interface for habit check in.
 A quick search and filter to help quickly find past habits.
 Different colors used to distinguish between various habits.
 Easily export and import habits using a human-readable format (JSON).
 Adapt to Material3 and Dynamic Color for Android 12 and later versions.
 Adaptation for landscape and large screen devices.
 Support network sync with WebDAV.
 No ADs in this app.

flathub:io.sourceforge.Pixelitor.name: Pixelitor
flathub:io.sourceforge.Pixelitor.description: Pixelitor is an advanced image editor with support for layers, layer masks, text layers, multiple undo, blending modes, cropping, Gaussian blurring, unsharp masking, histograms, etc. It has more than 110 image filters and color adjustments, some of which are unique to Pixelitor. Some of the gradients are unique to Pixelator.

flathub:net.goatattack.goatattack.name: Goat Attack
flathub:net.goatattack.goatattack.description: Goat Attack is a multiplayer 2D platformer pixel art shooter game. You can play it in a local network or over the Internet. Six gameplay modes are supported. Deathmatch, team deathmatch, capture the flag, speed race, catch the coin and goat of the hill.

flathub:org.ioquake3.ioquake3.name: ioquake3
flathub:org.ioquake3.ioquake3.summary: Free and open-source Quake 3 based engine
flathub:org.ioquake3.ioquake3.description:
ioquake3 is a free and open-source software first person shooter engine based on the Quake 3:
 Arena and Quake 3: Team Arena source code.
 The source code is licensed under the GPL version 2, and was first released under that license
 by id software on August 20th, 2005. Since then, our dedicated team has been working hard to improve
 it, fixing bugs, and adding just the right new features to make the engine even better than before.

flathub:org.koderoots.musik.name: Musik
flathub:org.koderoots.musik.summary: Simple audio player for KDE Plasma
flathub:org.koderoots.musik.description:
A lightweight native audio player built for KDE Plasma. Musik provides a clean and intuitive interface for playing your music collection with seamless desktop integration.
 Clean and intuitive design built with Kirigami
 Native KDE integration using Qt/QML
 Support for common audio formats including MP3, FLAC, OGG, and more
 Lightweight with minimal resource usage
 Playlist management and recently played history

flathub:org.pipewire.Helvum.name: Helvum
flathub:org.pipewire.Helvum.description:
Helvum is a graphical patchbay for PipeWire.
 It allows creating and removing connections between applications and/or devices to reroute
 flow of audio, video and MIDI data to where it is needed.

fedora-packages:gfs-baskerville-fonts/gf.name: gfs-baskerville-fonts

fedora-packages:gfs-baskerville-fonts/gf.description: John Baskerville (1706-1775) got involved in typography late in his career but his contribution was significant. He was a successful entrepreneur and possessed an inquiring mind which he applied to produce many aesthetic and technical innovations in printing. He invented a new ink formula, a new type of smooth paper and made various improvements in the printing press. He was also involved in type design which resulted in a Latin typeface which was used for the edition of Virgil, in 1757. The quality of the type was admired throughout of Europe and America and was revived with great success in the early 20th century. Baskerville was also involved in the design of a Greek typeface which he used in an edition of the New Testament for Oxford University, in 1763. He adopted the practice of avoiding the excessive number of ligatures which Alexander Wilson had started a few years earlier but his Greek types were rather narrow in proportion and did not win the sympathy of the philologists and other scholars of his time. They did influence, however, the Greek types of Giambattista Bodoni. and through him Didot’s Greek in Paris. The typeface has been digitally revived as GFS Baskerville Classic by Sophia Kalaitzidou and George D. Matthiopoulos and is now available as part of GFS’ type library.

firefox-addons:2972100.name: PDFMarshal privacy first PDF tools
firefox-addons:2972100.summary: Securely process PDF files in your browser. Redact, merge, extract, and more without uploading files.
firefox-addons:2972100.description:
PDFMarshal is the secure, privacy-first PDF toolkit that runs entirely in your browser. Redact sensitive data, merge documents, reorder pages, and extract text/images without uploading files to any server. Your data never leaves your device.
 Protect your privacy while managing your documents. 
Unlike other online PDF tools that upload your sensitive files to cloud servers, PDFMarshal processes everything locally on your computer using advanced browser technologies.
 Powerful Features: 
* Redaction : Permanently black out sensitive names, numbers, and text.
* Merge : Combine multiple PDF files into a single document.
* Reorder & Rotate : Organize pages exactly how you need them.
* Extract : Convert PDF pages to images or extract text using built-in OCR (Tesseract.js).
* Split : Separate a PDF into individual files.
 Why PDFMarshal? 
* 100% Local : No server uploads. No data collection.
* Free & Open : No paywalls for basic security.
* Fast : Zero upload/download times.
Perfect for legal documents, medical records, financial statements, and personal files.

firefox-addons:2623538.name: TWP - Translate Web Pages
firefox-addons:2623538.summary:
Translate your page in real time using Google, Bing or Yandex.
It is not necessary to open new tabs.
firefox-addons:2623538.description:
What can the TWP extension do? 
 Your page is translated in one click without opening new tabs.
 Translate PDF documents.
 Translate selected text.
 Multiple translation services are supported.
 Why do you need to access your data on all the websites you visit? 
This permission is required to translate the websites. 
 How are the pages translated? 
Pages are translated in real time using the translation service of your choice. 
 And how's my privacy? 
 Privacy policy We do not collect any data. However, the translation is done using third-party services and they may collect data to improve their services. 
 Limitations 
Some pages like support.mozilla.org and addons.mozilla.org will not be translated. For security reasons, the browser blocks extensions from accessing these sites. 
 How can I help you? 
 Patreon To help this project financially.
 GitHub To report bugs and contribute to the extension's source code.
 Crowdin For interface localization.

firefox-addons:2777564.name: Browsing Protection by WithSecure
firefox-addons:2777564.summary: Extension for protecting encrypted browsing with security products by WithSecure.
firefox-addons:2777564.description:
Browsing Protection by WithSecure is an extension allowing installed security products by WithSecure to protect your daily web browsing and online banking, and to show you security information while you are browsing the internet. The WithSecure security product uses WithSecure Security Cloud to obtain security ratings for the accessed URLs. 
With this extension the following products features are enabled: 
 Reputation-based browsing with the friendly block page to prevent you from unintentionally accessing websites that are not trustworthy or have prohibited content.
 Safety rating indicators to show a website safety rating on the search results page and SafeSearch mode for search engines.
 Connection control that adds another layer of security to prevent attackers from interfering with your confidential transactions when you access online banks or make transactions online. 
 Web content control allowing to limit access to inappropriate content to avoid viewing undesirable material on the internet based on their content. 
 Browsing Protection by WithSecure does not work as standalone and always requires an WithSecure security product to be installed. 
To install the extension, select Set up > Add.

When your team uses AI chat tools in the browser, Navige automatically logs every prompt, masks personally identifiable information, and sends the data to your compliance dashboard — with zero changes to how your team works.

- Automatic prompt logging — captures AI usage silently in the background
- PII masking — removes names, emails, and phone numbers before storing
- Employee attribution — tag usage by employee name for accountability
- Central dashboard — all AI activity visible in one place
- Toggle on/off — employees can pause monitoring instantly
Requires a free Navige account ( navige.ai ). Enter your API key in the extension popup to activate.

firefox-addons:3120378.name: AccessMate Accessibility Checker
firefox-addons:3120378.summary: Find and fix accessibility issues on any page. Scan against WCAG 2.2 AA, inspect what screen readers hear, simulate low vision and check colour contrast. Free, and checks run entirely in your browser.
firefox-addons:3120378.description:
Make the page you're working on usable for everyone, without leaving Firefox.
AccessMate opens in your sidebar and shows the barriers that stop people using a page: missing text alternatives, unlabelled controls, small touch targets, broken heading structure, low-contrast text and more. Every issue comes with the elements affected and what to change.
 View Introduction Video - https://youtu.be/pezM1rq19-g 
Free · Results in seconds · Nothing leaves your browser
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
SCAN: KNOW WHERE A PAGE STANDS IN ONE CLICK
• Check against WCAG 2.2 AA
• Get a score out of 100, with issues ranked by severity, items to review and checks passed
• Filter by severity or category to focus on what matters most
• Highlight affected elements right on the page
• See what an automated scan can't check, so you know what to test by hand
• Export results as HTML or JSON for reports, tickets and clients
ISSUE DETAILS: KNOW EXACTLY WHAT TO FIX
• Every affected element, with its selector and code
• A plain-language explanation of why it fails
• Links to the WCAG success criterion and further guidance
INSPECT: HEAR THE PAGE LIKE A SCREEN READER USER
• Headings outline in page order, with missing or skipped levels flagged
• Landmarks, images, forms and accessible names, each with problems counted
• Spot images with no text alternative and check which are marked decorative
VISUALISE: SEE THE PAGE THROUGH OTHER PEOPLE'S EYES
• Overlay issues, headings, landmarks, keyboard tab order and alt text on the page
• Simulate protanopia, deuteranopia, tritanopia, achromatopsia, blurred vision and low contrast sensitivity
• Run the WCAG 1.4.12 text spacing stress test and watch for anything that breaks
• Only you see the changes, and they turn off when you close the panel
CONTRAST: CHECK COLOURS AND GET ONES THAT PASS
• Pick any text on the page, or enter hex colours yourself
• See the ratio and pass or fail for AA and AAA, normal and large text, and UI components
• Get suggested text colours that pass, starting with ones that keep your colour's hue
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
BUILT FOR
Designers, developers, content editors, QA testers and accessibility specialists. Use it to check a page before release, review a design, or show a client where they stand.
PRIVATE BY DESIGN
All checks run locally in your browser. Page content is never sent anywhere. No account, no sign-up.
AN HONEST NOTE
Automated checks catch many common issues, but not every barrier. Use AccessMate as your first pass, then test with a keyboard and a screen reader, and get feedback from disabled people.
1 in 6 people worldwide live with a significant disability (WHO). Start making your pages work for them.
More free tools for websites, colours, alt text, PDFs and accessibility statements: https://accessmate.ai/tools

firefox-addons:2665445.name: Share-A-Cart
firefox-addons:2665445.summary: Share-A-Cart is a free browser extension that lets you share your online shopping cart with anyone. Whether you’re planning a grocery trip, sending a gift list, or managing a classroom supply order, Share-A-Cart makes collaborative shopping simple an
firefox-addons:2665445.description:
🛒 What Is Share-A-Cart?
Share-A-Cart is a free browser extension that lets you share your online shopping cart with anyone. Whether you’re planning a grocery trip, sending a gift list, or managing a classroom supply order, Share-A-Cart makes collaborative shopping simple and efficient.
🚀 How to Share a Shopping Cart
 Shop online like usual at your favorite retailer.
 Use Share-A-Cart to generate a unique cart sharing link.
 Send the link to anyone - they can instantly view and load your cart on their device.
Affiliate Disclosure: Share-A-Cart may earn an affiliate commission on purchases facilitated by the extension.
🏠 Great for Home Use
- Share grocery lists with family
- Send birthday or holiday gift ideas
- Organize back-to-school shopping with kids or co-parents
💼 Perfect for Work
- Teachers can share classroom supply lists with administrators
- Office staff can streamline purchasing with centralized supply lists
- Small businesses and teams can collaborate on procurement and restocking
🌐 Supports Thousands of Retailers
- Including Amazon, Walmart, Wayfair, Apple, and many more!
- See all supported stores here: https://share-a-cart.com/supported 
⭐ Top Features
- Free to use – no sign-up required
- Supports 95% of all online stores
- View & organize carts with tags and keywords
- Reorder easily from cart history
- Print & export carts you’ve created or received
👥 Who’s Using Share-A-Cart?
- Families & friends planning meals and gifts
- Teachers and staff organizing supplies
- Offices and businesses streamlining orders
- Influencers sharing promoted products with followers
- Homebuilders managing client needs
💬 Why Choose Us?
- Trusted since 2018
- Over 2 million carts shared
- Used in 3,000+ schools
- We don’t sell your data to any third parties or data brokers
- Responsive customer support
❓FAQs
Q: Where is the extension icon? 
A: It's on the right side of your toolbar. You may want to pin it so that it's always there. Just click the icon that looks like a puzzle piece, and then click the pin icon next to Share-A-Cart.
Q: What does Share-A-Cart do with my user data?
A: We don't sell user data to any data brokers. You can access most of our features for free and without giving us your email address or going through any registration process. 
Q: If I send a link to a cart to someone, do they need the extension as well?
A: Not always. Many major retailers are fully supported without requiring the extension on the recipient’s end.
Q: What if I find a retailer that you don't support? Or if I have an issue?
A: Email us at info@share-a-cart.com , and we'll get back to you right away. We are adding support for new retailers every week. 
Q: Can the person I send a cart link to edit my cart?
A: Yes! The receiver of the cart can add or remove items and change quantities. This is really helpful if you are sending a giant wishlist (like a Christmas gift list) to someone because it allows them to choose exactly what they want to order. 
Q: Why should I use Share-A-Cart instead of other extensions that do the same thing?
A: No other extension supports as many stores as Share-A-Cart, and we have many helpful features that our competitors don't. We have been in business since 2018, and this is not a 'side project' for us. And if you report an idea for a feature, new retailer, or a bug, we get back to you right away!
NOTE: Share-A-Cart does not complete any purchases on your behalf. It only helps shoppers move items from their cart to a recipient's cart. All checkouts must still be completed by the user. Share-A-Cart is not related to or endorsed by any of our listed retailers. 
Email: info@share-a-cart.com 
🔒 Privacy First: We never sell your data. No registration needed.
🛍 Note: Share-A-Cart doesn’t place orders for you - it simply shares your cart.
🏬 Not affiliated with any specific retailers.

bluejetty:00069370:ios.description:
The Ultimate Privacy Solution: Hide Photos, Lock Videos & Manage Gallery.
Do you have photos or videos on your phone that you want to keep strictly private? "Gallery Vault" is the all-in-one privacy solution designed to secure your personal media while providing a powerful gallery management experience. Whether you are protecting intimate memories, securing confidential documents, or simply cleaning up your camera roll, our app ensures that your data remains yours alone.
We combine military-grade encryption with a user-friendly interface, making it easy to hide pictures and videos from prying eyes. With features like the Fake Calculator disguise, Break-in Alerts, and Cloud Backup, you get complete peace of mind knowing your privacy is protected by the best technology available.
TOP FEATURES & BENEFITS:
1. Advanced Photo & Video Vault Move your sensitive media into a secure, encrypted vault. Once hidden, these files vanish from your main photo gallery and can only be accessed with your private PIN, Pattern, or FaceID.
2. Smart Gallery Manager More than just a vault, this app helps you organize your entire digital life.
Create custom albums and folders to sort your memories.
Clean up duplicate or unwanted photos to free up storage.
Sort by date, name, or size for easy access.
View images in a high-quality slideshow.
3. Disguised Entrance (Fake Calculator) Worried about someone forcing you to open the app? Use our "Disguise Mode." The app icon and interface transform into a fully functional calculator. The vault only opens when you type in your secret passcode and press the equals sign. To everyone else, it is just a calculator.
4. Intruder Selfie (Break-in Alert) If someone tries to guess your password and access your vault, the app silently snaps a photo of them using the front camera. You will see exactly who tried to snoop on your phone, along with the date and time of the attempt.
5. Private Web Browser Surf the internet without leaving a history or traces. Download photos and videos directly from the browser into your secure vault instantly. No cache, no history, no cookies saved.
6. Secure Cloud Backup Phone lost or broken? No problem. With our premium Cloud Sync, your hidden files are safely encrypted and backed up. You can easily restore your photos and videos to a new device anytime.
7. Fake Pin (Decoy Vault) If you are ever forced to open your vault, use a "Fake PIN." This opens a separate, empty vault (or one with safe photos), keeping your real secrets completely hidden.
WHY DOWNLOAD GALLERY VAULT?
Privacy: Keep family photos, ID cards, and personal videos safe.
Organization: A cleaner, faster, and better gallery experience.
Trust: We do not sell your data. Your privacy is our priority.

bluejetty:00023690:ios.summary: MobiDrive is a secure cloud storage ensuring your media, documents, spreadsheets, presentations, PDFs, and all other files are always by your side. From its powerful file conversion and office pack integration, to its cross-platform and fil
bluejetty:00023690:ios.description:
MobiDrive is a secure cloud storage ensuring your media, documents, spreadsheets, presentations, PDFs, and all other files are always by your side. From its powerful file conversion and office pack integration, to its cross-platform and file-sharing capabilities, let’s have a look at how MobiDrive empowers your productivity
SECURE DRIVE STORAGE & ADVANCED OFFICE FILE EDITING
- 20 GB of free cloud space that can be upgraded to a 2 TB (2000 GB) mega storage. 
- Sync, Transfer, and Store files and folders in seconds.
- Powerful integration with MobiOffice, a 4-in-1 office pack compatible with Microsoft Office and packed with hundreds of features to create, edit, and format any document, spreadsheet, presentation, or PDF.
- Automatic curation of files into Collections (Pictures, Documents, Video, etc.) for easier viewing. 
- Backup local photos and videos automatically to your cloud drive.
IN-DEPTH FILE MANAGEMENT
- Work with all major document, spreadsheet, presentation, or multimedia file types.
- Enjoy automatic content curation by file type in your storage - Pictures, Video, Music, Documents.
- Convert and sync files and documents to hundreds of supported formats. (Premium feature)
- Use dedicated sections for recently accessed files and documents in your cloud (Recent Files).
- Manage deleted files in the special Bin section of your drive.
- Track the changes made to your files with each file’s Version History.
- Up to 180 days of File Protection – Each file stored in the cloud Bin will be there from 30 to 180 days, depending on your plan, before being removed. That includes access to each file’s Version Histories.
ON-THE-GO, SYNC & SHARING CAPABILITIES
- Cross-platform sync files and documents to the other versions of MobiDrive.
- Share files and folders as an attachment or drop a handy Download link.
- Keep an eye on shared files with the ‘Shared by me’ and ‘Shared with me’ cloud sections.
- Keep a file ‘Offline’ to use when you don’t have an internet connection.
GET MORE WITH PREMIUM
Upgrade your storage and unlock powerful features to enhance your productivity.
- Up to 2 TB of Storage - Keep your local storages clean and your files and documents safe with up to 2 TB (2000 GB) of cloud space.
- Cross-Platform MobiOffice Premium - Enjoy full Premium access to MobiOffice versions on all available platforms.
- Convert Files in 1200+ Formats - Don’t let file formats limit you. Convert all major document or multimedia file types in your storage.
- 180 Days of File Protection - Work with deleted files and documents in the Drive Bin and manage Version Histories for up to 180 days.
- Advanced MobiOffice Integration – Create and edit files directly from your MobiDrive app, using MobiOffice.
PRICING & SUBSCRIPTIONS
MobiDrive offers an auto-renewable subscription.
The price corresponds to the same price segment, which is set in the "Apple's App Store Matrix" for other currencies.
• Your free trial subscription will automatically renew to a paid subscription unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the free trial period.
• Any unused portion of a free trial period (if offered) will be forfeited when you purchase a premium subscription.

bluejetty:00038468:ios.description:
The Express Plus Centrelink mobile app makes it easy for you to manage your Centrelink information online. To use the app, you'll need to have a Centrelink online account linked to your myGov account. With Express Plus Centrelink, you can do most things you can do in your Centrelink online account, without the need to visit an office or wait on hold. Here's what you can do using the app:
• View and update your personal details, including study.
• Report your employment income.
• View and update your family income estimate and payment choices.
• Check your payments.
• Upload documents to Centrelink.
• View your Child Care Subsidy details.
• Apply for or repay an advance payment.
• Track the progress of most online claims.
• View your Centrelink letters.
• Manage your Energy Bill Relief consent. 
• View and manage your Centrelink appointments by adding reminders to your personal calendar.
• View digital copies of your Centrelink concession or health care cards.
If you use a BasicsCard or if your payments are income managed, you can manage your own money to easily check your available balance and view recent transactions on your BasicsCard.
To sign in to the app, use your myGov sign in details and create a myGov PIN. You can then use your myGov PIN to sign in to the app each time you use it.
If you need help creating a myGov account, go to my.gov.au For help with linking Centrelink to your myGov account, go to servicesaustralia.gov.au/onlineguides For help using the app, go to servicesaustralia.gov.au/expresspluscentrelink

bluejetty:00082754:ios.summary:
ClockPhone is a stylish and functional clock app that’s easy to use.
It features an advanced alarm with flexible repeat settings: by day of the week, on a specific date, or following a shift schedule. And to make sure you really wake up, t
bluejetty:00082754:ios.description:
ClockPhone is a stylish and functional clock app that’s easy to use.
It features an advanced alarm with flexible repeat settings: by day of the week, on a specific date, or following a shift schedule. And to make sure you really wake up, there are not just standard options to turn it off, but also advanced methods — like scanning an NFC tag, QR/barcode (for example, on a toothpaste tube in the bathroom), or solving math problems.
ClockPhone also includes a versatile timer, perfect for workouts — including various interval types like Tabata, and productivity techniques like Pomodoro, 52/17, and 90/30 — as well as for cooking, meditation, and any task that needs precise time control.
The app combines a thoughtfully designed interface with a rich feature set. Thanks to its stylish and attractive time display, ClockPhone fits beautifully into any space. The large digits are easy to read from any distance, and the second hand comes with different display modes for enhanced readability. Time transitions are smoothly animated, and the clock’s appearance is easy to customize via a functional and intuitive interface.
Perfect for use on a charging dock or for bringing new life to a favorite device. It looks great in both landscape and portrait orientations. An onboarding guide shows how to control the app with gestures.
You can also add ClockPhone widgets to your Home Screen to see the time and date at a glance without opening the app. There are two types of widgets — simple and transparent — each available in two sizes and with plenty of customization options.
● Key app features to tailor it to your needs and use it comfortably in any situation
• Screen burn-in protection
• Exit lock to prevent unauthorized closure
• Simple and transparent widgets
• Display of date and battery level
• Customization of digit color, animation, thickness, and size
• Random color changing of digits
• Intuitive gestures: adjust brightness, toggle flashlight, open menu, resize digits
• Time signals
• Configurations — groups of settings that can be switched manually or on a schedule
• Backups
• Share settings, configurations, alarms, and timers
• Time zone support
• Display of analog and digital seconds
• Time announcements for visually impaired users
● Alarm features to suit any routine, habit, or personal preference
• Repeats by weekday, shift schedule, or specific date
• Option to postpone the next trigger
• Dismiss methods: standard, NFC tag scan, QR/barcode scan, or solving math problems
• Support for custom sounds from the Music library or files saved in iCloud
• Gradual volume increase
• Flexible snooze options: number of repeats and snooze duration
• Actions upon alarm dismissal
● Unique timer features to suit various use cases: interval training, productivity methods for work or study, and more
• Multiple intervals with different durations
• Repeat settings for entire interval series
• Sound at the end of an interval or name announcement at the start
• Pause or automatic transition to the next interval
• Actions upon timer completion
ClockPhone is constantly evolving based on user feedback. Install it on your iPhone, iPad, or iPod touch — and you won’t want to be without it!

bluejetty:00153968:ios.description:
TimeGuessr is the game that challenges both your geography and history knowledge in one addictive experience. Using real historical photographs from around the world, your task is simple: guess when and where each photo was taken.
Think you know your 1960s from your 1980s? Can you tell Paris from Prague just by a grainy street scene? Whether you're a casual player or a history buff, TimeGuessr will put your deduction skills to the test.
Each photo is carefully selected, showcasing moments that span continents and centuries. Place a pin on the map to guess the location, choose the year, and see how close you were. The closer your guess, the more points you earn.
New photos are added daily through the popular daily game mode, where players from around the world compete to get the highest score. You can also challenge your friends, compare your progress on the leaderboard, and even create your own shareable rounds.
TimeGuessr is more than just a guessing game - it's a journey through time and place, blending curiosity, memory, and discovery in a way that keeps you coming back for more.

bluejetty:00120335:ios.description:
Accelerate your algebraic calculation and accuracy as you expand your knowledge with these incredible rarely taught techniques. Learn to think differently about algebraic equations and amaze others with your equation solving prowess. With practice many of these techniques can be performed mentally with lightning fast speed. 
Easily master once difficult calculations as you watch and learn from the animated steps in every lesson. Practice each technique as you progress through various levels of proficiency and gain achievements along the way. Randomly generated questions ensure an endless ability to practice and have fun.
Master these algebraic techniques:
* Calculate 10% of Any Number
* Calculate 9% of Any Number
* Calculate 11% of Any Number
* Percentages of Numbers Less Than 100
* Percentages of Numbers From 100-999
* Multiply Two Polynomials
* Multiply Two Trinomials
* Multiply Large Polynomials
* Check Polynomial Multiplication
* Basic Algebraic Division
* Intermediate Algebraic Division
* Verify Algebraic Division
* Solve Simultaneous Equations
* Special Case Simultaneous Equations
* Basic Quadratic Equation
* Intermediate Quadratic Equation
* Advanced Quadratic Equation
* Verify Quadratic Equation Roots
Each lesson includes clear step descriptions with animated examples that can be watched as often as you like in order to ensure that you grasp the concept.
Prepare for the math section on the SAT, PSAT, ACT, GRE, GMAT, MCAT, or any other standardized test. Don't waste time with a calculator on the few tests that allow them. Use Mathemagics as a tutor to quicken up your test taking abilities.
Activate and challenge your brain to expand its ability to think efficiently and have fun at the same time. Train yourself to break problems down in to smaller more manageable pieces in order to reach solutions quicker and more accurately than anyone else.

bluejetty:00186319:ios.name: Piano Adventures® Player
bluejetty:00186319:ios.summary:
Piano Adventures® Player puts serious fun in the palm of your hand!
Nancy and Randall Faber, authors of one of the world’s leading piano teaching methods, are pleased to release a new mobile app that offers the convenience of a full MIDI pl
bluejetty:00186319:ios.description:
Piano Adventures® Player puts serious fun in the palm of your hand!
Nancy and Randall Faber, authors of one of the world’s leading piano teaching methods, are pleased to release a new mobile app that offers the convenience of a full MIDI player on your iPhone or iPad. The app provides easy access to interactive play-along accompaniments for the Piano Adventures method books — bringing an orchestra, jazz ensemble and rock band right to your mobile device. The user interface is elegantly designed, appropriate for all ages and instructional levels.
Interactive features enhance and motivate piano practice:
- Control tempo, parts, volume and balance
- Set loops to rehearse difficult sections
- Keyboard view with light-up keys reinforces the student part
- Score view with liquid layout, reflows notation as you zoom or change orientation
- High-quality instrument samples for premium sound
- Built-in metronome keeps the beat
Optionally connect to a MIDI keyboard for additional features:
- Follow Mode intelligently adjusts to track your tempo and dynamics or waits for you to play the correct note
- Listen to your recorded performances for personal assessment
BENEFITS
- Engage imagination with fun and creative arrangements 
- Reinforce model performances
- Make at-home practice more productive
- Easily explore a wide variety of musical styles, sounds and ensembles
- Build ensemble playing skills
- No disks to juggle or files to transfer
- Designed for both iPad and iPhone
CONTENT
- Available as a free download
- Thirteen levels available (My First Piano Adventure A, B, and C, Primer, 1, 2A, 2B, 3A, 3B, Accelerated 1 and 2, Adult 1 and 2)
- 1000 songs from the Piano Adventures Lesson, Technique & Artistry, and Performance books
- Includes three free songs per level
- Full song libraries may be purchased for $4.99 per level
- Digital sheet music with play-along tracks for 63 Popular songs at all levels, including: Star Wars, Thinking Out Loud, Hedwig's Theme, 100 Years, Pirates of the Caribbean, the Beatles, and more!
- Digital sheet music with play-along tracks for 72 Classics at all levels, including great symphonic and operatic masterworks by Bach, Beethoven, Mozart, Mendelssohn, Tchaikovsky, Vivaldi, and more!
- Digital sheet music with play-along tracks for 79 Christmas songs at all levels, including: Jingle Bells, Joy to the World, Rudolph the Red-Nosed Reindeer, Frosty the Snowman, Carol of the Bells, O Holy Night, and more!
- Easy access to video support for Adult Book 1 and 2
- International editions and multilingual support (Spanish, German, Dutch, Chinese, Japanese)
CONTACT
Visit PianoAdventures.com/player or send email to player@pianoadventures.com

bluejetty:00132361:ios.description:
Ready to manage your own airline? In Idle Airplane Tycoon: create your very own aviation business in one of the best and complete idle games!
Will you manage to build the largest airplane empire and become a wealthy entrepreneur?
To make billions, you will have to be the best on the ground … and in the sky.
Once on the landing strip, be ready for takeoff: make sure that your flights arrive at their destination whilst satisfying your customers!
Improve and manage your own airport network between flights.
COLLECT DOZENS OF PLANES!
Start with a single junky plane ... and end up with a fleet of luxurious airplanes.
Unlock and collect iconic airplanes by completing the exciting challenges of Idle Airplane Tycoon!
Upgrade your planes: add VIP seats and add luxury facilities like a casino or a bar in order to make sure that your flight’s are ranked amongst the best.
BUILD THE AIRPORT OF YOUR DREAMS
In Idle Airplane Tycoon, develop your airline by unlocking airports from all around the world: open flights to the most exotic destinations!
Upgrade your headquarters with all facilities needed to run a modern airport and to be able to welcome a greater number of passengers.
Transform your airport into a success story: open up more boarding gates and expand your duty free shop with new stores and various products.
Keep your airport safe: watch the boarding room, provide passport border control and security screening.
AND MANAGE YOUR FLIGHTS
Idle Airplane Tycoon is not only about building the airport of your dreams, it's also about managing your flights.
Manage your staff: train your pilots to deal with emergency situations and recruit hostesses to distribute food and beverages.
Complete crazy missions: passengers, precious resources or even dangerous chemicals, be prepared to transport all!
Will your pilot manage to safely land your plane at the airport?
Features available on Idle Airplane Tycoon:
- Collect and upgrade dozens of iconic planes
- Manage and expand your airports
- Satisfy your customers and improve your planes
- Explore the world map and unlock new cities and regions
- Complete various missions

bluejetty:00086496:ios.description:
Introducing Koinz - Your Foodie's Best Friend!
Welcome to the world of Koinz - The first social pickup food app in the Saudi & MENA region, where good food & good Times are always on the menu.
No matter where you are - cozy at home, busy at work, or out and about - - Koinz brings the best eats around you in a snap. With 500+ Saudi restaurants and cafes at your fingertips, From pizza and burgers to Arabic feasts and Italian treats, we've got it all!
Why Koinz?
Discounts & Cashback!
Enjoy your exclusive offer for your first-time order. and keep the excitement rolling with our special weekday and weekend direct discounts and cashbacks. 
Follow & Stay Connected!
That's right! You can follow your go-to restaurants on our app and never miss a beat. A wave of endless new eats and special deals through our stories. Easy to use, always exciting. with just a tap, turn those stories into a real meal.
Pickup Made Easy!
Skip the long lines and delivery waitings.
Order, Track, pick up when it pings & Go! Wherever you are, always get your meal ready on time.
Loyalty Program 
Grab a bite, earn points!
With Koinz, it's that easy. Order your favorite foods, collect points, and redeem them for free meals & gifts. Plus, make it more fun by sharing points with your friends.
Game & competitions 
Turn every order into a chance for victory, just like a treasure hunt!
Get ready for our exciting games and monthly competitions. racing up the leaderboard, earning Koinz, and winning big – all while enjoying your favorite food.
Thank you for making it to this point in our introduction; Ready for more? 
Take a moment to download our app and explore a world of daily wonders. And trust us, it's worth the phone space.
And don't forget to turn on the app notifications, for exclusive offers & gifts that await you.

bluejetty:00086959:ios.summary:
Trade Me is the must-have app for buying and selling items in New Zealand. With Trade Me, you can easily search, view your Watchlist, bid, and buy items, or sell the things you don't need anymore - all while you’re on the go.
The Trade Me
bluejetty:00086959:ios.description:
Trade Me is the must-have app for buying and selling items in New Zealand. With Trade Me, you can easily search, view your Watchlist, bid, and buy items, or sell the things you don't need anymore - all while you’re on the go.
The Trade Me app allows you to buy and sell a wide variety of items. Browse cars and boats, houses and rentals, couches and clothing, or find your next job—all in one app. The Trade Me app is the ultimate tool for Kiwi buying, selling and creating the life they want in Aotearoa.
With Trade Me, you can stay up-to-date with your buying and selling, whether you’re at home or out and about, on your iPhone or iPad.
Our app provides you with the following features:
- Search by keyword or image and browse and filter all Trade Me categories
- Add, view, and remove Watchlist items
- Bid on items or Buy Now
- Add items to your Shopping Cart to purchase multiple items at once
- Pay using your credit or debit card or credit your Trade Me account
- Save searches as Favourites and view them later
- Create a Job Profile to let top NZ employers find you
- Apply for jobs directly in just a few clicks
- Ask and answer questions including emoji support
- List items to sell and tweak them later
- Receive important notifications both within the app and through the Apple push notification service
- Use Face ID or Touch ID to pay
- Use Siri Shortcuts for the actions you regularly use
- Enjoy split view for iPad
If you love using our app, please leave us a review. If you have specific feedback, please send us a message at app_ios@trademe.co.nz. We're always working to make Trade Me even better, so stay tuned for more updates.

bluejetty:00173266:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00173266:ios.description:
ZOOMON - A RELIABLE HOME SECURITY CAMERA 
Do you want to create a home security system via mobile phones?
OR
Are you looking for a reliable application for HomeKit or IP camera?
ZoomOn is the only home security app that supports the most common types of security cameras (HomeKit, ONVIF, and other IP cameras - RTSP, MJPEG, and HLS protocol) and mobile phones (WebRTC).
USE ZOOMON APP AS A:
- phone/phone security system
- IP / CCTV camera
- app for your HomeKit / ONVIF cameras
- house surveillance system
- live cam monitor
- pet / baby / elderly monitor
- home alarm
Turn your mobile devices (one serving as a camera and the other one as a viewer) into a simle security camera system with ZoomOn app. On the other hand, you can use ZoomOn app as a viewer for your hardware cameras. 
DEVICES YOU CAN USE AS A CAMERA: iPhone (iOS 12 and higher), iPad, Mac, HomeKit or IP ONVIF camera, other IP cameras (RTSP, MJPEG, or HLS protocols)
DEVICES YOU CAN USE AS A VIEWER: iPhone (iOS 12 and higher), iPad, Mac, Apple Watch
---
KEY FEATURES:
- HomeKit/ IP ONVIF cameras compatible
- other IP cameras (RTSP, MJPEG or HLS protocols) compatible
- pan/tilt/zoom control
- live HD video stream
- smart notifications
- 2-way video & sound
- motion detection recordings
- noise detection
- night mode
- zooming in/out
- mic sensitivity adjustment
- low battery warning
- multi-home and multi-owner units
- picture-in-picture
- Siri voice control
- iCloud sync
- unlimited reach (3G, 4G, 5G, LTE, Wi-Fi)
A SECURITY CAMERA
To create a custom surveillance system in your home, all you need is at least 2 devices with ZoomOn app. Connect them and transform them into the perfect IP camera. 
ADD YOUR HARDWARE CAMERAS
ZoomOn app can check the availability of your HomeKit/ONVIF cameras on your network so you can add them to the app. And it goes without saying that camera functions (e.g. Night vision or Pan & Tilt) will also work in ZoomOn app. 
HIGH-QUALITY LIVE VIDEO & AUDIO
You can see your house perfectly anywhere, anytime, thanks to the full-screen video. ZoomOn app uses the most modern technology to ensure crystal clear live stream video monitoring.
UNLIMITED REACH
The app switches seamlessly between Wi-Fi, 3G, 4G, 5G, and LTE based on where you are. Keep monitoring whether you are next door or on the other side of the planet.
MONITOR MULTIPLE ROOMS AT ONCE
Put one device in the living room, one in the kitchen, and one just above the main entrance of your home. See all your rooms at once on your screen. So you will always know your house is safe.
ALL FAMILY MEMBERS CAN MONITOR
With ZoomOn app, the whole family can keep track of what's going on at home. You can log in to countless mobile phones under one ZoomOn account.
SECURITY CAMERA WITH NIGHT VISION
The night vision mode lets you see what is going on in the room even in the dark. Works both with the front and the back camera. The back camera uses the flashlight, the front camera uses the screen brightness.
GET NOTIFIED WHEN THERE IS NOISE/MOTION
Adjust the noise sensitivity in the app settings. You will receive a notification every time the sound in the room surpasses the set threshold. You will also be alerted to any movement at home.
SECURE CONNECTION
All communication between the phones operating as a security IP camera is securely encrypted. Industry-standard encryption is used to ensure that only owners have access to the home surveillance video and audio stream.
---
TRY ZOOMON APP FOR FREE
Go ahead and explore the app within 3 days with our FREE TRIAL! (as part of a yearly subscription)
If you're happy with the service provided, you can buy a subscription – monthly, yearly, or lifetime, depending on how long you plan to use the app.
Download ZoomOn app and stay calm wherever you are!
Terms of Use: https://www.zoomon.camera/terms-of-service
Privacy Policy: https://www.zoomon.camera/privacy-policy

bluejetty:00114465:android.description:
H Large Loan - Fast is an online instant personal loan platform that allows you to get instant credit in minutes.
You can get a loan of up to S$4000, and the process is fast, simple and secure.
If you are looking for a friend who can easily borrow money without any excuses, the financial function in H Large Loan - Fast wallet will be your best friend.
Production:
Loan amount: S$600 to S$13000
Minimum loan term: 6 months
Maximum loan term: 48 months
Maximum annual percentage rate (APR): 35% per annum
Administration fee: S$13 to S$1300, depending on the Loan conditions and amount.
GST: 18% Admin fee
Representative example:
If the loan amount is S$6000, the annual interest rate is 25%, and the term is 120 days, the interest will be charged as follows.
Interest = S$6000 x 25% / 365 x 120 = S$493
Management fee = S$100
VAT = S$100 x 18% = S$18
The cost for 120 days is S$6000 + S$493 + S$100 + S$18 = S$6611.
Annual interest rate = (S$6611 - S$6000)/S$6000/120 x 365 = 30.97%
Why choose H Large Loan - Fast’s financial wallet?
✔ Instant Personal Loan – The loan amount will be paid directly to your account within 15 minutes. Since the process is 100% online, you can make money anytime, anywhere.
✔ Efficient: We process your instant loan application quickly, without paperwork and frustration, as we adapt to your needs.
✔ Secure: Your data is safe with us. It is sent to our servers over a secure HTTPS connection and we will not share it with anyone other than the lender without your consent.
What should you do first?
1. Download and install the H Large Loan - Fast app on the Google Play Store.
2. Create an account
3. Upload your KYC documents.
Verification:
You must be a Singapore citizen.
You must be 18 years of age or older.
You must have a stable source of income every month.
Privacy policy address: https://fast.tst18.top/gw/SecurityPrivacy.html
Account cancellation address: https://fast.tst18.top/gw/SecureLogout.html
If you have any questions, please contact us via:
hlargeloanfast@proton.me
2 Jurong East Street 21, Singapore 609601

bluejetty:00128433:ios.description:
Learning gets wild in Hyper School!
Get ready for an education like no other in Hyper School, where you'll have to use your wits to pass exams, clean up the mess, and navigate the twists and turns of school life! It’ll make you feel nostalgic!
Sneak and Cheat 
Think you've got what it takes to outsmart the teacher and pass those tricky exams? Use your reflexes and cunning to cheat without getting caught! Just don't let the teacher catch you red-handed! 
Clean Up Duty
It's not all about academics! Grab that chalkboard eraser and clean up the mess left behind. The squeaky-clean chalkboard awaits your expertise!
Play Yard Patrol
Head to the play yard and round up those mischievous students! Get them back to their classes where they belong. It's a race against time to maintain order in the chaos!
Locker Organization
Organize the clutter in the lockers! Sort items like a pro and keep everything in its place. Neatness counts in Hyper School!
School Bus Adventures 
Hop behind the wheel of the school bus and collect students for a safe ride home. Make sure they get back in one piece! 
Unlock Shiny Treasures
Seek out golden keys hidden throughout the levels to unlock new and shiny items! The more keys you find, the more treasures you'll have at your disposal!
Decorate and Expand
Progress through the game and unlock new rooms in the school! Decorate them with the items you collect and create your own unique learning space! The more you progress, the more you can personalize! Feel free to head to the in-game store to get awesome new items that'll help you decorate your rooms even better & faster! 
Get ready to master the art of school survival in Hyper School. Are you up for the challenge?

bluejetty:00134166:ios.description:
Get ready for unrivalled coverage of the UEFA Women's Champions League!
The official Women's Champions League app brings you the best football from the top of the European club game, including live match streams, news, stats, live scores, analysis and video.
- Follow minute-by-minute updates for every match.
- Manage your own dream team in the UWCL Fantasy Football game.
- Track the numbers with live stats for each game.
- Review the goals in detail with next-day highlights for every match.
- With the live bracket, see the path to the final – and watch it update live as goals go in.
- Select your favourite soccer team and go straight to the news that matters to you.
- Read all the latest news and expert analysis from UEFA's reporters.
- Get an alert before anyone else as soon as official line-ups are announced.
- Never miss a goal thanks to real-time push notifications.
- Dig into the data with player and team stats over the course of the competition.
- Check the fixtures and standings throughout the season.
- Watch videos and highlights packages curated by UEFA experts.
- Vote for your Goal of the Week.
- Expand your knowledge of the top players with regular articles on the players to watch.
- Track the race for the competition's top scorer.
- Watch the livestream of the draws for the group stage and knockout rounds.
This is the easiest place to follow the competition that brings together the finest soccer teams from Europe's top leagues, including England's Women's Super League, Spain's Liga F, Germany's Frauen-Bundesliga, France's Division 1 Féminine, Italy's Serie A Femminile and more.
Follow all the top clubs as they progress through the tournament, including Barcelona, Lyon, Chelsea, Juventus, Wolfsburg, Paris Saint-Germain, Bayern Munich, Real Madrid and Roma, among others.
With the official app, you'll be able to watch the draws live as each team finds out who they'll be playing against on the road to the final.
Between matchdays, get up to speed with everything that's happening at the top of the women's game! You'll find a wide range of news articles profiling the biggest stars and best club teams, as well as detailed stats from every game.
Check the calendar for upcoming fixtures to see who's playing who, and learn more about each opponent with match previews and form guides.
Throughout the competition, you'll be able to keep up-to-date with all the football across Europe with real-time notifications. Follow your favourite team and configure your settings to get goal alerts, line-up announcements and more.
And once the matches have finished, see the results of every game, the standings in each group – plus how each goal affects the top scorers' charts.
Then, watch all the goals back with free highlights in the app, as well as curated video packages. And you can even make your voice heard by voting for the Goal of the Week for each matchday!
Download the app today to take your enjoyment of the UEFA Women's Champions League to a whole new level!

bluejetty:00200160:ios.summary:
iFacialMocap allows you to capture facial expressions in an iOS app and communicate in real time with 3DCG software on your PC. You can also do an FBX export by email.PC-side software allows you to import VRM models.
To export FBX, turn on
bluejetty:00200160:ios.description:
iFacialMocap allows you to capture facial expressions in an iOS app and communicate in real time with 3DCG software on your PC. You can also do an FBX export by email.PC-side software allows you to import VRM models.
To export FBX, turn on the REC mode and record. And when you press the mail button, the version selection screen of FBX appears, and when you press the OK button, the FBX file is saved in the File folder and the mailer starts.
Detailed usage is available at the following URL:
https://ifacialmocap.com/
This app can create face animations by communicating with Maya, Unity, 3dsMax and Blender in real time. In addition, animations created in real time can be baked.
This app can load VRM avatars within the iOS app. In addition, this app is linked with VMagicMirror on the PC and VRM related apps such as Luppet and HANA_APP.
To use, first start this app, then start "iFacialMocap to SoftWare app" on your PC and enter your iPhone's IP address.
(Donwload from PC use :https://ifacialmocap.com/download/
)
 Next, create up to 52 morph targets (BlendShape or ShapeKey) according to the naming convention.
Finally, use 3DCG software to load the script / add-on and press the connection button.
Very accurate facial motion capture can be performed very easily.
This app uses ARKit on devices that support ARKit facial tracking, and MediaPipe with the front camera on other supported devices. The camera image and resulting depth data are only used to send motion capture data to the user's PC. That data is not stored in the iPhone. To get depth data from Apple's API, access to the camera is required.
This application is only used for communication with PCs within the same network and does not send information to third parties.
TrueDepth is not required on supported devices. Tracking accuracy depends on the device and capture conditions. Camera access permission is required.
Examples of devices that support ARKit facial tracking:
・iPhone
iPhone13 mini
Phone13 Pro Max
iPhone13 Pro
iPhone13
iPhone12 Pro Max
iPhone12 Pro
iPhone12
iPhone 11 Pro Max
iPhone 11 Pro
iPhone 11
iPhone XS Max
iPhone XS
iPhone XR
iPhone X
・iPad
iPad Pro 12.9-inch (5th generation)
iPad Pro 12.9-inch (4th generation)
iPad Pro 12.9-inch (3rd generation)
iPad Pro 11-inch (2nd generation)
iPad Pro 11-inch
* On devices without ARKit facial tracking support, MediaPipe can be used with a supported front camera.

Scan a barcode and see the Walmart price in seconds. Then track it: price history, the lowest and average price, and an alert when the price drops.

Is that sale really a deal? Barcode Scanner for Walmart shows how the price has moved over time, so you buy at the right moment instead of guessing.

WHAT YOU CAN DO
• Scan barcodes: point your camera at a product's barcode to look it up and add it to your list.
• Search Walmart.com: browse Walmart's clothing or grocery department in the app and add any product.
• Two lists: a Watch List for things you're waiting to buy, and a Grocery List for the things you buy every week, with today's total, check-offs while you shop, and Add All to Walmart Cart.
• Your store's prices: Walmart's prices differ by store, groceries especially. Set your ZIP code and the app checks Walmart's prices for that ZIP code.
• Price summary: the lowest, highest and average price, and whether today's price is the lowest recorded.
• Price drop alerts: a notification when the price changes, when it drops, or when it falls to a price you choose. Tap it to open the item's price history.
• Common Groceries: 20 everyday groceries with today's prices, plus grocery price drops.
• Black Friday: one tap to Walmart Black Friday deals checked against price history on PriceWatchPro.com.
• Home Screen widget with Walmart clothing price drops, and quick actions on the app icon: Scan a Barcode, Price Drops, Grocery List.
• Add to Cart: send an item to your Walmart.com cart in one tap.
• Pull down to refresh every price on your list.
• Dark Mode and larger text sizes.

HOW IT WORKS
1. Scan a barcode or search for a product.
2. Add it to your Watch List or Grocery List.
3. Pick an alert: any price change, any drop, or a target price.
4. The app checks prices and lets you know when they change.

MORE PRICE HISTORY ON THE WEB
Visit pricewatchpro.com for free price history on Walmart, Best Buy and Home Depot products, this week's biggest price drops, and Black Friday price checks.

GOOD TO KNOW
• Prices come from Walmart.com. With your ZIP code set, they're Walmart's prices for that ZIP code; without it, Walmart's default online prices. The price at the register can still differ.
• Some barcodes may not be found. Search by name instead.
