Run through the valley counting numbers with TOBY and helping him
bluejetty:00186466:ios.description:
Learning math isn’t just educational, it’s fun with Math Bridges! Kids get to play fun, quick-paced math games while learning how to better understand numbers and counting!
Run through the valley counting numbers with TOBY and helping him fix bridges in a variety of math games and have fun learning! Numbers will teach kids effective math strategies through fun gameplay to help them solve addition and subtraction problems. 
Math Bridges suits any kid and adjusts the educational game based on their grade level. Kids will zoom through fun math games and their school work will show how much they’ve learned!
Math Bridges Features:
Math Games including
• Addition Games
• Subtraction Games
• Number Counting Games
Arithmetic Levels and Gameplay
• Math games offered in different levels based off children’s grade and math level
• Solve arithmetic problems to help TOBY fix bridges in the valley and learn new math strategies
• Use math to travel the world and have fun learning numbers!
Learning New Math Strategies for Kids
• Learning numbers through simple, fun math games to understand math topics better
• Practice counting numbers at their own pace with no pressure to complete levels
• Get math help through modern number games and find new strategies to help in school
Math Games and School
• Learning math is fun, and Math Bridges is another great math tool!
• Play math games as a class in school, and help children feel independent in math
• Encourage learning and make improvements in addition and subtraction
Math Bridges offers fun, fast math games for kids so they can have fun while learning! Adjust math games to your child’s grade, travel the valley and fix bridges by counting numbers with TOBY and feel more confident in school. 
Download Math Bridges today and see your child improve in math!

bluejetty:00146193:ios.description:
纳米盒，一款面向中小学生的课本同步闯关学的APP，覆盖语文、数学、英语、物理、化学、生物六大学科。1:1同步全国主流教材，科学设计每一课学习路径和学习内容，一站式搞定孩子预习、复习、练习、培优所有学习场景，帮助学生建立系统的知识体系，提升综合能力与自主学习能力。
【语文、英语点读课本】
覆盖2024年新课标版本教材，标准发音，功能强大，孩子自主学习，哪里不会点哪里。
内容介绍：
语文、英语点读课本，各大出版社官方正版授权，覆盖人教版、沪教版、苏教版、冀教版、北师大版、外研新标准、外研新交际、外研Join、陕旅版等50+教材版本；新增外研新交际版预备级教材，100%同步课本。
支持点读、复读、连读、翻译、跟读评测、智能背诵、听课文（正版音频）、课文生字、听写等十余种功能，帮助孩子纠正发音，认识生字词，自信流利说英语。
【语数英物化生同步AI互动课】
每个单元5-10节满分精讲同步AI互动视频课，AI数字老师，分组PK互动答题，每节课5-10分钟，讲透一个重难点。
【同步精准练】
根据每一课的知识重点，设置一课一练的课课练，让孩子快速刷题，扫清知识盲点；以及一周一测的同步单元测，一键打印，扫码看解析，做好单元总复习。
【语数英同步学教辅和预复习笔记】
5000+语数英同步学教辅，可部分代替纸质教辅书，减少纸质教辅书购买量，提升自主学习力。
同时覆盖预习、复习、巩固、培优等孩子课后在家学习场景，减少家长辅导课业负担，一站式解决学习问题，学习更系统、更专注。
内容介绍：
语文：课本预习（本节课的新知识梳理、难点攻克、拓展知识）、学霸笔记（用学霸的方法复习，包括课文详解、内容梳理、习题精讲）、课文生字（汉字笔顺、组词）、词语听写（解放家长，自主听写）、学作文，知识清单、同步字帖、默写本。
英语：课本预习（本节课的单词、句式梳理、难点攻克、拓展知识）、学霸笔记（用学霸的方法复习，包括句型、语法的详解、在线练习巩固）、练听力（20+种题型难度递进）、练语法（9000+练习攻克重难点）练阅读、词汇详解、知识清单，还有描红本、默写本。
数学：教材知识例题详解、教材母题变式、攻克易错题、学口算、同步计算题练习、应用题真题练习、单元知识清单、思维导图笔记、同步单元测，支持一键打印。
语数英拓展学：国际音标、情景口语、必背单词1000个、必背古诗词、晚读美文、句子宝典、数学思维故事等5000+智能教辅，等你来探索！
【课外阅读-有声名著】
精选中小学语文教材，《快乐读书吧》栏目指定阅读书目，包括四大名著、经典寓言、神话故事等200万字多媒体课外有声读物，按年级推荐，支持有声点读，图文并茂，激发阅读兴趣，养成良好的阅读习惯。
【纳米盒培优打卡营】
国际音标、自然拼读、语文阅读、数学思维等学习打卡营，系统监督学习过程，全勤激励，孩子自主学习，进步看得见，无需家长监督，解放家长更放心。
全新上线《纳米盒AI学苑》，真人1对1辅导督学、批改作业和答疑，科学安排学习规划。
【教辅练习册云打印服务】
纳米盒同步教辅练习册，支持一键打印、装订成册、包邮到家。包括《小学语数英同步单元测》《初中数学同步单元测》《小学数学口算天天练》《小学数学核心思维训练》《小学数学计算题和应用题专项精练》《小学数学应用题专项精练》《小学语文生字描红和看拼音写词语》《小学英语单词描红与汉英双向默写本》等。
【纳米盒荣誉】

荣获网易教育年度影响力在线教育品牌

bluejetty:00126932:ios.name: Lingard: Read & Learn Spanish
bluejetty:00126932:ios.summary: Learn Spanish by reading what you actually enjoy. Lingard turns books, daily news and audio into Spanish practice: tap any word to see its translation in context, listen along sentence by sentence, and keep new words with spaced repetition
bluejetty:00126932:ios.description:
Learn Spanish by reading what you actually enjoy. Lingard turns books, daily news and audio into Spanish practice: tap any word to see its translation in context, listen along sentence by sentence, and keep new words with spaced repetition until they stick. Learning French, German or English instead? Everything works the same way in all four languages.
## Graded books in Spanish, French, German and English
Books are adapted to your level (graded readers), so you can enjoy a real story even as a beginner. More than 1,000 books, dialogues, non-fiction summaries, podcasts and retold plots of popular films and TV series, sorted into six levels from beginner to proficiency (A1–C2). Not sure where to start? Take the CEFR level test in your profile and Lingard will suggest texts that match your level.
## Daily news in Spanish, French, German or English
Short news stories on a range of topics, updated every day. A few minutes of reading in your new language a day, with a fresh topic each time.
## Tap a word, get the meaning
See the translation in context, example sentences, synonyms, antonyms, phrasal verbs and word families, plus an AI-powered dictionary, without leaving the page. Translations are shown in your native language.
## Listen and read along
Every sentence has audio. Follow the text as it plays, change the speed, loop a sentence and repeat it out loud to train your listening and pronunciation. Audiobooks are synced with the text.
## Remember vocabulary for good
Save Spanish words from any book or article with one tap. Lingard's spaced repetition system (SRS) turns them into flashcards and brings each one back right before you would forget it. Before every session, choose whether to learn new words or review, and see how much is left for today.
## 200+ ready-made vocabulary lists
Topic-based word lists in Spanish, French, German and English for when you want to start right away.
## Check what you understood
Answer questions about what you read, with every mistake explained. Grammar rules and interactive quizzes help it stick.
## Speak with confidence
Say words and phrases out loud: Lingard listens and checks your pronunciation. Spelling practice helps you write them correctly too.
## Read your own books
Import ePub, PDF, DOCX and other files in Spanish, French, German or English and read them in the original with the same tap-to-translate dictionary, word saving and practice.
## Learn with friends
Keep a shared streak with a friend and climb the weekly leaderboard together.
## Sync across devices
Sign in to keep your books, vocabulary, progress and subscription in sync across your devices and platforms.
Lingard is for beginners who want simple Spanish texts with translation, for intermediate learners who need lots of real reading to move forward, and for anyone who would rather read a good story than drill isolated phrases.
Lingard teaches four languages: Spanish, French, German and English. Open your first book today.

bluejetty:00026946:ios.description:
OurTime is the dating app for people over 50 who are still out living their lives – and open to who they meet along the way. Whether you're 50, 65 or beyond, connect with people who share your interests, your pace, and your sense of adventure.
Are you ready to find your perfect duo? Maybe it's your new person for pickleball, someone to try that new restaurant with, or a partner ready to travel the world alongside you. Whatever you're looking for, you're in the right place.
Ready to start a new chapter? So are we.
With OurTime, you can expect:
 - Matches with people who share your interests and values, thanks to our smart matchmaking.
 - Real people over 50 near you, and real chances to meet in person.
 - Genuine connections built on something lasting, not casual swiping.
Dating over 50, built on trust.
We know online dating can feel like a leap, so we've made it a safe place to land:
 - An easy, intuitive app that guides you every step of the way.
 - Profile moderation and fraud detection to help keep the community genuine.
 - Strict privacy policies to protect your personal information and data.
With OurTime, you can meet people in the same stage of life and connect with confidence.
Here's how it works:
 - Browse profiles in the Discover tab and find mature people who match what you're looking for.
 - Like the profiles that catch your eye.
 - Start chatting once you match, and take your time getting to know each other.
 - Plan something real: a walk, a hike, a coffee, or a picnic in the park.
OurTime makes dating over 50 natural, respectful and easy.
Free when you join:
 - Build your profile with photos, a description and your interests.
 - Use Search to discover people who match your lifestyle.
 - Share stories and anecdotes in Topics to connect more naturally.
 - Get curated daily matches tailored to you.
Premium with a subscription:
 - See who liked you.
 - Know when your messages have been read.
 - Boost your profile to stand out.
 - Send a Super Like to show someone you're truly interested.
Whether you're after romance, friendship or lasting companionship, life's too short not to share the good stuff.
Download OurTime today and start your next chapter.
And if you've been searching for a senior dating app that actually feels like you, this is it — real people, real dates, real connections, where over-50 dating finally goes somewhere.

bluejetty:00148562:ios.name: Temas Bíblicos para Pregar
bluejetty:00148562:ios.developer: Maria de los Llanos Goig Monino
bluejetty:00148562:ios.summary:
Aplicativo na que encontrará todo tipo de recursos bíblicos que ajudarão você a estudar mais em profundidade a Biblia ou a pregar com o exemplo em qualquer momento ou lugar.
Temas bíblicos para Pregar está dividido em uma série de artigos
bluejetty:00148562:ios.description:
Aplicativo na que encontrará todo tipo de recursos bíblicos que ajudarão você a estudar mais em profundidade a Biblia ou a pregar com o exemplo em qualquer momento ou lugar.
Temas bíblicos para Pregar está dividido em uma série de artigos que vão desde a Admiração até o Vizinho, passando por temas tão variados como o Amor, a Confiança, a Conversão, a Paciência, a Superação.
Na cada um deles poderá ler um versículo de determinados pontos dos livros sagrados do cristianismo.
Com eles poderá entender que visão tem o cristianismo a respeito dos pontos mais essenciais na vida do ser humano.
É aconselhável usar temas bíblicos para pregar diariamente porque nos permitirá uma melhor comunicação com Deus e nos encherá de bênção.
Todos passamos situações difíceis em nossa vida e uma experiência com o Senhor nos ajudará a superar os maus momentos e voltar a ter alegria e força. Estes temas bíblicos ajudarão você a ter fé e manter você forte.
Os temas bíblicos para pregar ajudá-lo-ão a encontrar essa força dia a dia através da Bíblia e da Palavra de nosso Senhor Jesus.
Saiba todos os dias um pouco mais sobre a Bíblia e seguir o seu caminho e nosso Senhor Jesus Cristo.
É uma ótima oportunidade para nos melhorar e encontrar essa força e espírito que somente a Bíblia sabe como nos transmitir.
Temas Biblicos para Pregar é uma ferramenta que lhe fornece com diferentes tipos de recursos bíblicos. Esses irão ajudá-lo a estudar a Bíblia mais profundamente ou pregar usando os exemplos, a qualquer altura e em qualquer lugar.
Temas Bíblicos para Pregar tem informações sobre a Bíblia. Interpretação da Bíblia para obter respostas sobre tudo, oração, fé, conhecimento e muito mais.
O aplicativo contem:
- 140 Temas bíblicos para pregar como: Admiração, Adoração, Amor, Aprender, Batismo, Compreensão, Crianças, Deus, Espírito Santo, Evangelização, Jesus, Liberdade, Misericórdia, Paciência, Pecadom, Proteção, Purificação, Ressurreição, Sabedoria, Salvação, Transformação, Tristeza, Valioso, Verdade, Vício, Vida, Vida eterna, Viúvas ....
- Perguntas e respostas da Bíblia: irá ajudá-lo a entender melhor a Bíblia e vai encorajá-lo a estudar de maneira mais profunda.
- Estudos Bíblicos Variados: Estudos bíblicos variados na doutrina cristã básica que cada crente deve saber. De Grande bendicion a sua vida diária.
- O Dicionário Teológico do Novo Testamento mas completo e singelo com grande quantidade de definições e termos teológicos explicados e ordenados para sua fácil compressão.
- Estudo da Bíblia: Nós fornecemos uma compreensão básica de cada livro da Bíblia. Em cada guia o autor, data, finalidade da escrita, versos-chave, prenúncios e escreveu um breve resumo será incluído. Esta ferramenta irá ajudá-lo a entender melhor a Bíblia e vai encorajá-lo a estudar de maneira mais profunda.
- Devocionais Online: leituras breves de versos bíblicos relacionados, ajudassem você a estar mais de para perto de Deus todos os dias.
- Bíblia online
- Versículos Bíblicos en audio
Todos somos chamados para pregar o evangelho. Ao longo de nossas vidas encontramos pessoas que não conhecem Jesus e precisam ouvir o evangelho. Pregar não é apenas falar do púlpito; é também conversar e explicar sobre a salvação em Jesus para as pessoas que conhecemos.
Baixe e aprenda mais da Palavra de Deus.
Algumas pessoas têm o dom de pregação. Essas pessoas ajudam a edificar a igreja, ensinando mais sobre a palavra de Deus. Devemos respeitar os pregadores, porque têm uma grande responsabilidade diante de Deus e seu trabalho não é fácil. Também devemos analisar tudo que é dito, para confirmar que está de acordo com a Bíblia.
Temas Bíblicos que você não pode deixar de pregar. 
Faça o download agora Temas Biblicos para Pregar e partilhar connosco a sua experiência.
Deus os abençoe.

bluejetty:00136804:ios.description:
IMPORTANT NOTE
Petlibro and PETLIBRO Lite are two different apps. Make sure you download the correct one for your device.
IMPORTANT NOTE FOR GRANARY SMART FEEDER USERS:
To ensure you're using the correct app, please scan the QR code provided on your product or manual.
Introduction:
Petlibro helps you take care of your pets with ease, giving you access and peace of mind no matter where you are. Our app connects with a range of smart devices, including the Dockstream, Space, Air, Granary, and Polar, so your pet care is only a tap away.
Why choose Petlibro?
- Remote device control: Easily manage your Petlibro WiFi-connected feeders and fountains from anywhere, making sure your pets are always looked after, even when you're away.
- Real-time monitoring: Keep up with your pet's well-being with device status updates, activity logs, and timely notifications so you can quickly address their needs.
- Streamlined feeding schedules: Set up routine feedings with ease to maintain a consistent diet for your pets. You can even customize voice messages to make mealtime special.
- Stay connected anytime with video: Watch live video streaming and access saved cloud videos, so you’re always in touch with your pets, even when you're apart.
- User-friendly support: Get the help you need through our easy-to-use interface, ensuring your pet's care is never interrupted.
Supported devices:
- PLAF103 Granary Smart Feeder
- PLAF203 Granary Smart Camera Feeder
- PLWF105 Dockstream Smart Fountain
- PLAF107 Space Smart Feeder

bluejetty:00044516:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00044516:ios.description:
Thrive AI is more than a wellness app. It’s a private, emotionally intelligent space that meets you where you are.
A secure place to reflect, check in, and grow — guided by AI that understands how you feel.
Life doesn’t move in straight lines — and neither do your emotions. Some days you want to go deep. Other days you just need a moment to breathe. Thrive AI adapts in real time, offering thoughtful guidance, daily reflections, and gentle encouragement that moves at your pace.
With emotionally intelligent AI at its core, Thrive learns how you feel and responds with what you need most — whether that’s a calming meditation, a grounding exercise, or a moment of clarity.
This is personal growth without pressure.
Your privacy comes first
Thrive AI is designed to be a safe, private space just for you.
Your reflections, check-ins, and personal insights stay yours. We do not sell your data. We do not share your private entries. Everything you write is protected so you can be honest, open, and real — without fear of being watched or judged.
Thrive is built for trust, not tracking.
What you’ll experience inside Thrive AI
Daily Reflections, Exercises & Affirmations
Each day you receive one reflection, one guided exercise, and one affirmation — all personalized to your emotional rhythm. Small moments that create lasting change.
Emotion-Aware Check-Ins
Share how you feel and let Thrive gently guide you forward — without overthinking or overwhelm.
Personalized Growth Guidance
Thrive isn’t a to-do list or a rigid program. It’s a companion that listens, adapts, and supports you — whether you feel energized, anxious, tired, hopeful, or somewhere in between.
Journaling & Gentle Goal-Setting
Write freely, reflect on what matters, and turn insight into intention. Your journal and goals live in one place, helping you move forward in a way that feels natural and meaningful.
Progress That Feels Good
Track your growth through personal milestones and consistency — not comparison. Thrive celebrates showing up, not being perfect.
Why people come back
Because it feels good to return.
Thrive isn’t about pressure or performance. It’s about feeling supported, understood, and a little more grounded each time you open the app.
You’re not alone
Thrive AI is here to listen, support, and guide you — one check-in at a time, whenever you need

bluejetty:00184278:ios.description:
Com o aplicativo Banrisul Depósito de Cheques você pode validar cheques Banrisul e também efetuar depósitos direto pelo seu celular. 
Para verificar se um cheque Banrisul é válido, abra o app Banrisul Depósito de Cheques e capture o cheque (frente e verso) que você deseja consultar. Caso deseje efetuar depósito em cheque, baixe os apps Banrisul e Banrisul Depósito de Cheques e inicie o serviço pelo app Banrisul, acessando a opção Depósito de Cheques após acessar a sua conta.
O depósito de cheques por imagem é mais um serviço inovador dentro do app Banrisul. Com ele, você poderá efetuar depósitos em suas contas de forma rápida e segura, de onde você estiver.
Informações adicionais:
O serviço de depósito de cheques será habilitado sob assinatura de termo de compromisso, onde estão descritas as regras e responsabilidades do banco e do cliente.
A compensação bancária de cheques se mantém nos padrões definidos pelos órgãos regulamentadores, inclusive no que tange a trâmites e prazos. Esta compensação deve ser acompanhada pelo extrato bancário e pelas comunicações já padronizadas pelo Banrisul para todo os meios de depósito em cheque existentes hoje.

Para verificar se um cheque Banrisul é válido, abra o app Banrisul Depósito de Cheques e capture o cheque (frente e verso) que você deseja consultar. Caso deseje efetuar depósito em cheque, baixe os apps Banrisul e Banrisul Depósito de Cheques e inicie o serviço pelo app Banrisul, acessando a opção Depósito de Cheques após acessar a sua conta.
O depósito de cheques por imagem é mais um serviço inovador dentro do app Banrisul. Com ele, você poderá efetuar depósitos em suas contas de forma rápida e segura, de onde você estiver.

Informações adicionais:
O serviço de depósito de cheques será habilitado sob assinatura de termo de compromisso, onde estão descritas as regras e responsabilidades do banco e do cliente.
A compensação bancária de cheques se mantém nos padrões definidos pelos órgãos regulamentadores, inclusive no que tange a trâmites e prazos. Esta compensação deve ser acompanhada pelo extrato bancário e pelas comunicações já padronizadas pelo Banrisul para todo os meios de depósito em cheque existentes hoje.

bluejetty:00017551:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00017551:ios.description:
Using Akimbo with Apple Pay has never been easier! Add your card to Apple Wallet in just a few taps.
Akimbo - The Card for the Modern Household
The Akimbo Card is a unique budgeting and allowance tool designed to help manage your household finances. Link your bank account and set up regular loads to your card(s)*. Then keep track of your spending with real-time purchase alerts and our web and mobile apps. It all starts with one small goal - create a card and let the budgeting begin!
Add up to 5 additional “sub-cards” with any name. They are great for setting up specific budgets and allowances to family members or anyone. 
Plus, send money easily to anyone with an Akimbo Card. Find friends by entering an email or phone number. You can send money to friends with a click of a button and they have access to funds by using their Akimbo Card. 
You can use your Akimbo Prepaid MasterCard® everywhere Debit MasterCard is accepted and at ATMs around the world.***
Getting started is easy: Just download the app and if you don't already have an account, click the “Sign up” link at the bottom of the App’s login screen. There’s no fee to signup and no monthly fee!****
FEATURES:
Apple Pay support with in-app Apple Wallet provisioning
Add up to 5 sub-cards for budgets, allowances, family, or friends.
Setup one-time or automatic loads to your card and your sub-cards from linked bank accounts.
Load by direct deposit, cash, or with a paper check.
Send money free and quickly to any other Akimbo Card member or to any email address.**
Real-time text alerts for purchases (standard messaging rates may apply).
Add photos and notes to transactions.
24/7 Customer Support (phone, email, online).
No monthly fee and no charge for swipe and sign transactions with you Akimbo Card.****
Use it everywhere Debit MasterCard is accepted and at ATMs around the world.***
*U.S. bank accounts only. Successfully completing an account verification process is required before transferring funds. Bank transfers are executed through the Automated Clearing House (ACH) and generally takes between 2 to 4 days.
**Enrollment requires valid U.S. mailing address and identity verification (please see “Obtaining Your Card” below).
***The Akimbo Card is accepted at any ATM that displays the MasterCard or ACCEL® Acceptance Mark.
****Other fees, including ATM fees and POS PIN transaction fees may apply. Please see the Cardholder Agreement for more details.
IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT PROCEDURES FOR OPENING A NEW CARD ACCOUNT: To help the government fight the funding of terrorism and money laundering activities, federal law requires all financial institutions to obtain, verify, and record information that identifies each person who opens a Card Account. What this means for you: When you open a Card Account, we will ask for your name, address, date of birth, and other information that will allow us to identify you. We may also ask to see a copy of your driver’s license or other identifying documents.
The Akimbo Prepaid MasterCard is issued by Sunrise Banks N.A., St. Paul, MN 55103, Member FDIC, pursuant to a license from MasterCard International Incorporated. This card may be used everywhere Debit MasterCard is accepted. Use of this card constitutes acceptance of the terms and conditions stated in the Cardholder Agreement.
All trademarks and service marks are the properties of their respective owners. Akimbo is a trademark of FiCentive, Inc. © 2016 FiCentive, Inc. All Rights Reserved.

bluejetty:00080385:ios.description:
Transform Your Mind, Transform Your Life
Imagine waking up full of confidence, self-love, and inner strength. HypnoBox, backed by neuroscience, helps you tap into your subconscious, releasing unproductive habits and fostering lasting calm in all areas of life.
Why Choose HypnoBox?
• 700+ Customizable Modules: Personalize sessions to fit your unique needs.
• Voice & Sound Options: Choose between a soothing female or calming male voice, with customizable background sounds for a serene experience.
• Import & Record: Add your own audio or record content for ultimate flexibility.
• Works Offline: Access your sessions anytime, anywhere, even without internet.
Award-Winning Innovation
• HYPNO-INNOVATION AWARD – International Hypnosis Congress Zurich
• Voted Best Hypnosis App of 2023 by verywellmind.com.
What Makes Hypnosis Special?
• Natural Relaxation: Hypnosis brings deep relaxation while keeping you fully aware and in control.
• Targeted Change: It helps reprogram habits and behaviors on a deeper level than meditation.
• Science-Backed: Proven to be effective for stress relief, habit change, and emotional well-being.
HypnoBox Sessions
Each session is like a playlist created just for you:
• Introduction & Deepening: Guides you into a relaxed state for optimal effectiveness.
• Suggestions: Focused on your specific goals.
• Awakening: Gently brings you out of hypnosis (skip for sleep sessions).
• Background Sound: Enhances immersion.
What Others Are Saying
"Incredible! You can customize everything!" – Joko Winterscheidt (AWFNR Podcast)
"The most important app on my phone!" – Judith Holofernes (Wir sind Helden)
"The app actually managed to silence the critic!" – Business Punk Magazine
Start Your Journey for Free
Unlock the "Free Box" and enjoy 5 complimentary sessions, including topics like "Relaxation," "Better Sleep," "Memory Boost," and "Action Mode." Plus, access 10 free suggestion modules and customize your experience by importing or recording your own audio.
Join thousands of users transforming their lives every day with HypnoBox.
Meet the Developer
Bernhard Tewes, the creator and male voice of HypnoBox, is a renowned hypnotherapist based in Berlin, combining traditional hypnosis with cutting-edge methods to create lasting change.
Subscription Details
Choose from 1-month or 12-month subscriptions to unlock all content and future updates. Subscriptions auto-renew unless canceled 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel your subscription anytime in your iTunes account settings.
Have questions? Contact us at support@hypnobox.com. We value your feedback—don’t forget to leave a review in the App Store!
HypnoBox – Transform your mind, transform your life.

bluejetty:00159527:ios.description:
Reminderbase transforms how you communicate – from planning trips to automating appointment reminders, reducing no-shows, and growing your audience with hassle-free opt-ins. Our app ensures you never miss a beat in keeping your customers, colleagues, family, and friends top of mind. Trusted by over 16,000 users worldwide, turn every notification into a moment of connection. Remember everything better with Reminderbase!
We help you remember the important stuff, so you don’t have to. 
**Schedule text and email reminders.**
Schedule automated email and text messages from your personal or custom phone number on a one-off or recurring basis, with links and multimedia. Personalize your messages and save time with templates, all while ensuring your messages are delivered reliably. 
**Grow your audience with contact lists and sign-up links.**
Import contacts from your phone book and create contact lists for seamless bulk messaging. Generate subscribe links and share them anywhere, for your favorite people to join. 
**Remember more with calendar integration.*
Sync your Apple calendar with Reminderbase for automated reminders to yourself for personal or work-related appointments such as meetings, doctor appointments, deadlines, birthdays, and crucial tasks.
**Stay connected and boost your impact with audience trends.**
Monitor the growth trends and patterns of your contact list through our weekly updates. Gain valuable insights into your audience's engagement and identify peak sending times for creating well-timed interactions.
**Engage your audience with two-way conversations.**
Enhance engagement with two-way messaging and provide instant support through Conversations, fostering stronger relationships and ensuring a seamless support experience with an upgraded plan. 
**Important Note on Messaging Limits and Usage:**
- International text messages sent outside the U.S. are subject to higher costs. Depending on the country's cost, they will reduce your SMS/MMS limit by more than 1.
- With our upgraded plan, you can now enjoy the flexibility to send text messages using your custom number and choose one of our available local U.S. phone numbers.
Thank you for your understanding and happy remembering with Reminderbase!

Your account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period. bluejetty:00023749:ios.summary:
Inkflow is a note-taking and brainstorming experience unlike any other! Capture your ideas as easily as with pen and paper, then resize and reorganize them with your fingers.
DIGITAL WRITING DONE RIGHT

bluejetty:00023749:ios.description:
Inkflow is a note-taking and brainstorming experience unlike any other! Capture your ideas as easily as with pen and paper, then resize and reorganize them with your fingers.
DIGITAL WRITING DONE RIGHT
Inkflow's ink feels like a really smooth fountain pen. Great for expressive writing or sketching. Effortlessly scale or move anything you select. This will change the way you think about ink: Jot down a list of concepts then rearrange them to fit into the bigger picture. literally move your thoughts around the page, and assemble big ideas with your fingers. This works great for brainstorming and planning. It's also perfect for prototyping layouts, sketching, and drawing.
FULL RESOLUTION ZOOM
Zoom and pan with two fingers. Inkflow's ink stays sharp no matter how much you zoom in, so you can add fine details at full quality. It's also lightning fast and lag free. This allows writing and drawing with incredible precision, with or without a stylus.
TEXT, PHOTOS, and PAPER BACKGROUNDS TOO
Insert text boxes and photos anywhere on the page and resize them seamlessly with the ink. You can also choose from a selection of different stationery.
EASILY CREATE and SHARE
Inkflow let's you export your books to PDF, high-resolution JPEG, and share them via Twitter, Email, or with other Apps.
TRY INKFLOW FOR FREE
Rather than just read about Inkflow, go ahead and try it out: We've decided to make the Basic Edition of Inkflow completely FREE. The Basic Edition is a full featured note-taking and sketching app. It comes with the Fountain Pen with black ink, photos, and a standard set of 5 popular fonts for text. Books max out at 20 pages each, but you can create as many as you like.
If you're looking for more, there is...
INKFLOW PLUS
Upgrade instantly at any time to the Plus Edition to get:
- Inkport
- Dozens of premium stationery designs
- iCloud sync
- A customizable, full color palette,
- Pencil, Eraser, and Paint Brush tools,
- The Write-Behind Highlighter tool,
- Rotate, Cut, Copy, Paste Ink, and Page Management,
- Export as PNG with transparent backgrounds,
- Notebooks with unlimited pages,
- Custom paper backgrounds,
- An additional 50+ fonts,
- And more!
The Plus Edition lets you do even more things such as: Painting, cartooning, page layouts, and brainstorming in full color. Learn more in the in-App Quickstart Guide.
INKPORT: COPY AND PASTE FROM THE REAL WORLD
Only Inkflow Plus includes the revolutionary Inkport tool. Inkport uses your iPad's camera to instantly convert your written notes and sketches into Inkflow's native vector ink. Easily pull in materials from multiple sources and go from paper to iPad without missing a beat. Inkport is going to change the way you use paper in your workflow.
Universal App for iPad, iPhone and iPod Touch: Upgrade once and get Inkflow Plus on all your compatible devices connected to your iTunes account!
EDUCATORS: Inkflow Plus is also available as a standalone App, and qualifies for Apple's Volume Purchase Program.
A PLATFORM FOR CREATIVITY
We strongly believe that the iPad is not just a consumption device. It's a creativity device. Check out our whole range of creativity Apps on our website.
Keep on creating!

bluejetty:00015574:ios.description:
Completely revised and updated, the Physicians’ Cancer Chemotherapy Drug Manual is an up-to-date guide to the latest information on standard therapy and recent advances in the field. Written by world-class experts in clinical cancer therapeutics, this essential reference provides a complete, easy-to-use catalogue of over 100 drugs and commonly used drug regimens—both on- and off-label—for the treatment of all the major cancers.
Feature and Benefits
• Addition of 10 new agents approved by the FDA within the past year and updates to new indications for several previously approved agents 
• Indications, drug doses and schedules, toxicities, and special considerations for each agent expanded and revised
• A specific chapter focused on antiemetic treatment regimens for both acute and delayed nausea/vomiting
• Diagrams of drug structures and pathways for many of the agents
• A comprehensive discussion of clinical pharmacology, special considerations, indications, and dosages
• Covers toxicity and drug–drug interactions
• A section on chemotherapy regimens for all major cancers
• Provides an overview of the basic principles of cancer drug therapy.

bluejetty:00045739:ios.name: Arsenal Remote
bluejetty:00045739:ios.summary:
WHAT IS ARSENAL? Arsenal is the world’s first intelligent camera assistant for DSLR and mirrorless cameras. By combining this mobile app and Arsenal’s ultralight hardware you get complete control over your camera from your smartphone!
NEVE
bluejetty:00045739:ios.description:
WHAT IS ARSENAL? Arsenal is the world’s first intelligent camera assistant for DSLR and mirrorless cameras. By combining this mobile app and Arsenal’s ultralight hardware you get complete control over your camera from your smartphone!
NEVER MISS THE PERFECT SHOT: Like your own personal photography assistant, Arsenal lets you focus on the parts of photography you love while it takes care of the rest. In Smart Mode, Arsenal’s machine learning algorithm understands the scene you’re shooting, chooses smart settings, and fine tunes them using 18 different environmental factors. 
GET COMPLETE CONTROL: When you want full creative control, Arsenal’s Manual Mode turns your smartphone into the world’s best wireless camera remote. Set your camera’s shutter speed, aperture, and ISO. See a live preview of your shot. And trigger the shutter... all from up to 100 feet away!
TAKE GREAT SHOTS IN TRICKY LIGHT: Capture scenes with High Dynamic Range (HDR) without spending hours in front of your computer. Arsenal automates advanced exposure stacking techniques, taking multiple exposures and merging them into a single RAW or JPG file on your camera.
KEEP EVERYTHING SHARP: With focus stacking, you can get your entire scene in sharp focus. Arsenal calculates the optimal number of exposures, takes them at different focus positions, and merges them into one crystal clear image on your camera.
CAPTURE STUNNING TIMELAPSES: Arsenal makes capturing “holy grail” timelapses a breeze. Simply start your timelapse and let Arsenal adjust the exposure as the light changes for a smooth day-to-night transition. You can even preview your timelapse while it’s being recorded.
WORKS WITH MOST POPULAR CAMERA MODELS: Arsenal fully supports dozens of popular DSLR and mirrorless camera models made by Canon, Nikon, Sony, and Fuji. To see if your camera is supported, visit https://witharsenal.com/supported-cameras
You can learn more about Arsenal at https://witharsenal.com

Create professional invoices, estimates, and receipts in minutes with InvoPlex. This app helps you manage your billing, track payments, and organize clients directly from your iPhone. It is the ideal invoice generator for anyone who needs a simple, fast, and professional way to get paid.
KEY FEATURES AT A GLANCE
- Simple Invoice Creator: Build professional documents with items, services, taxes, and discounts.
- Digital Signature: Sign invoices directly within the app for a polished finish.
- PDF Export: Generate clean, shareable PDFs instantly.
- Payment Tracking: Keep tabs on paid, pending, and overdue invoices and send reminders.
- Multi-Currency & Tax Support: Flexible settings to accommodate global clients.
WHAT YOU CAN DO WITH INVOPLEX
- Create professional invoices and estimates in minutes
- Send documents via email, WhatsApp, or messaging apps
- Track payment status (paid, pending, overdue)
- Add your logo, signature, and business details
- Convert estimates into invoices in one tap
- Manage clients, services, and pricing in one place
BEST FOR
- Freelancers who need a simple invoice app
- Small business owners managing billing on the go
- Contractors and service providers
- Consultants and remote professionals
- Anyone looking for a fast and professional invoice generator
WHY CHOOSE INVOPLEX
- Simple and Fast: This app helps you create invoices or estimates in just a few taps — no accounting experience needed. Use it to replace messy spreadsheets and manual billing forever.
- Professional and Customizable: Add your logo, taxes, discounts, payment details, and notes. This app helps you match every document to your brand.
- All-in-One Billing Solution: Keep your clients, services, and documents organized in one place. Ideal for staying organized without juggling multiple tools.
- Work from Anywhere: Create and send invoices anytime — at your desk or on the go. Use this app to run your business from your iPhone.
FAQ
- Why do I need InvoPlex?
- Use this app to create, edit, and send professional invoices anytime, anywhere — directly from your iPhone.
- How do I create an invoice with InvoPlex?
- Simply fill in client details, add services and prices — the app automatically calculates totals and generates a PDF in seconds.
- How can I share invoices with my clients?
- Share directly via email, WhatsApp, or save as a PDF to send through any platform.
- Can I customize my invoices?
- Yes! Upload your logo and choose from professional templates to match your brand.
- Is it really free?
- Your first invoices and estimates are completely free to create. A subscription unlocks additional features like unlimited invoices and advanced templates.
Download InvoPlex for free and start creating your first professional invoice today!
SUBSCRIPTION INFORMATION

bluejetty:00163185:ios.description:
### Experience a Style Revolution with Our AI-Powered Hair Makeover App!
Are you ready to embark on a transformative journey into the world of fashion and hairstyling? Welcome to our cutting-edge application, designed to revolutionize your personal grooming experience! Delve into a realm where trends meet technology, and where the stars' iconic hairstyles become your playground.
#### Unveiling the App's Essence
Our app is a treasure trove of style, merging the brilliance of artificial intelligence with the ever-evolving trends in hairstyling. It's not just an ordinary platform; it's a virtual stylist that places the latest and most iconic celebrity-inspired hairstyles at your fingertips. We've meticulously curated an array of hairdos that have graced the heads of renowned personalities across the globe.
#### Seamless Interface & User-Friendly Navigation
Navigating our app is as effortless as crafting a new look! The interface is intuitively designed, ensuring a seamless user experience. Whether you're a style aficionado or just exploring the realms of hairstyling, our user-friendly design caters to your every need.
#### Celeb-Inspired Styles: Your Red Carpet Moment
Ever fancied the hairstyle your favorite celebrity flaunted on the red carpet? Now, you can effortlessly replicate those iconic looks. Our app features an extensive collection of hairstyles sported by the stars at premieres, award shows, and exclusive events. Explore the glamour of Hollywood or the elegance of the fashion capitals with just a tap.
#### Tailored Recommendations & Personalized Styling Tips
Discovering your ideal hairstyle has never been easier! Our app doesn't just offer a plethora of options; it also provides personalized recommendations based on your facial structure, hair texture, and preferences. Additionally, receive styling tips, tricks, and insights from top-notch hairstylists and fashion experts.
#### Virtual Try-On: Effortless Experimentation
Say goodbye to the uncertainty of traditional salon visits! Our app allows you to virtually "try on" multiple hairstyles before making any commitments. Experiment with diverse looks, visualize the possibilities, and confidently choose your next signature style—all from the comfort of your own space.
#### Interactive Community & Sharing Features
Join a vibrant community of fashion enthusiasts, hairstyling aficionados, and trendsetters! Share your transformations, seek advice, and engage in discussions within the app's interactive social platform. Connect with like-minded individuals, exchange styling ideas, and inspire others with your newfound looks.
#### Stay Updated with the Latest Trends
Fashion is ever-evolving, and so are we! Our app keeps you in the loop with real-time updates on the newest trends, emerging styles, and seasonal must-haves. Be the first to embrace the hottest hairstyles straight from the runways and celebrity circles.
#### Compatibility & Accessibility
Available across multiple platforms and devices, our app ensures accessibility for everyone. Whether you're using a smartphone, tablet, or computer, enjoy the same seamless experience regardless of the device you prefer.
#### Embrace Your Style Evolution Today!
Join the millions already transforming their looks, embracing newfound confidence, and unleashing their style potential with our AI-powered hair makeover app. Embrace the evolution of fashion, redefine your style narrative, and unveil a whole new you!
#### Download now and embark on your style revolution!

bluejetty:00093215:ios.description:
Create mobile apps and websites with AI, as easily as chatting with a friend! No coding required.
SteerCode lets you effortlessly build mobile apps, websites and games using just your words. Simply describe your idea, and watch it turn into reality faster and easier than ever. Experience VIBE CODING - a revolutionary approach where you focus on describing what you want while AI handles all the technical implementation. Skip the complexity of traditional programming and dive straight into bringing your creative vision to life through natural conversation.
NO CODING NEEDED
SteerCode is designed for everyone, regardless of technical background. You don't need to learn programming languages, understand complex syntax, or spend months studying development tutorials. Simply chat with our AI in plain English. Describe what you want to build, and watch your ideas transform into fully functional apps and websites.
SHARE YOUR APPS INSTANTLY
Once you've built your app with SteerCode, sharing is effortless. Generate a shareable link that friends and family can use immediately, even if they don't have SteerCode installed! Send them the link and they get instant access to your app on their iPhone through App Clips. Your creations go live instantly, no technical setup, no waiting.
MOBILE-FIRST CREATION
Built specifically for mobile experiences. Create apps that feel native on phones - with touch gestures, mobile-optimized layouts, and smartphone-specific features. Perfect for apps you want to use on-the-go or share with others who primarily use mobile devices.
GET INSPIRED AND START REMIXING
Discover amazing projects created by the SteerCode community and make them your own! Browse through public apps and websites built by other users, then remix and customize them to fit your vision. Found a game you love but want different characters? A website template that's almost perfect but needs your personal touch? Simply take any public project as your starting point and chat with AI to modify, enhance, or completely transform it. It's like having endless inspiration and a head start on every project.
LIGHTNING FAST DEVELOPMENT
What used to take weeks or months now happens in minutes. SteerCode eliminates the traditional development cycle of planning, coding, testing, and debugging. Instead, you describe your vision, and our AI instantly generates working prototypes that you can refine through continued conversation. Make changes, add features, or completely pivot your design with just a few messages.
Perfect for:
• Rapid prototyping
• Passion projects you've been putting off
• App ideas you discussed over coffee
• Tools that streamline your workflow
• Creative visions brought to life
------
It's like having your own dedicated software development team, available 24/7—just type what you want and see it built in real-time.
Perfect for beginners ready to turn their ideas into reality, as well as experienced creators looking to speed up their workflow.
Start chatting and watch your next big idea come to life, directly from your phone.

Footy’s AFL is always on the agenda and so are all the local, national and global talk topics that matter to all South Australians. Download the FIVEAA Player app and take the best of Always Adelaide wherever you go.

- Listen with Apple CarPlay
- Enter FIVEAA radio competitions for your chance to win!
Add the new FIVEAA Player app to your phone so you'll never miss a thing!
And if you've got mates interstate missing out on the latest on the Power and Crows, they can listen in from wherever they are.

Access your BMO InvestorLine Self-Directed and adviceDirect accounts using your existing Client ID or your BMO Nesbitt Burns portfolio using your online Gateway ID.

bluejetty:00175940:ios.name: Chess Crusade
bluejetty:00175940:ios.summary: MEET CHESS CRUSADE It’s the game that’s easier than chess and harder than chess at the same time. It’s chess for the curious, and it’s a new challenge for the deck-builders. Wield powerful new character pieces like Nightrider, Archbishop
bluejetty:00175940:ios.description:
MEET CHESS CRUSADE It’s the game that’s easier than chess and harder than chess at the same time. It’s chess for the curious, and it’s a new challenge for the deck-builders. Wield powerful new character pieces like Nightrider, Archbishop, and Angel to attack or protect the king in stunningly colorful worlds. 
Checkmate is just the beginning. Even when one game ends, your strategy continues. Refine your deck, experiment with your opening line-up, plot your next character upgrade, redeem your rewards, and win your way to the nearly unstoppable Angel. The more you play, the more powerful you become. 
GAMEPLAY Gameplay starts with a few pieces; choose wisely or you won’t have long to live. With each turn you survive, earn more Material and spawn a strategic new piece from your battle complement. But watch out, the game can change in a single turn—who will your opponent spawn? If they’re saving their gold, you could get slapped with the Angel, and she’s anything but angelic.
DECK-BUILDING Between games, build up your deck. Your deck has four card slots for Chess Crusade pieces—upgrade pawns to Rangers, sanctify your Archbishop, or run the brutal Rook Rush play. 
WARRIORS AND ROYALTY Chess Crusade springs from traditional chess—you’ll find the bishop, rook, knight, pawns and queen protecting the king. But in Chess Crusade, everyone in the kingdom has counterparts who are biggerbetterfaster. 
Ranger—Every pawn wishes he were a Ranger: the awesome hat, the damsels, and the freedom to move back and forth. 
Priest—The Priest sidles in the shadows, following in the bishop’s footsteps for a lower ante.
Tower—He’s a rook in training. What he lacks in reach, he makes up for with his willing spirit.
Princess—She’s delicate and beautiful, but she’ll send you straight to the gallows if you attack the throne. 
Nightrider—He’s in the king’s special forces, brave like a knight with sneak-attack range.
Crusader—The Crusader is a battle machine. He’s all knight and all rook, balancing long-range straightlines with a hooked-L surprise. 
Archbishop—The Archbishop is holier and more corrupt, with a staggering 20-position reach. 
Angel—She’s terrifying. 
PACE Play ranked PvP games or casual PvE games at your speed; be a Sloth and sleep on your next play for 23 hours of the day, take the calculated approach in 15-minute rounds, or ratchet up the heat in turns once every minute. 
FRIENDS Crusade with friends or challenge foes from the global leaderboard. You can even spectate live games friends are playing or learn from the top players in the kingdom. 
WORLDS Earn beautiful new themes to frame your battles. From the lovely Queen’s Meadow to the fiery Lava Flows, you’re far away in an epic landscape plotting a sacrifice or the ultimate endgame. 
GEMS Customize your world with avatars, card pieces, and taunts (“Bean slouch!”) from the shoppe. 
WHAT THEY’RE SAYING: 
“It’s making me crazy. I cannot stop playing.” —JordyB
“I’ve been playing chess for eight years and was skeptical a fun, new version could ever be created. I was wrong. It’s approachable, visually great, and addicting. I’ve played hundreds of games in just a few days.” - 04tuna
“This game absolutely ruined me for regular chess. I can’t imagine playing now without Nightrider, Crusader, or Ranger.” - Rank13
“This game will resonate with people who already love chess but are open to new experiences.” - Whom’st

Are you ready to understand what your dreams are telling you? Immerse yourself in the sacred realm of your dreams with Temenos Dream, your personalized dream interpretation and tracker powered by advanced AI. This cutting-edge dream journal offers a secure space for effortlessly recording and decoding your dreams, helping you uncover deeper meaning in your life.
Temenos Dream is more than just a dream diary - it acts as your insightful companion, unlocking the mysteries hidden in your dreams. Our proprietary dream analysis algorithm combines widely recognized dream dictionaries, science-based sleep research, and spiritual frameworks to offer unique perspectives and sophisticated interpretations, effectively serving as your personal dream advisor with its robust AI interpreter.
TEMENOS DREAM’S POWERFUL DREAM ANALYSIS FEATURES 
UNLOCK THE POWER OF YOUR DREAMS™
Harness our advanced dream analysis algorithm, integrating diverse approaches to unveil precise, relevant, and profound insights about yourself through your dreams.
TRACK RECURRING SYMBOLS FROM YOUR UNCONSCIOUS 
Delve into the symbols populating your dreams and discover their relevance in your waking life.
YOUR PERSONAL DREAM INTERPRETER 
Our AI interpreter is your personal guide - providing nuanced insights into your dream meaning, based on a vast dream dictionary.
SHARE AND CONNECT WITH OTHER DREAMERS 
Share, discuss, and explore dreams within the Temenos Dream Circles, forging connections through shared dream experiences.
A SACRED, SECURE SPACE FOR YOUR DREAMS 
Your dreams' privacy is our utmost priority. Every dream you log is encrypted, ensuring it remains visible only to you.
In addition to dream interpretation, Temenos Dream fosters a sense of community, allowing you to share your dreams with friends or within the collaborative Temenos Dream Circles. As you navigate the mystical dream realm, you can engage with a larger conversation around dream interpretations, enriching your understanding and experience.
Discover the magic of the AI-powered Temenos Dream App—a complete guide to exploring the enchanting depth of your dreams. Don't just sleep. Dream, interpret, and understand with us. Dive deeper into your dreams with Temenos Dream - your portal to profound self-discovery.
Temenos Dream is your ultimate dream tracker and sleep tracker, perfect for anyone interested in dream analysis, dream interpretation, and exploring dream meanings. Make Temenos Dream your go-to dream diary and discover the hidden meanings in your nightly visions.

bluejetty:00083496:ios.description:
The GK One app gives you all-in-one financial freedom to manage your money, shop online, and stay connected.
MONEY TRANSFERS & CARDS 
Collect or send Western Union transfers 24/7, make instant peer-to-peer transfers, and get a FREE VISA Prepaid card to shop online anywhere VISA is accepted.
QUICK TOP-UPS 
*Instantly reload mobile credit (Flow & Digicel), JUTC SmartFare bus cards, and Highway 2000 T-Tags.
SHOP ONLINE 
*Access Amazon, Shein, groceries, gift cards, travel, event tickets, courier services, and finance markets all from one hub.
INVESTMENTS & LOANS 
*Invest with First Global Bank (FGB), or apply for FGB credit cards, auto loans, and mortgages directly in the app.
INSURANCE & BILL PAYMENTS 
*Pay over 100 billers for free and purchase Third-Party Motor Vehicle or Accidental Medical insurance from GKGI.
REWARDS & DISCOUNTS 
*Refer friends to earn GK Value Rewards points and unlock exclusive merchant discounts through GK Loyalty.
EASY ACCOUNT MANAGEMENT 
*Track balances, view transaction history, get instant alerts, and manage or replace your card anytime.
Download the GK One app today and claim your FREE VISA Prepaid card!
N.B: To use some features of the GK One app, we are required to validate your identity to be compliant with local Know-Your-Customer (KYC) laws. In validating your identity, the GK One app will require access to your device's camera to capture photos and videos to facilitate ID verification and liveness detection. The Identity verification task must start and cannot be paused or interrupted to provide the best user experience possible. In some cases, the identity verification process may fail which requires the user to restart the process. We will require Foreground Service permissions for this process. Your privacy and data security are important to us, and all information collected will be handled in accordance with our privacy policy.
GK One - ONE solution, endless possibilities!
*The GK One digital product is being tested in the Bank of Jamaica Sandbox*

bluejetty:00180288:ios.description:
Keto Manager is a simple and comprehensive low-carb manager, and macro counter tool powered by speech recognition technology. The app brings valuable Keto insights in just one tap, as well as makes it quick & easy for you to track everything that matters to you most in your weight loss journey.
With a few taps Search, Scan, or Create a custom meal, Log it, and Track your results! 
So wherever you go, you have an app to track your food via search, barcode, and voice. Scan barcodes, use your device’s microphone to say what you ate, create custom meals, or use our HUGE databases of common foods, restaurants, groceries, and USDA!
Keto Manager is your all-in-one destination for living a healthy low-carb high-fat diet (LCHF) lifestyle. We've included low-carb diet articles, recipes, a meal planner, a guide, and much more.
Whether you are on a keto/ketogenic, Paleo, Atkins, Whole30, Balanced, Zone, or bodybuilding diet, Keto Manager can help you stay motivated.
KEY FEATURES INCLUDE:
1. Voice recognition technology: no more manual search and data input
2. Automatic macro and net carb calculator
3. Low-carb eating insights
4. Track your exercise
5. Easy-to-navigate design
6. Helps to lose weight or maintain weight
7. Connect with the Keto Community
VOICE YOUR DIET!
We have a simplified meal tracking process, where you don't need to search for the required ingredient or dish manually—just say it to Keto Manager and the rest is on us.
CALCULATE YOUR NUTRITION INTAKE!
With a keto diet, it is very important to keep track and measurements of all nutrition you eat. Now, all your protein, fat, carbs, and net carbs are calculated and recorded automatically within the app system.
Community!
The Keto app makes it easy to connect with people, start activity challenges, share success stories, your favorite keto recipes, and your keto journey with an uplifting community. Join the Keto community to connect with new people and share logs to help stay motivated and be inspired by others who are doing amazing things in their journey. 
Download now and start your weight loss transformation journey today.
Keto Manager integrates with Apple's Health app by:
- Pulling weight entries from the Health app.
- Pulling height from the Health app.
- Gets date of birth the Health app.
- Using Health data to pre-populate relevant fields during account setup.
*Prices are equal to the value that "Apple's App Store Matrix" determines is the equivalent of the subscription price in $USD.
You can read our privacy policy and terms of use :
https://pixsterstudio.com/privacy-policy.html 
https://pixsterstudio.com/terms-of-use.html

bluejetty:00030654:ios.summary:

Create scenes with mul
bluejetty:00030654:ios.description:
Sketch fast with MANIKIN a 3D posing tool containing a collection of models and tools aimed to help professional artists and amateurs alike in drawing anatomically correct figures with respect to light & perspective.
Create scenes with multiple characters or manipulate simple 3D shapes to quickly visualize the outlines of your sketches, generate storyboards with screenshots or frame your comic book illustrations and mangas. 
ARTISTS MANNEQUIN 
The mannequin was born out of the need for an interactive human anatomy reference to tackle problems like foreshortening, proportion and depth. 
We expand upon the wooden mannequin for figure drawing with various 3D models and tools to help you with shape recognition, shading, perspective and stance.
POSE FAST
Moving things in 3D often involves a lot of interaction for even the simplest of goals. This is why we wanted posing to be as intuitive and simple as possible with a bare minimum in menu diving and without losing complexity.
A straightforward and intuitive design keeps all functionality close without drowning you in options. 
Our goal is to let you spend more time drawing and less time preparing.
APPLY ANIMATIONS
Even for the most hardened artists it’s not easy to imagine how the body moves. In MANIKIN all animations can be viewed in detail. Use them to get faster to your desired stance or as use them as a figure study for motion.
CAMERA & LIGHT
We also give full control over camera & light. Use 360 mode to work and use "point of view mode" to get the exact camera angle you had in mind.
To ease your shading needs you have up to 4 fully adjustable lights at your disposal to create dynamic drop shadows and realistic depth.
SCREENSHOTS FOR DIGITAL PAINTERS
MANIKIN also features cutout screenshots so you can immediately use them in Photoshop, Coreldraw, Procreate, Paper or whatever digital drawing software you use. No more hassle with editing screenshots.
FEATURES
* View character animations in detail.
* A straightforward and intuitive design.
* Various tools and effects such as outline, cut-out, grid, ...
* Dynamic light with up to 4 fully adjustable lights 
* Freelook camera
* Screenshots without background.
* Share your creations on any platform and much more …

bluejetty:00156817:ios.description:
Managing your financial life should be simple and convenient. We bring modern craft banking to you in person, online and on your favorite devices. With your iPhone®, or iPad® mobile banking is a fast, convenient way to stay on top of your account. Plus you have the convenience of using the same ID and password as your Field & Main® online banking credentials.
With mobile banking, you can:
∙Rename, hide/show accounts, and more with customizable dashboards
∙Add tags, notes and receipt images to your transactions to stay better organized and easily search your transactions
∙Deposit checks in a snap by taking a picture of the front and back
∙Send an overnight or second-day payment electronically or via check
∙Set up one time, future dated or repeating transfers between your Field & Main accounts or to other financial institution bank accounts
∙Make payments, whether you’re paying a company or a friend
∙Create customizable notifications for when your balance is running low, large transactions, and awareness of your account status
∙Self-service settings allow you to change your mailing address, phone number or email without having to call or visit the bank
∙Securely message with Field & Main’s support team to get the answers you need
Secure your account with a 4-digit passcode and fingerprint or face reader on supported devices.
To use the Field & Main Bank Mobile app, you must be enrolled as a Field & Main Bank digital banking user. If you currently use our Internet Banking, simply download the app, launch it, and login with the same Internet Banking credentials.

bluejetty:00160423:ios.description:
Our app is a handy NFC tag application that allows users to read and write data easily. With the app, you can read NFC tags as well as write text information and data sets to them. Additional features include the ability to lock tags to write permanently and set a password to protect the information. - Customized Puzzle Difficulty, Free to Choose: Start with an easier jigsaw puzzle (like 36 pieces) for a quick win, and move up to a larger one (up to 400+ pieces) when you feel ready. No rush, just enjoyment.

Download Classic Jigsaw and experience the challenges as real jigsaw puzzles for free!

bluejetty:00127400:ios.name: RaceTools
bluejetty:00127400:ios.summary: RaceTools is the toolkit built for drivers who take their build seriously. Calculate your ethanol mix, find E85 stations without sharing your location, track every mod, and plan your routes. All in one app, built by a car guy for car guys.
bluejetty:00127400:ios.description:
RaceTools is the toolkit built for drivers who take their build seriously. Calculate your ethanol mix, find E85 stations without sharing your location, track every mod, and plan your routes. All in one app, built by a car guy for car guys.
Key Features:
1. Ethanol Calculator: Get the precise pump gas and ethanol amounts to hit your target blend in seconds. Your car's setup is prefilled from your last calculation so you're never starting from scratch. Tap any field for a plain-English breakdown of what it means.
2. E85 Locator: Find E85 stations near any address without sharing your location. Search by address, use your current location, or search the area around you. Community-reported availability keeps the data honest.
3. Route Planner (Premium): Know your E85 stops before you leave the driveway. Plan your route around stations, save your last 5 routes, and never get caught short on a drive.
4. Car Build Tracker: Every mod. Every part. Every cost. Track your full build history in one place, because your build deserves better than a notes app.
5. Tire Size Calculator: Compare tire sizes before you commit. See diameter differences instantly and protect your AWD system from unwanted wear.
6. CarPlay Support (Premium): Your favorite RaceTools features, right on your dash. Hands-free and always within reach.
Follow us: @racetoolsapp
Terms of Use: https://racetools.mirzaworks.com/TermsAndConditions.html?source=app

bluejetty:00040162:ios.name: Merge Cake - Design Story
bluejetty:00040162:ios.summary: Merge Cake - Design Story is an exciting game designed for food enthusiasts and creative minds. In this game, players will immerse themselves in the world of a dreamy girl, who aspires to build a unique bakery and coffee shop of her own. Yo
bluejetty:00040162:ios.description:
Merge Cake - Design Story is an exciting game designed for food enthusiasts and creative minds. In this game, players will immerse themselves in the world of a dreamy girl, who aspires to build a unique bakery and coffee shop of her own. You embark on a journey to explore cooking, arrange furniture, and decorate their space to create an appealing destination for customers. 
Create 100+ Delicious Treats
In Merge Cake - Design Story,merg, drag food items are central to the game. Players engage in the process of creating unique sweet treats by combining various ingredients and recipes to produce new and enticing products. To do this, players need to drag and drop similar ingredients on top of each other. When the ingredients are merged together, they will create a new, more advanced ingredient.
There are many different types of ingredients in the game, from basic ingredients like milk, sugar, and ice to more advanced ingredients like chocolate, whipped cream, and fruits. Players can freely merge and create their own dishes, from simple cakes to elaborate desserts.
Renovate & Design Your Restaurant
In addition to merge delicious dishes, players also have the opportunity to engage in decorating and renovating their restaurant. Players can buy different furniture and decorations to make the shop more beautiful and eye-catching. You can also build the town around the shop, creating a lively and bustling neighborhood.
Players can choose the decoration style for their shop, from classic to modern, from luxurious to youthful. Players can also build buildings and other structures in the town, creating a vibrant and attractive space.
In Merge Cake - Design Story you’ll:
Explore and experiment with new and creative cooking recipes
Experience the process of merge and combine ingredients to create unique dishes
Decorate your restaurant in your own style
Build the town around your restaurant, creating a vibrant and bustling neighborhood
Join the exciting world of Merge Cake - Design Story today and discover your creative potential in cooking and decorating! Download the game now to begin your journey!

bluejetty:00018524:ios.description:
Look no further, you have found the best Financial Calculator app available. 
In-App Purchase: 10bii+ Features (Bonds, Breakeven, Depreciation, Trig, Probabilities) available!
5 Stars: "What is the PV of WOW? I'm sure thrilled with everything about this app! Too bad there isn't room for another star!" - Pokey
5 Stars: "This tool is excellent. It's downright marvelous! I would recommend it to any financial advisor without reservation." -John L Olsen, CLU, ChFC, AEP
5 Stars: "Awesome Financial Calculator! I use it all the time and love it!" - Tinahart2 
5 Stars: "Great customer service along with the app's ease of use made this purchase a no brainer." - HarborDan 
5 Stars: "I am a full-time investor in real estate and notes. This has become my "go to" app on my iPad. [It does a] wonderful job in integrating visual tools to illustrate financial cash flows. A++++" - Sanjosee 
Highlights:
- Displays current N, I/YR, PV, PMT and FV values right above buttons 
- Print or Save PDF Amortization Schedules 
- Easily enter your Uneven Cashflows in a spreadsheet-like worksheet
- Video Tutorials in Help section 
- Draws Cashflow Diagrams for simple TVM or complex Uneven Cashflows 
- Saves Recent calculations so you can easily reload them 
- Easy Mode allows everyone to get the financial answers you need!
Finally a Financial Calculator for everyone! Whether you are a seasoned investor or you just have questions about paying off your credit card, refinancing your home, or planning your 401(k) contributions, the 10bii Financial Calculator has the answers to YOUR financial questions!
The 10bii Financial Calculator is a versatile and powerful financial calculator which features more than 105 different functions for financial analysis, business, statistics, and general mathematics. Modeled after the extremely popular HP 10bII Financial Calculator, the 10bii Financial Calculator app combines precise mathematics, intuitive display, and ease-of-use in one compact package. It allows you to easily calculate loan payments, interest rates, amortization, time value of money, investment value, and more using a combination of powerful and intuitive equation-writing functionality and helpful worksheets. The 10bii Financial Calculator's keypad has been specially designed to be easy to use and easy to see. 
By expanding on HP's traditional presentation, the 10bii Financial Calculator allows quick and intuitive building and visualization of TVM (Time Value of Money) calculations and Uneven Cash Flows, lets you see the stored values of all of your memory registers in one easy view, graphs your statistical series, and lets you type in whole equations for easy review and one-touch evaluation.
With the 10bii Financial Calculator, you can:
Get answers to common financial questions WITHOUT having to know how to use a financial calculator! With the 10bii Financial Calculator's Easy Modes, answer a few simple questions worded in plain language (rather than Financial-ese) and find out just how much you'll save with that refi, how much you'll have at retirement, how long it'll take you to save up for that big purchase and more. Now with 12 Easy Modes!
Easily enter and see diagrams for Cash Flows, including rapid calculation of Net Present Value and Internal Rate of Return. A dedicated interface makes adding, editing, deleting, and reordering uneven cash flows a breeze.
Enter and analyze statistical data points, and see graphs based upon the values you enter. Includes standard calculations such as standard deviation, mean, and linear regression forecasting.
Never has using a financial calculator been so easy or intuitive. The 10bii Financial Calculator is powerful enough for the professional but accessible enough for everyone. It is an ideal tool for teaching the power of compounding interest, analyzing potential deals or business ventures, or just doing math problems, and sharing the results of your work with others.

The Sixth Tone app brings you people-focused news, features, commentaries, and visual storytelling about contemporary China.

Daily Tones are daily news and highlights from across China.

Multimedia are visual stories that get up close and personal with contemporary China. A mix of short videos, documentaries, photography, and data visualization.
Sixth Tone × features translations, cross-publications, and collaborative projects from Sixth Tone’s external partners.
Special Projects showcase the collaborative efforts of Sixth Tone’s newsroom on diverse topics. 
Q & A features in-depth interviews with the minds and makers shaping today’s China. Your questions, answered.
Announcements are the latest news about Sixth Tone as well as its events, projects, and other initiatives.

bluejetty:00014962:ios.name: Advanced Naming Therapy
bluejetty:00014962:ios.summary: Take your speech therapy to the next level! Practice word-finding skills for adults with aphasia after stroke with this evidence-based app. Four engaging activities give you lots to talk about in new ways as you improve higher-level expres
bluejetty:00014962:ios.description:
Take your speech therapy to the next level! Practice word-finding skills for adults with aphasia after stroke with this evidence-based app. Four engaging activities give you lots to talk about in new ways as you improve higher-level expressive language skills including thought organization, attention to detail, and mental flexibility.
 **Try Advanced Language Therapy Lite for FREE**
Advanced Naming Therapy is your next step up from our best-selling Naming Therapy app - perfect for the speech therapy clinic and home practice for people with aphasia, cognitive-communication challenges, and unclear speech after stroke. Challenging, fun, and perfect for groups, Advanced Naming Therapy will be your “go-to” app for verbal expression.
------------------
4 Trusted Activities:
1) CREATE sentences using 250 action words based on the evidence-supported Verb Network Strengthening Treatment (VNeST) method for aphasia. 
2) GENERATE words in over 300 sound- and meaning-based categories to stretch your mental dictionary as you improve verbal fluency and speed after stroke. 
3) DESCRIBE over 500 interesting photographs that will make you laugh or scratch your head – and talk!
4) COMPARE and contrast over 200 pairs of items from concrete to abstract using verbal reasoning skills.
Over 1,250 unique stimuli – you won’t get bored as you improve with this exciting speech therapy app!
------------------
Here’s what you’ll be able to work on:
* Word Finding
* Sentence Creation
* Verb Conjugation
* Semantic Organization
* Non-Literal Language
* Verbal Reasoning
* Synonyms
* Mental Flexibility
* Speed of Processing
These activities can help people with aphasia or anomia after stroke, cognitive-communication challenges after brain injury, tip-of-the-tongue sensation during conversation, or other cognitive and communication challenges.
------------------
Helpful features and settings:
* Track progress easily with automated reports that include data and responses
* Assess verbal fluency easily with built-in tests with published norms
* Record your voice with on-screen audio recording you can email
* Adaptable to any level with multiple input methods: type, dictate*, or choose
* Learn quickly with helpful instructional overlays that guide you
------------------
See what Speech-Language Pathologists are already saying about this app:
“I love using the VNeST technique with my patients with aphasia, but I struggle to come up with good verbs and choices. I can’t believe how easy it is with this app! What’s even better is that now my patients can practice at home too. Thank you Tactus!” – Outpatient SLP
“The members at my stroke group were so engaged with the Describe pictures – even the ones who are normally quite passive spoke up. I can’t wait for my volunteers and families to start using this app.” - Community SLP
“My client with aphasia used your 4-in-1 app until he got too good. I showed him this one and he loved it! It’s just the right level for him now. In general, for the stroke and brain injury clients I usually see, I think this is your most useful app yet!” – Private Practice SLP
“Everyone loves Generate – including me! I’ve used it to elicit clear speech while engaging in a cognitive challenge for a patient with Parkinson’s, and my aphasia group gets very competitive with it. Each activity is useful for so many goals.” – Rehab SLP
“I used the app today with 2 kindergarten students working on /s/ and turned to Describe for the silly pictures. We were all giggles, and they were so motivated!” – School SLP
------------------
Download now to get started – or try it for FREE with Advanced Language Therapy Lite!
Looking for something different in a speech therapy app? We offer a wide range to choose from. Find the right one for you at tactustherapy.com/find
*Voice dictation requires 3rd generation iPad or newer

bluejetty:00066185:ios.name: Palavras Cruzadas - Português
bluejetty:00066185:ios.summary:
Gosta de treinar o seu raciocínio e os seus conhecimentos sobre língua portuguesa e os temas mais variados? Então este é o jogo perfeito para você.
As Palavras Cruzadas são um passatempo tradicional, muito comum em jornais e revistas e, po
bluejetty:00066185:ios.description:
Gosta de treinar o seu raciocínio e os seus conhecimentos sobre língua portuguesa e os temas mais variados? Então este é o jogo perfeito para você.
As Palavras Cruzadas são um passatempo tradicional, muito comum em jornais e revistas e, por isso, um grande sucesso também na internet.
Aqui, o objetivo é encontrar todas as palavras utilizando as dicas disponíveis. Conforme algumas palavras são preenchidas, o jogo preenche automaticamente algumas letras de outras palavras, facilitando a resolução de cada desafio.
A dificuldade das palavras cruzadas variam de acordo com o formato e a quantidade de palavras. Quanto menos as palavras se cruzam maior é a possibilidade do jogo ser mais difícil.
Esse passatempo consiste em várias linhas formadas por quadrados em branco, algumas na vertical e outras na horizontal, que se cruzam umas com as outras. Cada linha deve ser preenchida por uma palavra e cada palavra deve ser descoberta através de dicas que acompanham as cruzadas. Ao se preencher uma das linhas, automaticamente se preenche alguns quadrados das outras linhas que a cruzam, tornando mais fácil sua resolução. 
A prática ou cultivo das palavras cruzadas pelos leigos é denominado "cruzadismo" e os seus praticantes são chamados de "cruzadistas". Então venha, cruzadista! O melhor jogo dos últimos tempos está à sua espera.
Recursos do jogo: Modo Horizontal (Paisagem) no iPad, Pesquisa, Modo Escuro, Dicas de Múltiplas Palavras, Pular Células Preenchidas, Travar Palavras Corretas, Assistência para Cruzadas Incorretas, Revelar Palavras, Mostrar Erros, Limpar Erros, Modo Offline, Temas de Cores.
---
AVISO: As opiniões expressadas nas palavras cruzadas incluídas neste aplicativo representam somente as opiniões dos autores e não necessariamente representam as opiniões da Redstone Games ou qualquer membro da empresa.

You PLAY, we PLANT!
Discover a natural world where you merge to plant real trees! Our mission is to make games that protect nature and fight climate change. With over 2 MILLION real trees planted in worldwide conservation projects, you can join our community and merge to fight climate change today. 
= KEY FEATURES =
• ECO ADVENTURE
Uncover a devastating climate disaster that needs your help. Expose secret crimes of the mystery corporation behind the park's destruction! Work with the town mayor, the park ranger and the investigative journalist to unravel the gossip and travel a world that stretches the county on a road trip of eco fun!
• RESTORE THE VALLEY
Discover a valley that lies in ruin. Merge to design and renovate nature's garden to a sunny paradise; from the quiet creek to the heights of Mount Fairview. Your mission is to protect the environment. Only you can stop the development of a mansion, cafe, restaurant, diner or manor on the green land.
• COLLECT ANIMALS
Rescue animals and give them a home on your merge board. Exciting special events give exclusive animal rewards! Discover new merge opportunities with an evolving events calendar. Compete with other merge players from around the world for extra boosters!
• MERGE TO RELAX 
Relax and reconnect with nature as you create a green world. It's the easy, cozy way to make a difference for the planet!
• PLANT REAL TREES
We partner with Eden: People + Planet to plant real trees and protect our world. Reach level 12 to plant your first real tree today!
Longleaf Valley is the number one merge game for a better planet! Download to fight climate change and plant your tree today!
