bluejetty:00092283:ios.description:
GoBuid is a user-friendly construction tracking app designed to make your construction projects easier and more efficient. Whether you're a small business or doing several large projects, GoBuid is here to help you save valuable time and resources for your business.
Discover GoBuid's Incredible Features:
1. Equipment Management Made Simple: Easily create and organize your equipment inventory. Each item gets its own unique QR code for hassle-free tracking of its location and status in real-time.
2. Task Management Bliss: Assign tasks to your team effortlessly, keep track of their progress, and foster collaboration among team members. It's the secret sauce to completing tasks on time, every time!
3. Manpower Tracking with a Smile: Wave goodbye to paper timesheets! GoBuid offers digital timesheets and GPS breadcrumbs, so you always know who's on-site and where they are. No more guessing games!
4. Central Schedule Hub: Imagine managing all your tasks and projects in one convenient location. GoBuid's central schedule feature makes it a breeze to oversee your team's progress and get notified when tasks are completed.
5. Track Map Magic: Instantly locate your team members and equipment in real-time with our track map feature. Say goodbye to searching for lost workers or misplaced equipment – it's all right there on the map!
6. Progress Tracking for Success: Keep an eagle eye on site activities and calculate productivity by tagging your manpower and equipment. It's your ticket to understanding your project's progress like never before!
7. Budget Management Bliss: Set and manage budgets for manpower, equipment, and materials with ease. Stay in control of your project's finances and make budget requests effortlessly.
The Wonderful Benefits of GoBuid:
• Time and Money Savings: By simplifying and automating construction management tasks, GoBuid lets you focus on what matters most – your projects. Say goodbye to time-consuming paperwork!
• Efficiency and Productivity Boost: With all your project information neatly organized, your team can work together seamlessly, ensuring tasks are completed efficiently and on schedule.
• Less Downtime, More Peace of Mind: Real-time tracking of your team and equipment means you can quickly address any issues, reducing downtime and ensuring everyone stays safe.
• Empowered Decision-Making: Make informed decisions on the fly with real-time project data at your fingertips. It's like having a crystal ball for your construction projects!
Don't wait! Embrace the future of construction management with GoBuid. 
Download our app today and experience the joy of streamlined project success. 
Let's build a better tomorrow, one project at a time, with GoBuid by your side!

bluejetty:00069494:ios.description:
Loopy Pro: Live Looper, Sampler, Sequencer, Customisable DAW
Loopy Pro is a customisable music creation environment that blends looping, sampling, MIDI sequencing, and full plugin hosting — with a creative canvas that you control.
Whether you’re building a performance environment, sequencing beats, designing your own instruments or effect chains, or syncing up with external gear, Loopy Pro gives you the tools to build exactly what you need. And have fun doing it!
TRY IT FREE FOR 7 DAYS — no commitment, no signup, no subscription.
—————
CUSTOMIZE YOUR WORKFLOW
Loopy Pro is like musical Lego. You can add loops, one-shots, and buttons to the canvas along with customized sliders, dials, XY pads, clip slicers, encoders, grids, and more. You can use your iPad or iPhone stand-alone, or connect audio interfaces, MIDI controllers and external instruments. 
—————
LIVE LOOPING WITHOUT LIMITS
• Record with count-in/out or freely, with audio threshold, or retrospective capture
• Detect loops automatically — just play and it finds the loop
• Structure songs with Play Groups and transitions
• Layer overdubs with peel/replace
• Sync and quantize with groove and tempo control
• Automate anything: trigger scenes, send MIDI, control effects, or react to clip events
• Easily import audio to incorporate pre-recorded loops and samples, with studio-quality tempo and pitch controls
• Use the project sequencer timeline for arranging songs completely hands-free, with all kinds of options for song sectioning
—————
SEQUENCE MIDI & BUILD INSTRUMENTS
• Record and edit MIDI clips with built-in MIDI sequencer/piano roll editor
• Quantize with swing, randomness, or your own groove
• Trigger audio clips polyphonically and pitched
• Automate playback for hands-free performance
—————
MIX, ROUTE & CONTROL YOUR SETUP
• Full-featured mixer with inserts, sends, buses, and effect chains — perfect for deep sound design
• Host AUv3 instruments, effects, and MIDI processors
• Dock plugin windows for a clean workspace
• Multitrack session recording with isolated stems
—————
CONNECT WITH GEAR
• Send/receive MIDI, sync clock, change patches
• Use multi-channel audio interfaces
• Route click track to your ears, loops to the PA
• Control pedals, synths, other apps or hardware
• Extensive MIDI controller support, including built-in support for the Launchpad, the APC Mini Mk2, APC Key 25 Mk2, APC40 Mk2, and the MIDI Fighter Twister, and effortless MIDI Learn for setting up your controllers.
—————
USED BY MUSICIANS AT THE FRONTIER
Loopy Pro is used on stages and in studios around the world by artists pushing the boundaries of live looping and performance. It’s more than an app — it’s a platform for musical invention.
—————
PRICING
Loopy Pro uses a classic pay-once model:
• 7-Day Free Trial – No commitment.
• One-time purchase – Keep forever. Includes all features released for the following 12 months.
• Optional upgrades – Buy additional 12-month feature updates any time. You keep everything you pay for.

MIX, ROUTE & CONTROL YOUR SETUP

—————

—————

USED BY MUSICIANS AT THE FRONTIER

Loopy Pro is used on stages and in studios around the world by artists pushing the boundaries of live looping and performance. It’s more than an app — it’s a platform for musical invention.

PRICING

bluejetty:00147421:ios.name: Pocket Palette
bluejetty:00147421:ios.summary:
The perfect blue is everywhere: in a sunset, a paint chip, a stranger's jacket. Pocket Palette lets you capture it in seconds and build it into something.
It's a full-featured color studio that feels like a simple one. Every tool is one ta
bluejetty:00147421:ios.description:
The perfect blue is everywhere: in a sunset, a paint chip, a stranger's jacket. Pocket Palette lets you capture it in seconds and build it into something.
It's a full-featured color studio that feels like a simple one. Every tool is one tap away, nothing is buried in menus, and there's no learning curve standing between you and your palette. Open the app, and you already know how to use it.
From the world to your palette
Point your camera at anything: tile, fabric, foliage, that mural you pass every day. Pull the exact color straight into your palette, or eyedrop from any photo in your library. If you can see it, you can keep it.
Deep tools, zero clutter
Under the simple surface is a precise color editor. Work in Hex, RGB, HSB, or spin the HSB color wheel for intuitive hue control. Every color is fully editable, and undo keeps experimenting risk-free. Not sure what comes next? Pocket Palette suggests coordinating colors to round out your scheme.
Organized without effort
Group palettes into Collections by project, client, or mood. iCloud sync keeps everything current across your iPhone and iPad automatically—no account, no setup, no thinking about it.
Everywhere your work goes

Check your EBT balance instantly. Stay safe from EBT theft with top-tier security features. Find deals, jobs, benefit updates, and more ways to save money.
Propel is the #1 rated EBT app for checking your food stamp/SNAP balance.
Join the 5+ million people who trust Propel (formerly Providers, Fresh EBT) for a better way to manage their EBT, WIC, Social Security/SSI, and other benefits.
TRACK ALL YOUR BENEFITS IN ONE PLACE
Propel makes it easy to manage your benefits in one secure app:
- EBT
- WIC
- Child Tax Credit
- Cash benefits (TANF)
INSTANTLY SEE YOUR EBT BALANCE
Check your EBT and WIC balances and spending history instantly on your phone with the app. Save time and always know how much you have available.
SUPPORTED IN 53 STATES AND TERRITORIES
Propel (formerly Providers, Fresh EBT) supports EBT card programs in most states and territories, including SNAP, WIC, and Summer EBT. Check your EBT balance for Quest, ebtEDGE, ConnectEBT, California CalFresh, Texas Lone Star, Your Texas Benefits, Florida & Pennsylvania ACCESS cards, Illinois Link, Oregon Trail, and more. Coverage also includes DC, PR, USVI, and Guam.
PROTECT YOUR BENEFITS
Lock your card. Block fraudulent transactions outside of your home state. Monitor suspicious transactions. Prevent EBT theft before it happens with Propel’s exclusive EBT security features.*
STAY ON TOP OF YOUR BENEFITS
Get regular updates on any important changes to your food stamps (SNAP), Summer EBT, Disability, and other benefits in all states.
SAVE MONEY WITH EXCLUSIVE OFFERS
Get exclusive deals for EBT cardholders & weekly discounts to help you save money on your groceries, bills, and more.
FIND WORK THAT FITS YOUR SCHEDULE
Our job board offers local employment opportunities, from gigs to full-time employment.
–––––
Propel, Inc.
235 Duffield Street Suite 1700, Brooklyn NY 11201
Propel (formerly Providers, Fresh EBT) is a private company. We securely access your EBT account information with your permission via state EBT systems. We compile information about government benefits from public websites.

Card locking is currently available in AL, AK, AZ, CA, CO, DE, DC, FL, GA, GU (Guam), HI, ID, IL, KS, KY, MA, MD, ME, MI, MN, MO, MT, NE, NV, NH, NJ, NM, NY, NC, ND, OH, OK, OR, PA, RI, SC, SD, TN, UT, VT, VI (Virgin Islands), VA, WA, WV, WI, WY.

Online transaction blocking is currently available in AK, AZ, CA, CO, DC, FL, GU (Guam), HI, ID, IL, KS, KY, ME, MI, MN, MO, NE, NV, NH, NM, NY, NC, ND, OR, RI, SD, TN, VT, VI (Virgin Islands), WA, WV, WI, WY.
Suspicious transaction monitoring is currently available in AL, AZ, AR, CA, CO, CT, DE, FL, GA, GU (Guam), IL, IN, KS, KY, LA, MD, ME, MI, MS, NJ, NY, OH, OK, PA, PR (Puerto Rico), SC, TN, TX, UT, VA.

Learn more at https://www.propel.app/snap/propel-ebt-security-features/

- Auto Delete Screenshots: Say goodbye to cluttered photo galleries! ClearPico automatically identifies and deletes unnecessary screenshots, ensuring your gallery stays organized and optimized.
- Fast & Efficient: With our optimized design and seamless user experience, ClearPico makes cleaning up your phone faster, easier, and smoother than ever before.

- Smart Cleaning: ClearPico’s intelligent scanning algorithms ensure that only the right files are removed, keeping your phone in top shape without losing important data.

- User-Friendly: Whether you’re a tech pro or a casual user, ClearPico’s intuitive design ensures a smooth, easy experience.

bluejetty:00177797:ios.description:
Open personal (from age 14) or business bank account within 20 minutes with selfie in Hungarian
Prepare your ID card and address card – if you’re a business customer, also have your tax number ready.
1. Tap on "Become a customer" button
2. Select your account and card, and provide your contact info
3. Accept the terms
4. Take photos of your documents, scan the NFC chip of your ID card
5. Take a selfie and sign the contract with an SMS code
6. Log in with the provided code and start using your account
If you haven’t turned 18 yet, here’s what you need to do:
1. Ask your parents to start the application from their app
2. Follow these steps:
 * Click the "Become a customer" button
 * Select the option that matches your age
 * Accept the terms
 * Take photos of your documents, scan the NFC chip of your ID card
 * Take a selfie and sign the contract with an SMS code
3. Your parents will also need to sign the contract to complete the account opening
4. Log in with the provided code and start using your account
-----------
TRACK YOUR SPENDINGS
Want to get a clear overview of your finances?
We created a space in the app called Analytics, where you can quickly review your expenses. Thanks to automatic categorization – which you can modify – and grouping of expenses, you’ll soon know what and how much you spend.
-----------
FIND ALL YOUR PRODUCTS IN ONE PLACE
Whether it’s bank accounts, debit and credit cards, fixed deposits, or investments, you’ll find everything here in one place.
You can:
-share your account details with others 
-easily change card limits whenever you want 
-create term deposit, terminate or withdraw it 
-activate, suspend or unlock your cards
-check your overdraft limit
-set up recurring investments
-----------
YOU GET THINGS DONE WITH LESS EFFORT WITH THESE FUNCTIONS
-Login and authorize easily using TouchID or FaceID or PIN code 
-Make transfer even to email, mobile number, tax number or ID are liked to bank accounts. 
-Manage card and transaction limits 
-Pay-off your credit card 
-Apply for loans, overdraft, credit card
-You can view, create and delete existing Standing Orders. 
-You can manage Term Deposits. 
-You can view, create and delete Direct debits. 
-The items waiting for collection above the limit you set can be approved or rejected. 
-Get special offer to exchange currencies between own accounts. 
-Generate payment requests and send payment by scanning QR code. 
-Send and receive payment requests. 
-Authorize the internetbank login and transactions. 
-Approve online purchases in the mobile app.
-We send you a push notification about the task of the authorization.
-----------
TO REGISTER, YOU NEED:
-maintaining the account in Raiffeisen Bank Hungary 
-bank account or credit card in Raiffeisen Bank Hungary 
-internet banking service - valid credentials 
-a smartphone operating on iOS 16.0 or later
-----------
Following app functions are also available with joint signature: HUF, SEPA payments, transfer between own accounts, payments request.
Registration: download the app, log in with your internet banking credentials and activate Mobile Token by choose a PIN code. The Mobile token PIN code can be substituted with Touch ID or FaceID.
-----------
We use technology creatively to bring new things to life and make your daily banking experience even better. Stay tuned, we have more coming soon. If you like us, give us a rating! If we can improve it, let us know via email to info@raiffeisen.hu.

Have you ever needed to open a .zip file on your mobile device?
Wouldn't it be great if you could compress files on your phone into .zip files?

This mobile app is for UPMC Health Plan insurance members only. Not a member? Learn more at www.upmchealthplan.com.
The UPMC Health Plan mobile app puts your health insurance information in the palm of your hand. It offers convenient, on-the-go access to your health insurance benefits and wellness plans. Whether you need to chat with a Health Care Concierge about a benefit related question or forgot your member ID card for your doctor’s visit, this app has you covered.

- View member ID cards for you and your family, and email them to your provider directly from the app.
- Review current coverage and benefits for you and your family.
- Use live chat and secure messaging to connect with a Health Care Concierge.
- Check the status of your recent claims and review your claim details.
FIND CARE IN YOUR NETWORK
- Easily search for in-network providers and hospitals.
- Browse medical, dental, vision, and behavioral health providers and facilities.
- Filter results by proximity, view directions, and tap to call a provider or facility. 
WELLNESS CONNECTIONS
- Live chat with a health coach to set lifestyle goals or stay motivated.
- Track your steps with Apple Health app integration and check your Take a Healthy Step progress.
- Take the MyHealth Questionnaire to learn about your health, understand how to reduce your risks, and spend less on care.

Code de la Route & Permis 2026 est la référence pour réviser efficacement. Que tu passes le permis auto, le code moto ETM ou le permis bateau, tout est inclus pour t'assurer la réussite.
Conforme à la réforme 2026 et aux contenus officiels (Codes Rousseau et Officiel), c'est l'outil indispensable pour être prêt le jour J.

• Tout-en-un : Code auto, code moto ETM et permis bateau (côtier et fluvial) dans une seule app

• Séries d'entraînement : Accède à des milliers de questions types examen

At Corewell Health, we are making your experience better by making it easier. Introducing the Corewell Health App, bringing care to your fingertips whenever and wherever you need it.  
What Can You Expect from the Corewell Health App?  
Take Control of Your Health Journey with MyChart: Access your health records at your fingertips. Quickly retrieve medical information, seamlessly view health data from other institutions, request prescription refills, view any health test results, and effortlessly communicate with your healthcare provider.  
On-Demand Video Visits: Experience healthcare on your terms. Connect with Corewell Health providers within minutes through video visits, addressing a diverse range of health concerns, all from wherever you are.    
Seamless Scheduling: Effortlessly schedule, reschedule, or cancel video or in-person appointments with our diverse network of 1000+ providers across primary and specialty care.  
Streamlined Experience: Your time matters. Navigate our user-friendly interface to make the most of your precious moments. Utilize features including eCopay, Fast Pass and eCheckin, designed to streamline your experience so you can focus on what truly matters. Constant Innovation: The Corewell Health app is always thinking ahead. It evolves to anticipate and cater to present and future needs. Safety and Security: Your privacy is our commitment. Safeguarding your personal health information is our top priority. The Corewell Health app adheres to HIPPAA compliance standards and fortified with multiple layers of security, ensuring your data’s safety both online and offline.

bluejetty:00171632:ios.description:
Pack your bags kids, we are Flying to New York City and it is going to be so much fun! My City : New York is your chance to create your own story and adventure in the busiest city in the world. Visit Times Square just don’t get lost! Watch the amazing wizard of Oz broadway show and take a short trip to the Statue of Liberty. If you want to relax, make sure to visit Central Park where you can visit the hungry penguins, have a picnic or just hangout. Find out what makes this city one of the greatest cities in the world. The possibilities are endless. The fun never ends as you create your very own adventures!
Game features:
* Large game with 8 locations. NY fashion Store, Classic New York dinner restaurant, The statue of liberty and many many more
* 20 Characters you can move between our games, more games means more characters to play with!
*NEW! NY clothing collection so playing dress games has never been more fun
* New mini games, Fun puzzles and lots of hidden items to discover all around the My City : New York!
Over 100 million kids have played our games world wide!
Creative Games Kids Love to Play
Think of this game as a fully interactive dollhouse in which you can touch and interact with almost every object you see. With fun characters and highly detailed locations, kids can role-play by creating and playing out their own stories.
Easy enough for a 5-year old to play with, exciting enough for a 12-year old to enjoy!
- Play as you want, stress-free games, Extremely high playability.
- Kids Safe. No 3rd party Ads and IAP. Pay once and get free updates forever.
- Connects with other My City games: All My City games connect together allowing kids to share characters between our games.
More Games, More Story Options, More Fun.
Age group 4-12: 
Easy enough for 4 year olds to play and super exciting for 12 year to enjoy.
Play Together: 
We support multi touch so kids can play together with friends and family on the same screen!

* Some functions may
bluejetty:00060679:ios.description:
The simplest viewer app for viewing comic, fictional image archives
Such as a cartoon or a novel, on a smartphone
You can see it anywhere.
Now that you've installed the app
Try transferring files on your PC with WiFi
* Some functions may not be supported on Mac(Apple Silicon)
** Characteristic **
- zip, rar, 7z, cbz, cbr, cb7 compressed files are supported (png, jpeg, jpg, gif, bmp, tif, tiff, jxl(iOS 26+), heif(iOS 18+) extension images are included, webp format is supported from iOS14)
- Support for locked files (zip, rar, 7z, pdf)
- PDF file support
- TIF/TIFF file support (like PDF file, change in settings)
- Upload via PC web browser (WIFI)
- Import files from cloud apps such as iCloud, dropbox, circle drive, and Box 
- FTP support: browse, download
- SSHFTP support
- Secure FTP not supported
- Cloud apps support file copy from mail attachments
- one page view, two page view
- Sharpen image filter
- IPhone, iPad, Mac(Apple Silicon) support
- Rotate the screen both horizontally and vertically
- Image next page Zoom-in keep-alive function: Apply the previous book's zoom-in status in the following book. Please change your settings.
- Screen off option: When set to ON, the screen automatically turns off at the time the device turns off.
- Last file view, On / Off in setting
- Next book auto-switching options: If you automatically change the next book switching option in Settings, tabs on the last page will automatically switch to the next book. (Default manual)
- iCloud Sync : Synchronize the information (read location) of the read file and open the same file on another device (signed in with the same iCloud account) so that you can see it again.
- Two pages in landscape mode: Two pages in landscape rotation, one page in vertical rotation, iPad only
-Vertical scroll mode (= webtoon mode): scrolls vertically like webtoons, one-page mode is fixed, and some options are fixed and not applied. 
- Image / PDF Night mode: Invert color / Image brightness (1 to 3 steps), in-app purchase required
- Night Mode - Invert Color: Invert the white background to black (gray) and black to white. This mode is suitable for viewing novels.
- Night Mode - Image Brightness: You can change the brightness of the image in three steps without changing the screen brightness of the device.
- Bluetooth keyboard: Supports page switching and screen closing function, direction key (asdw) page switch, ESC key viewer screen close (in-app purchase required)
- A function that changes to the next page when the volume is changed. (The sound size will change as well. Please be careful. ON / OFF in setting. Need an in-app purchase or reward view.)
- Blink: Recognizes eye blinks to switch pages (iPhone only, iOS 18+, in-app purchase required)
- Automatic Image Crop: Automatically crops the empty space on all four sides of images with a white background. (iOS 16+, in-app purchase required)
- Content Color: You can change and unify the content (pictures or text) within the image to a single color. A background color is applied to the image background excluding the content (In-app purchase required)
- Select text: Long-click to select text within a page and copy, search, translate, or share (iOS 18+, in-app purchase required)
Please send bugs or suggestions to junhuloveapple@gmail.com at the top right of the setting screen.

bluejetty:00016243:ios.description:
Cross DJ Pro is the perfect app to mix and perform DJ sets on the go!
MIX AND PERFORM LIVE
• Start your mix with the essential 2-deck DJ setup
• Easily import and sort your music library by title, artist, album, BPM or length
• Shape and resample your sound in real-time with Pro-grade FXs 
• Play with over 70 one-shot samples and 12 loops 
• Access your Soundcloud library to mix all the latest bangers
• Synchronize your tracks with the most accurate Waveform view
• Customize your setup with the color of your choice
• Set the view to portrait mode for easier access while on the go
• Record your mix & share it with the world! (Soundcloud etc.) 
OUTSTANDING AUDIO ENGINE 
• Import any audio file (MP3, AAC, FLAC, WAV & AIFF)
• Accurate BPM detection of your music, down to the last decimal
• Insanely low latency, the music reacts instantly to your actions
• Realistic turntable scratch sounds
• Change the BPM without affecting the tone with Keylock mode 
• Detect the key of the songs to know which tracks sound good together
• Automatically equalize the levels of 2 tracks with Auto-gain
• Sync the two tracks in the player with Auto-sync
• Control EQs and crossfader with external hardware mixers
• Multichannel audio for USB compliant multichannel sound cards
ENJOY ADVANCED PRO-GRADE FEATURES!
• Record and play your own samples
• A full-fledged 3-band mixer with DJM EQ preset 
• Launch Loops from 8 to 1/32 
• Hot cues & loops are automatically set on the beat with Quantize mode
• Keep the same tempo while looping with Slip Mode 
• Customizable, manual pitch range (4 to 100%) and manual pitch bend
• Pre-listen to tracks in your headphones before mixing them with Split audio
• Cross DJ can mix your tracks & play music automatically, from any source with Automix (playlist, album, etc.)
• Go live with your friends through Ableton Link
• Compatible MIDI controllers: Pioneer DDJ-WeGO1&2t, Mixvibes U-Mix Control Pro I & II, Numark Mixtrack Pro I & II, Numark iDJ Live I & II, Hercules DJ Console RMX 2, Hercules DJ Control Instinct, Hercules DJ Control AIR, Vestax Spin2
***Due to copyright reasons, recording mixes with streamed tracks from SoundCloud is not possible.

"Beautiful design & faster performance" - DJ TechTools
"Clean, simple & professional look & feel" - Best-dj-software.com

Experience the thrill of flying with Aeroplan Pilot 3D the ultimate flight simulator
Step into the cockpit and bring your dream of becoming a pilot to life with Aeroplan Pilot 3D a realistic and engaging flight simulation game designed for aviation lovers and flight enthusiasts of all ages. Wide selection of planes to choose from
Realistic flight mechanics and controls
Detailed city environments and airports
Engaging pilot career mode with progressive challenges
Smooth gameplay optimized for mobile devices
Dynamic missions that keep you engaged
Download Aeroplan Pilot 3D and enjoy one of the most complete and immersive flight simulator experiences available today

bluejetty:00135177:ios.description:

The app is free to download, but you need to be a Daily Liberal digital subscriber to read articles. Features include:
- Access to breaking news updates 24 hours-a-day
- Browse the latest articles in the topics that interest you most
- Save articles to read later
- Alerts for breaking news and big stories
- Read a digital replica of the day's newspaper
- Play our daily interactive puzzles

bluejetty:00031284:ios.description:
Bushnell Golf has defined precision in golf for decades. Now, that same trusted technology lives in your pocket.
The Bushnell Golf app is two powerful tools in one.
As a 3D GPS golf app, it gives you accurate distances, smart course management, and shot planning tools across more than 40,000 courses worldwide - so you can play smarter on every round.
As the home for your Bushnell Golf devices, it lets you register your devices, connect via Bluetooth, and unlock enhanced performance features that take your game to the next level. 
Trusted Technology. Smarter Devices. Lower Scores. Download Today. 
FREE - START PLAYING SMARTER TODAY
GPS access to more than 40,000 golf courses worldwide. Accurate front, center and back distances to the green you can trust on every hole, at every course, anywhere in the world.
Shot planning with movable layup points lets you map out every tee shot and approach before you pull a club. Track and store your rounds and statistics to start building a picture of your game over time. Plus, wireless course updates keep your Bushnell GPS devices current automatically.
BUSHNELL GOLF PLUS - WHERE GOOD ROUNDS BECOME GREAT
KEY FEATURES:
 • 3D VIRTUAL REALITY VIEW: Experience fully immersive 3D virtual holes. Explore every course from tee to green, study elevation changes from any angle, and visualize your shots before you ever step to the tee.
 • 3D HOLE FLYOVER: A cinematic, real-time preview of every hole using your actual club distances. Watch your ball flight play out before you swing. Identify your landing zone. Execute with total confidence.
 • GPS DISTANCES WITH SLOPE: Tap anywhere on the course for instant yardages, automatically adjusted for elevation change. Play the true distance. Pick the right club. 
 • APPROACH HEAT MAPS: Color-coded green maps reveal slopes and speeds so you always know the ideal place to land your approach. 
 • CLUB LANDING ZONE: Overlay your personal club distances directly onto the hole. See exactly where your ball will land, visualize your shot shape, and avoid hazards before you swing.
 • PUTT BREAKS: Instantly see the precise break of every putt from anywhere on the green. Trust your line. Putt with confidence. Sink your putt.
 • DAILY PIN POSITION: Tap the flag to set the exact hole location. Always know the true distance to the pin.
 • SHOT TRACKING: Record every shot from tee to green and build an accurate, data-driven profile of how far you actually hit each club. No more overestimating. No more coming up short.
 • SCORES & STATS: Pro-level performance tracking. Monitor your improvement after each round so you always know exactly what to work on next.
SUPPORT 
Questions about features, feedback, report technical issues, or don't see your course in our database? We want to hear from you. Visit https://www.bushnellgolf.com/contact/ to contact our team. 
Learn more about Bushnell Golf products and how they work with the app at bushnellgolf.com
PAYMENT INFORMATION
The Bushnell Golf app offers a free membership along with two Plus memberships: $8.33/month, billed annually or $19.99/month, billed monthly.
Payment will be charged to your iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase. Subscriptions automatically renew at the same rate within 24 hours prior to the end of the current billing period. Manage your subscription and turn off auto-renewal at any time in your iTunes Account Settings after purchase.
TERMS OF SERVICE: https://www.revelyst.com/termsconditions.html

bluejetty:00065748:ios.description:
Yelp has over 199 million reviews of businesses worldwide. Whether you’re looking for a new pizza place to try, a great coffee shop nearby, or need to book a haircut, Yelp is your local guide for finding the perfect place to eat, shop, drink, explore, and relax. The Yelp app is available for iPhone, iPad, and Apple Watch.
Yelp features:
Food Near You - Find Restaurants
• Find the newest and hottest restaurants in your area
• Make reservations, order delivery or pickup—all from your phone
• Filter restaurant search results by price, location, open now, and more
Search for Nearby Businesses, Services, & Professionals
• Discover great local businesses, from hair salons to trusted doctors and movers
• Read millions of reviews by the Yelp community
• Home need repairs? Find the best rated contractors and handymen
• Find great deals offered by local businesses, get quotes instantly, and book appointments
Beauty - Pamper Yourself 
• Find highly-rated salons, spas, massage therapists, and more
• Book appointments through Yelp at the most relaxing staycation destinations
Search Filters 
• Filter your search results by neighborhood, distance, rating, price, and hours of operation
• Look up addresses and phone numbers, call a business, or make reservations directly from the app
Other Features
• Read expert user reviews and browse through beautiful photos of each business
• Write and read reviews, check-in to local businesses, upload photos and add tips for other Yelp users
Find local restaurants, read expert customer reviews, and start searching for businesses near you with Yelp. 
Need Help? Contact Yelp at https://www.yelp.com/support
Note: Continued use of GPS running can dramatically decrease battery life.

bluejetty:00026685:ios.description:
Welcome to the Macy’s app, the most iconic shopping destination. Find exactly what you need for the occasions that matter most. Shop fashion, beauty, accessories, home, gifts, and more. Explore brands like Calvin Klein, Michael Kors, Ralph Lauren, and more. Easily earn shopping rewards with every purchase, and unlock free shipping, birthday perks, and extra earning potential with Macy’s Star Rewards memberships. The Macy’s app is designed to make shopping and savings easier with flash sales and seasonal discounts on men’s and women’s clothing. 
Save money on every purchase and make shopping more rewarding by unlocking everyday discounts and exclusive rewards right at your fingertips. Find women’s clothing inspiration, beauty services, wedding and gift registries, and exclusive Macy’s brands right in the palm of your hand. 
Macy’s is more than just a clothing store; we’re also the home of larger-than-life celebrations – from the Fourth of July Fireworks to the Thanksgiving Day Parade – that bring us all together. Download the Macy’s app today to experience the magic of Macy’s for yourself. 
MACY’S SHOPPING APP FEATURES: 
SHOP CLOTHING & ACCESSORIES 
- From women’s clothing and beauty to jewelry, seasonal must-haves, and men’s shoes and clothes–find everything in one place. 
- Shop handbags, furniture, mattresses, kids' clothing, gifts, electronics, and more. 
- Macy’s Pay- Enjoy faster, contactless checkout with your coupons and rewards applied instantly with Macy’s Pay. 
- Macy’s Wallet – keep all your offers, gift cards, and coupons in one place! 
REWARDS FOR SHOPPING & LOYALTY 
- Star Rewards- Platinum & Gold members get free shipping, no minimum when you shop at Macy’s with a Macy’s Card. 
- Our clothing store app allows you to track your Star Rewards balance, earn Star Money, and unlock bonus events and early access to sales. 
- Earn shopping rewards points on every purchase (1,000 points = $10 Star Money). 
- Move through Silver, Gold, and Platinum for higher earning rates (1–5 points per $1). 
- Enjoy birthday perks and exclusive shopping rewards, with extra earning potential through a Macy’s credit card or standard membership.

Abs Workout A6W is a proven abs training plan and one of the most popular six pack workout apps worldwide. Unlike random fitness routines, this structured workout plan focuses on progressive intensity to engage all your abdominal muscles and build a strong core.
WHAT IS THE A6W ABS WORKOUT PLAN?
The Aerobic Weider Six (A6W) is a 6-week abs workout designed for maximum results. It consists of 6 daily abs workout exercises that you perform for 42 days. This bodyweight workout is the gold standard for core training because it doesn't require a gym – it is a pure home workout for abs. Our app acts as your digital trainer, guiding you through every step of this legendary fitness routine.
WHY CHOOSE OUR ABS TRAINING FOR A SIX PACK?
• Proven Effectiveness: Use an abs training plan recognized globally for its fast results in defining the midsection.
• Focus on Results: It is a six pack workout system designed to burn fat, strengthen core muscles, and support a flat stomach.
• No Equipment Abs Workout: All exercises are designed for the floor and use only bodyweight. No weights or expensive gym memberships are needed for this home workout.
• Track Your Transformation: Use the built-in workout schedule and diary to monitor your weight and waist circumference. Add photos to see your six pack abs becoming a reality.
• Step-by-Step Guidance: Each exercise includes detailed descriptions and graphic instructions. Proper technique is key to your fitness routine success.

bluejetty:00017906:ios.name: Flatastic: Household Chores
bluejetty:00017906:ios.summary: Flatastic turns household chores into a simple shared routine. Whether you live with roommates, your partner, or your family, the app brings your chore chart, grocery list, bill tracker, and household notes together in one place. No more ar
bluejetty:00017906:ios.description:
Flatastic turns household chores into a simple shared routine. Whether you live with roommates, your partner, or your family, the app brings your chore chart, grocery list, bill tracker, and household notes together in one place. No more arguments about who did what.
A Chore Chart Everyone Can See
Flatastic gives your home a clear chore list that updates for everyone at once. Assign chores, set how often each one repeats, and let the app handle the chore rotation so the workload stays fair. Automatic chore reminders nudge each person when their turn comes around, so nothing gets forgotten and nobody has to play the nag.
Weekly chores, daily chores, one time tasks, the monthly deep clean. Build the chore schedule that matches how your household actually lives.
Chore Tracker for Families
Parents use Flatastic as a kids chore chart that works without printouts or stickers falling off the fridge. Kids see their own chores, check them off, and everyone can follow along. Splitting family chores stops being a daily conversation and becomes something the app keeps track of.
Chore List for Roommates
Shared flats run on fairness. Flatastic shows exactly which household chores were done, by whom, and when. The chore tracker keeps a running record so cleaning duties stay balanced between roommates over time.
Shared Grocery List
Avoid double purchases and last minute runs to the store. The synchronized grocery list keeps everyone informed about what is needed at home, with live updates as items get added and ticked off.
Bill Tracker for Transparent Finances
Track shared expenses without spreadsheets. The built in bill organizer records who paid for what and what each person still owes. Simple, transparent, and quick to settle.
Pinboard for Household Communication
Share notes, reminders, and upcoming plans in one shared space. Useful for everything that does not fit on the chore list but still needs to reach everyone at home.
Why Flatastic?
Built specifically for shared living, Flatastic combines chore management, grocery planning, and expense tracking in one app. Your household chores stay organized whether you are at home, at work, or on the go.
More Features:
Offline access, so you can manage chores without an internet connection
Simple and intuitive design for roommates, couples, and families
A customizable chore planner that adapts to your household
Who is Flatastic for?
Roommates: a clear chore schedule that prevents conflicts before they start
Families: organize household chores and groceries as a team
Couples: share chores, bills, and responsibilities without keeping score in your head
Download Flatastic Now!
Make chores the easiest part of your week. Download Flatastic and see how simple home organization can be.
For more information, visit:
www.flatastic-app.com
Follow us on Facebook:
www.facebook.com/flatastic
Need support? Contact us at:
support@flatastic-app.com

bluejetty:00073214:ios.description:
Connect with your loved ones and make new friends with heartfelt communication using Lettre: a handwriting-based PenPal / Social iOS-exclusive app. Lettre lets you enjoy the charm of handwriting letters in a digital format. Truly connect with the sincerest communication medium of all time.

— Write & Send Handwritten Letters. Share deep thoughts, silly drawings, epic poems, or just your day with other members of the Lettre community. Send genuine letters to any email address. Get honest, get personal.
— No bots. No generative AI.
— Find Global Pen Pals! Make authentic, meaningful friendships based on long-form writing, drawing. Use your creativity to start an in-joke with a new bestie. Meet the you from across the world.
— Collect Unique Digital Stamps. Lettre supports our favorite independent artists from all of the places our letters go. Become a digital philatelist; and use the word philately in your letters.

Lettre encourages a slower, more meaningful way to communicate. Enjoy the ancient and modern art of reading and writing*

bluejetty:00061979:ios.name: Australian Citizenship Test(s)
bluejetty:00061979:ios.summary: After you finished reading the official document: Australian Citizenship: Our Common Bond (located here: https://www.homeaffairs.gov.au/Citizenship/Documents/our-common-bond.PDF). You can download this app to test your knowledge on the citi
bluejetty:00061979:ios.description:
After you finished reading the official document: Australian Citizenship: Our Common Bond (located here: https://www.homeaffairs.gov.au/Citizenship/Documents/our-common-bond.PDF). You can download this app to test your knowledge on the citizenship test questions.
Some quick background information about the Australian Citizenship Test.
There are two sections in the full document (Australian Citizenship: Our Common Bond).
One section is the "Testable section" which all the questions in the citizenship test are based on the information contained in this testable section. This is the information you will be tested on.
Part 1—Australia and its people
Part 2—Australia's democratic beliefs, rights and liberties
Part 3—Government and the law in Australia
Glossary
You will be tested with 20 questions, and you will need to answer 15 out 20 questions correctly or get a 75% to pass test.
The other section is the "Non-testable section" which this non-testable section contains information that will help you to understand the history and culture of Australia. You will not be tested on this information.
Part 4—Australia today
Part 5—Our Australian story
Glossary and Acknowledgements
Our app features:
-TEST mode - this mode simulates the actual exam which randomly chooses 20 questions from the question bank.
-STARRED mode - this mode allows you to favorite or save the questions that you have difficulty with.
- PERFECT mode - this mode helps you master all the questions and answers. The questions that you've answered wrong will keep coming back at you until you have perfected the questions and answers in the question set.
-LISTEN mode - this mode automatically plays all the questions and answers audio sounds without touching your phone.
Keywords: Australian Citizenship Test, Civics Test, Our Common Bond, Testable Section, pass, practice, free, Australia, Australian Citizenship Test 2026

bluejetty:00017394:ios.summary:

 please select or add "VRPlayer Helper" i
bluejetty:00017394:ios.description:
● VRPlayer can record screen/audio of your desktop and streaming it to VRPlayer via VRPlayer Helper.
 - to use this feature "VRPlayer Helper" should be installed and executed on your desktop. 
 please select or add "VRPlayer Helper" item on vrplayer app and follow instruction first.
 - this feature is experimental for now.
 so there might be considerable amount of latency and unstability depends on network environment and system spec where helper is running
● VRPlayer can play not only general 2D movies but also 3D movies (half side by side or over and under) for VR (google cardboard)
● and support the following file formats.
- video : mp4, mov, m4v, mkv, avi, wmv, asf, flv, swf, mpg, 3gp, vob, divix
- subtitle : smi, srt
● VRPlayer can play following file formats by real time streaming via VRPlayer Helper
- Video : mp4, mov, m4v, mkv, avi, wmv, asf, flv, swf, mpg, 3gp, vob, divix
- Subtitle : smi, srt
※ this app can not play DRM protected videos purchased from iTunes store.
● You can add or access following items
- VRPlayer Helper (streaming server)
- Folder
- SMB/SFTP/FTP Server
- Dropbox
- Video Library
※ VRPlayer Helper is embedded in your own VRPlayer app and the download URL provided by VRPlayer is your own iPhone's IP address itself not an external web server.
so iPhone and the server PC should be in the same wifi network to download Helper.
tap the "+"button at top right corner of VRPlayer and select VRPlayer Helper then you will see the URL from which you can download helper.
● You can control VRPlayer with keyboard
 - Bluetooth Keyboard
 - USB Keyboard (connected by camera kit)
 - Keyboard of PC on which VRPlayer Helper is installed
※ while navigating
 - up / down : move cursor by item
 - up / down + shift : move cursor by page
 - right / enter / space : select item
 - left / esc : back to previous
※ while playing
 - up / down : move cursor by button
 - enter : select button & do action
 - esc : stop & back to list
 - space : play & pause
 - right : move forward 5 seconds
 - left : move backward 5 seconds
 - right + shift : move forward 1 minute
 - left + shift : move backward 1 minute
 - up + shift : play previous video
 - down + shift : play next video
 - [ : slow down the playback rate
 - ] : speed up the playback rate
 - 1 : Toggle 360°/180° Video
 - 2 : Toggle VR Mode
 - 3 : Change 2D/3D Mode
 - 4 : Zoom In/Out
 - 5 : Back To Center / Motion Tracking
 - 6 : Motion Tracking Constraint
 - 7 : Loop
 - 8 : Audio/Subtitle
● You can control VRPlayer with Game Controller
 ※ supported controller
 - XBox controller
 - Playstation Dualshock controller
 - Other MFi certified game controller
 ※ while navigating
 - up / down : move cursor by item
 - up / down + RB : move cursor by page
 - right / A : select item
 - left / B : back to previous
 ※ while playing
 - up / down : move cursor by button
 - A : select button & do action
 - B : stop & back to list
 - X : play & pause
 - right : move forward 5 seconds
 - left : move backward 5 seconds
 - right + RB : move forward 1 minute
 - left + RB : move backward 1 minute
 - up + RB : play previous video
 - down + RB : play next video
● support panorama photo
 - enjoy your own panorama photos in VR
● Use multiple gestures to control playing 
- Tap the screen with two fingers to change 2D/3D screen mode. 
- Double tap the screen to zoom in/out. 
- Swipe right to skip forward 5 seconds. 
- Swipe left to skip back 5 seconds. 
- Swipe right with two fingers to speed up the playback rate. 
- Swipe left with two fingers to slow down the playback rate. 
- Long press with one finger to select audio or subtitle. 
- Drag & drop subtitle to change position. 
- Pinch in or out screen to change font size of subtitle.

bluejetty:00131765:ios.summary:
Welcome to BowlSheet®! A revolutionary bowling scoring / tracking system for iOS devices
* Supports single player AND multiplayer games (team)
* First iOS bowling app to support the baker scoring system
* Now supports opponent score (match
bluejetty:00131765:ios.description:
Welcome to BowlSheet®! A revolutionary bowling scoring / tracking system for iOS devices
* Supports single player AND multiplayer games (team)
* First iOS bowling app to support the baker scoring system
* Now supports opponent score (match play)
* Bowling ball speed calculator built in (mph / kph)
* Check averages and stats from directly in the app
* Post stats, oil pattern markups and ball drilling specs directly to Facebook, Twitter, or *email with .csv file
* Automatically calculates splits / common leaves and displays their common name
* Pin by Pin, Ball for Ball scoring
* Keep track of everything important in bowling
* Easily slide your foot (Approach), Arrow, or BreakPoint Targets for each ball thrown and store the actual hits as well as attempted hits
* Store and use different types of oil patterns as well as mark them up and send to others via email
* Customizable color scheme for entire app
* Store High, Middle, or Low pocket hits for each 1st ball of each frame thrown
* Analyze games in their entirety
* Keep track of every bowler and their equipment (balls, shoes, wrist supports, and other)
* Store bowling ball surfaces and other important equipment options as well as use your own bowling ball image for target sliders
* Track bowlers hand layout (span, finger sizes, pitch) and bowling ball layout (Pin / Pap / Dual Angle Layouts)
* Store each bowling ball’s drilling and pin layouts
* Track which shoe slide (front and back) you used at different bowling centers and even each shot
* Take notes for each ball rolled
* Store important aspects of each location / event bowled including addresses, phone numbers, coordinator's contact information, you can even take a photo of each location and view the location on a map as well as auto locate via GPS
* View common statistics for each bowler as well as their pin hit / miss ratios and percentages
* Easily view series totals for each event
* Bowl as a single bowler, team or as a Baker Team (bowler 1 thru 5 is assigned automatically to each frame 1-5,6-10).
* Change team lineup prior to every Team Game
* Filterable statistics for :First Ball average, Strikes, Spares, Splits, Pocket Shots, Open Frames, Split Conversions, Pinfall and more! 
Please send comments/suggestions to support@edibu.com
Follow updates on Twitter @ https://twitter.com/edibullc
Or visit our Facebook page @ https://www.facebook.com/EdibuLLC/
* CSV Statistics Export requires subscription after 1 year from date of app purchase.

bluejetty:00017968:ios.description:
Goodbudget is a personal finance app perfect for budget planning, debt tracking, and money management. Share your budget and data across multiple phones (and the web!).
MANAGE MONEY WITH PEOPLE YOU LOVE
Goodbudget is perfect for sharing a budget with a spouse, family member, or friend because your budget is backed up. Share your budget across multiple devices including iPhones, other smartphones, and the web.
* Transactions get backed up to the cloud and are accessible from other devices, including Goodbudget's web app!
* Stay on the same page about finances with those close to you
* Your data is automatically and securely backed up to Goodbudget's website
* Download transactions to CSV (on website)
INSIGHTFUL REPORTS
Goodbudget helps you make sense of your budgeting and spending with in-app reports.
* Know how to modify your budget after analyzing reports
* Spending by envelope report (cool-looking pie chart!)
* Income vs spending report
* Debt progress report (track your payoff!)
* Even more reports on the web
A PROVEN SYSTEM
Goodbudget is based on the envelope budgeting method. But with no physical envelopes...only virtual envelopes!
* Check envelopes balances (aka how much you have left to spend) while you're on-the-go
* Add transactions and track expenses easily on the go
* Use the proven cash envelope budgeting method
* Track your bank balances in addition to envelope balances
* Pay off debt and manage payments
* Live within your means
* Schedule transactions and automatically fill envelopes
Ad-free, Free Forever version includes 10 regular envelopes & 10 annual envelopes. Use envelope budgeting to plan your spending, not just track it!
================================
SUBSCRIBERS GET MORE FEATURES!
================================
* Unlimited Envelopes AND Accounts
* Automatic Bank Sync
* 5 devices for sharing 
* 7 years of transaction history
* Personal and friendly email support
Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period. Payment will be charged to iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase. Account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period, and identify the cost of the renewal. Subscriptions may be managed by the user and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user's Account Settings after purchase.
If you're looking to track where your money goes, plan your spending, or create a budget that works, try us out!
Goodbudget: Budget well. Live life. Do Good.
Features, bugs? Please email us at support@goodbudget.com! We're happy to help!
** Leading personal finance app downloaded over 2,000,000 times AND previously featured by Apple, The New York Times, Forbes, CNET, LifeTime TV, The Boston Globe, and Lifehacker **

bluejetty:00160564:ios.description:
Join 60,000+ people building their own board of AI advisors — specialists who remember you, connect the dots across your life, and help you think clearly.
Most AI forgets you the moment you close it. Kin remembers. It builds a private, lasting picture of who you are — your goals, habits, energy, relationships and patterns — so every conversation and every day builds on the last.
BUILD YOUR OWN BOARD
Choose your specialists across work, body and energy, relationships, mind and meaning, social confidence and more. Add the advisors who fit your life, swap them anytime — and they all share one memory of you, so you never start from scratch.
DAILY EDGE
Wake up to a personal briefing built from your day and your connected data, read to you by an advisor you choose. Start every morning clear on what matters.
ASK ANYTHING
Tired and don't know why? Stuck on a decision? Kin connects the dots across your sleep, habits and history to surface answers you couldn't see yourself.
A JOURNAL THAT ANSWERS
Write it down and get more than a blank page. Talk through an entry with the right advisor, spot patterns, and actually understand yourself.
REMEMBERS EVERYONE
Kin keeps track of the people in your life — who matters and what's going on — so you show up better in every conversation and relationship.
PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Your life stays yours. Kin runs on zero-access architecture with on-device memory and a biometric lock. Your data is private and is never used to train anyone else's AI.
WHY PEOPLE CHOOSE KIN
- A board, not a bot: specialists with different expertise, one shared memory
- Built on memory: key details remembered, and editable by you
- Connects the dots across your whole life — work, health, relationships, energy, growth
- Fast capture: voice notes, quick entries, searchable history
- Private by design: on-device memory, biometric lock, zero-access
WHAT YOU CAN DO WITH KIN
- Start your day with Daily Edge, a briefing made just for you
- Plan around clear priorities with calendar-aware prompts
- Prep for tough conversations and debrief afterwards
- Keep energy steady with check-ins and recovery nudges
- Journal with AI guidance that feeds your memory automatically
- Talk or type — switch anytime
Whether you're building a company, navigating your career, or just living with more clarity, Kin is the personal AI that actually knows you.
Download Kin and start building your board today.

Find and spot the differences. Train your brain & improve concentration!
Enjoy the Find the Differences game with tons of beautiful pictures and over 20,000 different challenging levels! Spot all the differences between the two pictures with no time limit. Train your brain, improve your concentration, and test your detective skills. 
Find the Differences is a classic relaxing game around the world. It's simple and intuitive: search and spot all the differences you can find in two pictures. How fast can you solve the puzzles? It might be tricky at first, but with this wonderful brain-training game, you can become an amazing detective. It's suitable for both kids and adults to sharpen the mind and relieve stress. Download today and give it a try!
How to Play
- Inspect two almost identical pictures with patience.
- Each time you find a difference, tap on the screen.
- Use unlimited hints when you are stuck.
- Zoom in or out on pictures to find differences more easily.
- Congratulations! You completed the challenge. Let's move to the next level!
Key Features
- Tons of beautiful HD pictures: nature, animals, food, architecture and more.
- Different levels of challenges. Relax, relieve stress, and train your brain. 
- Simple and intuitive design. As easy as playing puzzles on the paper.
- Unlimited hints. Help you solve all the puzzles within the time limit.
- Zoom in or out. It would be easier for you to find and spot differences.
- Play offline. Enjoy the game anywhere and anytime.
Relax with Find the Differences and improve your patience, concentration, and detective skills. It's so amazing that won't let you stop playing!
Are you ready for the challenges? Download now and play Find the Differences. It's the best brain exercise for you!

bluejetty:00174898:ios.description:
This application is designed to provide up to date information about bush fire data in New South Wales, Australia.
It utilises data from the NSW Rural Fire Service RSS feeds on fires with your current location provided by the iPhone GPS.
Using this information the application is able to provide a list of fires showing the nearest ones first, helping you to understand your current situation.
The information is reliant on both the accuracy of the iPhone GPS and the data recorded on the RFS's website. 
This application does not cache any data, so Internet access (either Wireless. 3G or GPRS) is required to access the data. 
Be aware that while P4G has utilised "best efforts" to provide this information to you, it is not intended to replace other sources of information on the fire situation near you. Also remember that fire and weather can change quickly.
All data is provided Copyright from the NSW Rural Fire Service.

bluejetty:00022209:ios.description:
Available in English, Portuguese, Spanish and Italian languages, this app makes it possible to contemplate the mysteries of the Holy Rosary through the visualization of artworks of great artists of history. There are more than 200 images about the mysteries of Christ's life that help to pray and meditate on the moment related to each mystery.
The images have always been widely used by the church as a catechesis tool for the people. With them, the sacred writings take shape allowing anyone to understand the infinite love of God.
With this app it is possible to meditate through many images of the same mystery, allowing to observe the same moment of different perspectives, with different details emphasized by the artist and his experience with the Word of God.
We hope this app also be a rescue of the sacred art, so rich and so abundant in the history of the Catholic Church.

bluejetty:00144024:ios.description:
A tarot app that remembers what you drew, and teaches you why it mattered.
Free every day: your card, one full reading and four card meanings. No account, no sign up, no ads.
Most tarot apps hand you an answer and forget you. This one keeps the record. Draw a card in the morning, write what it meant to you, and come back in a month to a journal that shows how your reading has changed.
WHAT IS DIFFERENT HERE
A journal, not a feed. Every reading you save keeps its cards, its positions and your own notes. It lives on your phone. Nothing is uploaded and nothing needs an account.
A real learning path. Twelve courses and 65 chapters, from your first Major Arcana card to reading a full Celtic Cross. Two quiz modes check what stuck, and a streak counter keeps you honest.
Every card follows the classic 1909 deck drawn by Pamela Colman Smith, with meanings from A. E. Waite's Pictorial Key to the Tarot.
Works with no signal. All 78 cards, all courses and every meaning are already on your phone. Airplane mode, the underground, a cabin with no bars: it all works.
WHAT YOU GET
- 78 cards, Major and Minor Arcana, with upright and reversed meanings
- Meanings by topic: love, career, money, health, spirituality, and yes or no
- 15 spreads: Card of the Day, Yes or No, Past Present Future, the Crossroads, New Love, Relationship, Career, Prosperity, Wellbeing, Celtic Cross, Year Ahead, Tree of Life and more
- 12 courses, 65 chapters, progress saved chapter by chapter
- Two quizzes: name the card from its keywords, and the keywords from its card
- A private journal, with your own note on every saved reading
- Three home screen widgets: card of the day, your streak, and a daily fact
- Reversed cards are on by default, and one switch in Settings turns them off
- 13 languages: English, German, Spanish, French, Italian, Portuguese, Polish, Romanian, Dutch, Norwegian, Russian, Ukrainian and Vietnamese
- No ads. Ever.
FREE AND PRO
Free covers a daily habit: the card of the day, one full reading a day, four card meanings a day, and the beginner's course.
Pro lifts the daily limits and opens all 12 courses, every topic meaning on every card, and your saved reading journal. Pro comes as a subscription or a one-time purchase. Cancel a subscription any time in your Apple settings.
WHO IT IS FOR
Beginners who want the cards explained in plain language and a path through them. Readers who already know the deck and want somewhere to keep their spreads. Anyone using tarot as a five minute daily reflection rather than a prediction.
Start with today's card. The rest follows.
Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://ivorytarot.com/privacy-policy/

bluejetty:00035661:ios.description:
bCard is the ultimate digital business card app for effortlessly creating, customizing, and sharing your professional contact information.
Whether you'rea a business professional, entrepreneur, freelancer, or realtor, bCard makes networking simple, efficient, and productive.
Why bCard?
• Unlimited Sharing: Create unlimited personalized digital business cards and share them anywhere, anytime. Perfect for meetings, events, or conferences—your card is always with you.
• Apple Wallet Integration: Add your digital business card directly to your Apple Wallet. Access your contact details instantly with just a tap.
• QR Code Sharing: Quickly share your contact details through unique QR codes. Display your QR code to others or send it via WhatsApp, iMessage, email, and more.
• Email Notifications: Receive an email with the contact details whenever someone scans your QR code, even if they don’t have the bCard app installed.
• AI Scanner: Easily scan physical business cards, email signatures, documents, printed materials, or digital screens to automatically create digital contacts. The AI scanner accurately extracts and imports contact information directly into your app.
• Multiple Cards for Different Contexts: Design various digital business cards tailored for clients, partners, colleagues, or specific networking scenarios.
• Customizable Fields: Personalize your digital business cards with over 10 customizable fields, including name, company, position, phone number, email, website, social media profiles, and more.
• Easy Networking: Begin networking online in just 4 simple steps—create your card, upload it to Apple Wallet, share via QR code or messaging, and effortlessly collect contact information.
Who Can Benefit From bCard?
Whether you're part of a big corporation, small business, or working independently, bCard enhances networking efficiency:
• Real Estate Pros: Instantly share listings and contact details with potential clients.
• Entrepreneurs & Freelancers: Organize your business contacts effortlessly by creating dedicated cards for different projects.
• Corporate Teams: Easily share contact information with clients, partners, and vendors without the hassle of physical cards.
• Event & Conference Attendees: Simplify networking by quickly exchanging contact information via QR codes.
Why Go Digital?
Traditional paper business cards can be lost, damaged, or forgotten. With bCard, your digital business card is safe, always accessible, and environmentally sustainable. When you share your contact details, you’ll always get theirs back, effectively solving a key networking challenge.
bCard's Key Benefits:
• Always Accessible: Your digital business card is always available on your smartphone.
• Enhanced Networking: Instantly exchange and collect contact details through QR codes and messaging.
• Professional & Customizable: Highlight your brand identity with a variety of customizable fields.
• Perfect for Multiple Contexts: Create specialized cards for every scenario—professional meetings, casual interactions, or specific projects.
• Seamless Apple Wallet Integration: Quickly access your cards from Apple Wallet.
• Environmentally Friendly: Say goodbye to wasteful paper cards.
Corporation plan:
Once you want to have bCard for the employees of your company, please contact us via support.
Join the Future of Networking
With bCard, the best free digital business card app, embrace the digital transformation of networking. Impress contacts, build meaningful connections, and effortlessly maintain relationships with the power of digital technology.
Download bCard today and redefine the way you share your professional contact information.

bluejetty:00034766:ios.summary:
PeakWatch turns your health data into clear, personalized guidance.
By connecting sleep, stress, recovery, activity, training, and nutrition, PeakWatch helps you understand what is affecting your body today and which small actions may help
bluejetty:00034766:ios.description:
PeakWatch turns your health data into clear, personalized guidance.
By connecting sleep, stress, recovery, activity, training, and nutrition, PeakWatch helps you understand what is affecting your body today and which small actions may help you feel better over time. 
Whether you want to improve your sleep, manage stress, exercise more consistently, eat with greater awareness, or simply understand your Apple Watch data, PeakWatch gives you the context your numbers are missing.
◎ Key Features
==AI is now available in PeakWatch==
Have questions about your recovery, sleep quality, exertion levels, or recent performance? Just ask. Your data now comes with explanations, insights, and context.
UNDERSTAND YOUR BODY TODAY
PeakWatch analyzes signals including HRV, resting heart rate, sleep, breathing, stress, activity, and recent workouts to help you understand:
- How well you are recovering
- What may be affecting your energy
- Whether today is better suited to activity or recovery
- How your current state compares with your normal pattern
TRACK ENERGY AND STRESS
Body Energy combines sleep, recovery, activity, and stress to show how your energy changes throughout the day.
Stress tracking helps you notice when physiological stress rises and how it may relate to sleep, movement, and daily habits.
SLEEP WITH MORE CONTEXT
Explore sleep duration, consistency, interruptions, restorative sleep, sleep debt, HRV, heart rate, respiratory rate, blood oxygen, and sleep stages.
See how sleep may be affecting your energy, recovery, and stress the next day.
MOVE AT THE RIGHT LEVEL
PeakWatch suggests an appropriate activity range based on recovery, recent training, and cardiovascular load.
You can also access detailed workout analysis, heart rate zones, effort scores, training impact, heart rate recovery, and long-term training balance.
Choose from more than 100 workouts across strength, HIIT, hybrid, and HYROX, or create your own custom sessions.
EAT WITH GREATER AWARENESS
Log meals with a photo and use AI-assisted analysis to estimate calories and nutrients.
Track energy balance, protein, carbohydrates, fat, and nutrition trends over time.
SEE LONG-TERM PROGRESS
Follow trends across sleep, stress, recovery, activity, cardiovascular fitness, nutrition, and training.
Understand what is improving, what may be holding you back, and which habits appear to be helping.
NOTICE WHAT AFFECTS YOU
Add events such as alcohol, illness, travel, late meals, soreness, or stressful days, then see how they may relate to changes in sleep and recovery.
APPLE WATCH
View your current health status directly from your wrist with multiple watch face options and complications.
# Contact Us
Email: hi@peakwatch.co
Instagram: @getPeakWatch
We’d love to hear your thoughts! Your feedback fuels our improvements.
# Subscription and Terms
PeakWatch is available for free with the option to upgrade to PeakWatch PRO with an auto-renewing subscription. You may switch off auto-renew in your Apple ID Account Settings.
Purchases of PRO subscriptions will be charged using your Apple ID upon confirmation of purchase. Subscriptions renew on a monthly or yearly frequency unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. If canceled, subscriptions remain valid until the end of the current period, and any unused portions are not valid for a refund.
PeakWatch reads data from HealthKit. All health data is stored and processed locally on your device.
# Subscription and Terms
PeakWatch is free to use, with the option to upgrade to PeakWatch PRO for advanced features. Subscriptions auto-renew unless canceled in your Apple ID settings.
Terms of Service: https://peakwatch.co/en/service/terms-of-use.html
Privacy Policy: https://peakwatch.co/en/service/privacy-policy.html
# Disclaimer
PeakWatch provides general information and is not a substitute for medical advice or treatment. Consult a healthcare professional for medical concerns.

bluejetty:00061995:ios.name: Halloween Baking Game for Kids
bluejetty:00061995:ios.summary: Our diverse collection of games keeps kids engaged and motivates them to learn more! We've developed an extensive curriculum that covers number sense and math tasks, tracing letters and numbers, writing words, phonics, interactive reading,
bluejetty:00061995:ios.description:
Our diverse collection of games keeps kids engaged and motivates them to learn more! We've developed an extensive curriculum that covers number sense and math tasks, tracing letters and numbers, writing words, phonics, interactive reading, and more. Curated by experts, the content fosters curiosity, creativity, and confidence in young learners, assisting them as they grow. 
Smarter, Inclusive Learning for Every Child
SKIDOS now supports kids with ADHD, Dyslexia, Dysgraphia & Dyscalculia. Built with accessibility guidelines, the experience is tailored to every child’s unique learning needs—making learning more personalised, inclusive, and enjoyable for neurodivergent learners too
SKIDOS PASS: ALL IN ONE
With the SKIDOS Pass, children explore a safe and age-appropriate space with 1000+ fun and engaging activities, gaining life skills and receiving positive reinforcement for academic success. Parents can create up to 6 personalized profiles for their kids. and customize each according to age, gameplay preferences, and subjects to learn. Monitoring kids' progress is easy - learning reports in the app or via email give you a simple overview of their growth and challenges.
GAMEPLAY:
BAKERY
Whisk, Bake, Learn, Play
Bake with cheerful SKIDOS monsters in a playful bakery adventure for kids aged 4–8! Learn real cake recipes step-by-step while boosting focus (Executive Function), solving ingredient puzzles (Cognitive Development), decorating with flair (Creative Imagination), and improving coordination (Motor Skills). A deliciously fun way to nurture essential early skills! 
LEARNING CURRICULUM
Our curriculum mixes engaging games with learning content, improving your child's learning skills and promoting active play.
MATH: Our math exercises cover a comprehensive list of topics, including number sense, addition, subtraction, multiplication, division, geometry, and more. Tasks evolve as your child progresses. Interactive design and animations help support learning - three cute SKIDOS mascots will offer assistance, encouraging kids while they work on the assignments.
TRACING LETTERS & NUMBERS: You can pick tracing letters and numbers for your child to practice. A ladybird will show your little learner how to trace with their finger, while visuals and voiceovers teach new words and counting.
READING: Children will be introduced to the world of phonics, sounds, letters, and reading. Interactive designs and smart prompts help kids make their first confident steps toward reading, while storytelling with songs keeps them engaged and curious about new learning journeys.
EMOTIONAL WELLBEING: Through engaging activities, kids learn to understand and express their emotions and nurture positive attitudes.
EDUCATIONAL VIDEOS: Our video content piques kids' curiosity in a fun and easy way. We've curated just the right mix of entertainment & learning in our video catalogue.
SAFE & AD-FREE
SKIDOS ensures an ad-free online environment, providing kids with a positive and uninterrupted learning experience. Our apps are COPPA & GDPR-compliant.
ABOUT THE SKIDOS PASS SUBSCRIPTION:
- We offer monthly, quarterly, bi-annual and annual auto-renewable subscriptions
- Every subscription starts with a 3-day Free Trial
- Payment is charged to your Apple Account only after a free trial period, wherever applicable
- Subscriptions renew automatically unless auto-renewal is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current billing cycle
- The user may turn off the subscription auto-renewal in the user's device Account Settings
- Cancellation goes into effect at the end of the current billing cycle
- Any unused portion of a free trial period will be forfeited when the user purchases a SKIDOS pass, where applicable
Privacy Policy: http://skidos.com/privacy-policy
Terms & Conditions: https://skidos.com/terms/
Support: support@skidos.com

Welcome to MECU Credit Union’s Mobile Banking App 
- For our consumer and business members 
Get the most from MECU’s Mobile Banking App 24/7! You can do more than check your balance and transfer funds: 
• Deposit checks anywhere, anytime with Mobile Deposit.
• Transfer funds quickly and easily between your accounts. 
• Treat yourself with Purchase Rewards – activate your rewards in app today! 
• Check your balance in seconds – without logging into the app. 
• Send money to family and friends! 
• Don’t waste a stamp – pay bills with Online Bill Pay.
Two Easy Steps to Mobile Banking
1. Download the MECU App. 
2. Sign up for Mobile Banking or login using your existing Online/Business Banking login credentials.
Mobile Banking is FREE and SECURE. Security includes the latest encryption. MECU strongly recommends that you also use a reputable anti-malware program on your phone to further protect your information.
Our Online Privacy Practices
Keeping financial and personal information secure is one of our most important responsibilities. MECU is committed to protecting the information of members and visitors who use our apps and website. We value your trust and handle all personal information with care.
As with information we collect through other means, we use the information you provide online to respond to your needs, service your accounts, and provide you information about other services.
Message and data rates may apply.
Need assistance? Call 410-752-8313 during regular business hours.
Federally Insured by NCUA.

Permanent Residents

REVIEWS

bluejetty:00029135:ios.description:
Omio: Compare and book trains, buses, flights and ferries
Omio makes travel booking easy. Compare and book train, bus, flight and ferry tickets all in one place.
With Omio, you can compare more than 3,000 trusted transport companies across 45+ countries, including Europe, the UK, the US, Japan, Southeast Asia and Brazil. Whether you are booking trains, buses, flights or ferries, Omio helps you find routes, compare prices, check travel times and keep your tickets ready in one app.
Book popular trips like London to Paris, Paris to Amsterdam, Milan to Rome, Madrid to Barcelona, Tokyo to Kyoto, Kuala Lumpur to Singapore and Sao Paulo to Rio de Janeiro. Use Omio to book Japan bullet trains, including Shinkansen routes, plus buses, flights and ferries in Japan. You can also book buses and flights in Indonesia, Malaysia, Thailand, Singapore, Vietnam and Brazil.
Why choose Omio?
Compare 3,000+ companies: Search trains, buses, flights and ferries from top travel providers in one place.
All-in-One Travel: Book tickets for trains, buses, flights or ferries quickly and compare prices across leading providers in Europe, the UK, the US and beyond.
Easy to Use: Discover routes, compare options, pay securely and receive mobile tickets directly on your phone.
Exclusive Ticket Discounts: Students, frequent travelers and more can save with special offers, referral programs and loyalty cards.
Live Updates: Receive real-time trip updates, including platform changes, delays and gate information where available.
Mobile Tickets: Add your train, bus, plane and ferry tickets directly to the app and access them whenever you need them.
24/7 Support: Omio provides international customer service, so you are covered wherever you travel.
Unlock a free eSIM: With your Omio booking, enjoy 2 days of free mobile data, up to 1GB, with our partner Kolet.
Travel with top train and rail providers
Book train tickets with trusted providers across Europe, North America and Japan, including Amtrak, VIA Rail, Eurostar, SBB, SNCF, Trenitalia, Deutsche Bahn DB, Renfe, Italo, Iryo, National Rail, Japan Rail Pass and Shinkansen routes.
Travel by train across Europe and the EU with high-speed and regional rail options. Book Eurostar routes between the UK and France, SNCF trains in France, Trenitalia in Italy, DB trains in Germany, SBB in Switzerland, Renfe in Spain, Amtrak in the US and Shinkansen rail journeys in Japan.
Book bus tickets effortlessly
Compare buses with major operators including FlixBus, ALSA, National Express, BlaBlaCar Bus, RegioJet, OurBus, RedCoach, Socibus, PKS, Avanza Bus, Rede Expressos, Itabus, MarinoBus and IberoCoach.
Find bus routes across Europe, the UK, North America, Japan, Southeast Asia and Brazil. Omio helps you compare bus companies, prices and journey times before you book.
Flight tickets in a few taps
Compare flights with leading airlines including Ryanair, easyJet, British Airways, Wizz Air, Vueling, Eurowings and more. Book regional and international flights in selected markets across Europe, the UK, Japan, Southeast Asia and Brazil.
Sail smoothly on ferries
Book ferry tickets with reliable operators like Balearia, Blue Star Ferries, GNV, NLG, Positano Jet, Seajets and Travelmar, with ferry connections across Europe, the UK and island destinations.
Join over 28 million travelers who trust Omio
Omio helps travelers compare trains, buses, flights and ferries, plan trips and book tickets with confidence. The app has a 4.7/5 Trustpilot rating from over 1,500 reviews.
Contact
Need help? Visit help.omio.com/hc/en-us
Stay Connected
Follow Omio for travel updates, tips and exclusive offers:
Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/Omio
Instagram: https://instagram.com/Omio/
TikTok: https://www.tiktok.com/@omioglobal
