bluejetty:00156026:ios.summary:
ACHARYA PRASHANT APP – SEE YOURSELF CLEARLY
Career, relationships, life’s struggles: how much of what you call “me” is borrowed from family, society and conditioning?
We learn everything about the world, except the one who is living in it
bluejetty:00156026:ios.description:
ACHARYA PRASHANT APP – SEE YOURSELF CLEARLY
Career, relationships, life’s struggles: how much of what you call “me” is borrowed from family, society and conditioning?
We learn everything about the world, except the one who is living in it.
The Acharya Prashant App is Acharya Prashant’s initiative to bring education of the self to the masses, bringing the Bhagavad Gita, the Upanishads and the wisdom of the saints to the questions of everyday life.
Not a belief system, not a technique, not motivation. A mirror to question, examine and understand yourself.
AP COMMUNITY – LEARN, DON’T JUST LISTEN
You can listen to wisdom for years and remain exactly the same. Real understanding needs questioning, reflection and sustained study, and AP Community is built for exactly that.
• LIVE SESSIONS: Study the Bhagavad Gita, Upanishads and other wisdom texts verse by verse with Acharya Prashant. Simple and in-depth explanations connect each verse to relationships, work, fear, desire and everyday choices.
• SESSION RECORDINGS: Revisit sessions, return to difficult portions, study at your own pace.
• ASK LIVE: Submit your questions and confusions. Acharya Ji may address them in an upcoming session.
• DAILY REFLECTIONS: Examine what you have understood and how it relates to your life. Share through text, images, audio or video.
• LEARN WITH OTHERS: Read fellow members’ reflections. Let fellow students’ honest mirroring challenge your assumptions.
• VIDYA-AVIDYA: Look beyond headlines. Examine current events, social issues and human behaviour through the lens of self-knowledge.
EXAMS – HAVE YOU REALLY UNDERSTOOD?
Remembering words is not the same as understanding. Regular exams on Acharya Ji’s sessions help you test what you have understood and where the gaps are, with explanation and percentage.
Not a certificate of wisdom, a mirror.
AP MUSIC – LISTEN, REFLECT, UNDERSTAND
Explore bhajans, dohe and kavya of the saints with synchronised lyrics: words that invite self-examination, not escape.
TALKING MIRROR – QUESTION THE QUESTIONER
Not advice, a mirror. Share a situation or confusion. Talking Mirror, an AI guide built on Acharya Ji’s teachings, helps you examine the assumptions, fears and desires behind it.
READ – GO BEYOND THE SURFACE
• ARTICLES: Explore questions on relationships, career, fear, attachment, spirituality and everyday life.
• COLUMNS: Acharya Prashant’s columns on society, current affairs and the questions of our times.
• EBOOKS & AUDIOBOOKS: Read or listen to Acharya Prashant’s books in Hindi and English.
• QUOTES & POSTERS: Short, sharp insights that challenge habitual thinking.
GLOBAL SEARCH – START WITH YOUR QUESTION
Search in Hindi or English across articles, books, quotes, posters, columns, session recordings and community posts.
WATCH – FROM SHORT INSIGHTS TO DEEP STUDY
• SHORTS: Brief videos that challenge familiar assumptions: a doorway to deeper study, not endless scrolling.
• VIDEO SERIES: Structured, step-by-step study of scriptures and life’s fundamental questions. Download to watch offline.
WHERE TO START
Explore 10,000+ free articles, quotes, posters and Shorts, along with books, video series and AP Music.
For deeper learning, join AP Community for live sessions, recordings, exams and reflections.
ABOUT ACHARYA PRASHANT
Acharya Prashant is a philosopher, author and the creator of the AP Framework (Acharya Prashant Framework), a philosophical framework spanning ontology, epistemology, liberation, value, mind, the human being and aesthetics. He founded the PrashantAdvait Foundation. Drawing on the Bhagavad Gita, the Upanishads, the saints, other scriptures and Western philosophy, he brings rigorous inquiry to the problems of modern life, without superstition or blind belief.
The world teaches us how to achieve.
But do we understand the one who wants to achieve?
Website: acharyaprashant.org
Support: support@advait.org.in

This new
bluejetty:00152856:ios.description:
War Vow is a unique online military strategy game. 
This new game combines military tactics, casual, and simulation elements to offer a completely free and thrilling experience. 
WAR VOW is a unique online military strategy game.
This new game combines military tactics, casual gameplay, and simulation elements to offer a completely free and thrilling experience for fans of war games, RTS (Real-Time Strategy), and military combat.
Base Construction
Experience the authenticity of modern warfare by building and upgrading military fortifications, including anti-aircraft turrets, fuel depots, and armored factories. Create an indestructible steel fortress with a perfect balance of offense and defense. Manage your resource chain strategically to maximize war production capacity, ensuring your base survives intense artillery strikes in real-time battles.
Legendary Troops
Recruit legendary WWII generals such as Eisenhower, Patton, Rommel, and Zhukov, each with unique tactical skills and personalized upgrade paths. Combine various military units—infantry, tanks, artillery, and air forces—to form the ultimate army capable of dominating the battlefield in both PvP and PvE war campaigns.
Tactical Strategy
A true commander achieves victory with minimal losses. Your choices—attack routes, unit deployment order, and real-time tactical skill usage—directly impact battle outcomes. Master battlefield strategy, engage in intense RTS combat, and secure one victory after another in fast-paced action warfare.
Alliance Wars
Will you choose war or peace? Form or join a legion, expand your territory, and engage in massive multiplayer battles against players worldwide. Coordinate with allies, crush enemy bases, and prove your dominance in global military strategy warfare. Forge alliances, Crush oppression!
artwork
Featuring stunning, meticulously crafted artwork, from heroes and weapons to vehicles and gear. Every detail shines with vibrant colors and breathtaking effects, making it one of the best-designed war strategy games in the world.

bluejetty:00032069:ios.description:
Recommended by CNN and Lonely Planet, this is Guangzhou's best subway map! Up-to-date with all the metro lines; Works offline; Routeplanner, GPS, Street maps; English and Chinese included.
Download the app completely free! The free app is ad-supported. Upgrade to VIP features if you'd like to get extra features, remove ads and support future development!
WHY EXPLOREMETRO?
1. Fully up-to-date
Accurate metro map, includes every station on every line. Free updates for future station openings and timetable changes.
2. Designed for iPhone
Our gorgeous maps have been fully redesigned for all iPhone devices. Runs on all iOS10-14 devices.
3. Designed for iPad 
Specially redesigned interface for the larger iPad screen with split screen. Drag and drop station names, tips, maps and timetables into other apps.
4. Street maps for every station 
Need to get your bearings at a station? Integrated Street maps show you metro exits and nearby streets for every station.
5. Route-planner 
A really easy route-planner. Get route and time information for any journey with just three taps.
6. "Find my nearest station" 
Using your GPS, see a list of the closest metro stations to your current location.
7. Works offline 
Everything works without an Internet connection. Search stations and plan routes on the go.
UPGRADE TO VIP FOR EVEN MORE FEATURES
I've been developing this app for 10 years. Upgrading to VIP helps support future development of the app. VIP users get additional features, like NO ADS, accurate prices for every journey, first/last train times, offline street maps, tips at every station, and a general warm fuzzy feeling.
REVIEWS
CNN Travel: "These maps are very easy on the eye and simple to navigate. They work offline and also include free updates of stations that have yet to be completed, operating hours and schedules." 
Lonely Planet: "Easy to use, up to date and work offline. Very handy, especially when they've run out of paper maps at the stations."
SUGGESTIONS
We'd love to hear your comments and suggestions on ways to improve the app. Please contact us via support@exploremetro.com, as we can't respond to comments left in the reviews.

— SEE IT AS IT HAPPENS —
When
bluejetty:00069528:ios.description:
Aurora Forecast answers one question: can you see the aurora tonight, from where you are? It brings together NOAA space weather, the sky above you, and reports from people nearby who are watching it right now.
— SEE IT AS IT HAPPENS —
When people near you spot the aurora, their reports appear on the map and on the Home tab, showing how many have seen it within 100 km and how close the nearest one is. Seeing it yourself? Share it in one tap. No account needed, and every location is blurred to about 1 km before anyone else sees it.
— KNOW BEFORE THE SKY GLOWS —
• NOAA OVATION 30-minute aurora forecast on a map and a 3D globe
• Aurora probability for your exact location
• Kp index history, 3-day forecast and 27-day outlook
• Live solar wind: speed, density and magnetic field (Bz)
• Cloud cover, moon phase, sunrise and sunset
• Live aurora webcams and real-time images of the Sun
• Aurora hotspots: well-known viewing spots, including dark-sky parks
• Aurora Guide, plus Stories & News from the world of the aurora
— AURORA INTELLIGENCE (ULTIMATE) —
One clear answer to "Should I go out now?", weighing the forecast, the clouds above you, the moonlight and reports from people nearby. On iPhones with Apple Intelligence it runs on your device; otherwise it uses our cloud AI.
— ALERTS, WIDGETS AND APPLE WATCH —
• Aurora alerts for your location (Pro)
• Apple Watch complications (Pro)
• Home Screen and Lock Screen widgets (Ultimate)
• Detailed cloud cover by altitude (Ultimate)
— ON EVERY SCREEN —
iPhone, iPad, and iPhone Duo open or folded, in 32 languages.
— SUBSCRIPTIONS —
The forecast, maps, live data, webcams and community reports are free.
• Aurora Pro, monthly or yearly: aurora alerts and Apple Watch complications
• Aurora Ultimate Pro, monthly or yearly: everything in Pro, plus Aurora Intelligence, widgets and detailed cloud cover
Prices are shown in the app in your local currency.
Payment will be charged to your Apple Account at confirmation of purchase. Subscriptions renew automatically unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Your account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can manage or cancel your subscriptions in Settings > [your name] > Subscriptions.
Privacy Policy: https://www.tinacinc.com/AuroraForecast/privacy_policy.html
Terms of Use: https://www.tinacinc.com/AuroraForecast/terms_of_conditions.html

bluejetty:00152239:ios.description:
Farm Thru Tycoon – Idle Country Empire
Build, harvest, and sell your way to the top of the farming world!
Restore Grandpa’s old farm, run poultry, dairy, and crop businesses, and grow your Farm-to-Market Empire on the sunny countryside highway.
Serve customers with fresh produce, automate everything, and become the #1 Farm Tycoon in the region!
GROW, PRODUCE & SELL
Tap to harvest vegetables, collect milk, hatch chickens, and pack goods for sale.
Automate your conveyors and workers to earn money even while offline.
Watch trucks, pickups, and cars arrive to buy your fresh produce nonstop!
EXPAND YOUR FARM BUSINESS
Poultry Farm – Hatch eggs, raise chickens, and ship ready-to-cook packs.
Dairy Barn – Milk cows, pasteurize bottles, and deliver to the milk factory.
Crop Fields – Harvest corn, wheat, and veggies for roadside buyers.
Farm Mart – Sell local snacks, juices, and organic items to travelers.
AUTOMATE & UPGRADE
Unlock Fast Harvesting, Turbo Milking, and Express Packing boosters.
Use Safe-O-Matic systems to automate cash collection and deliveries.
Upgrade conveyors, barns, and storage silos to double your profits.
PROGRESS, PRESTIGE & BONUSES
Earn Stars to unlock new farm areas and side businesses.
Collect Crystals & Hammers to enhance global upgrades in your Workshop.
Prestige anytime to gain permanent multipliers and grow faster each run.
OUTSMART YOUR RIVAL
Greedy tycoon Victor Steele wants to buy your land—fight back!
Survive his sabotage events, rebuild stronger, and prove that hard work beats money in this ultimate Idle Tycoon Showdown.

Deep yet relaxing idle tycoon gameplay—easy to start, satisfying to master.
Stylized 2D cartoon art with a vibrant countryside backdrop.
Offline earnings, daily quests, and seasonal farm festivals.
Game Center leaderboards—see who built the richest farm!
BECOME THE FARM LEGEND
Download Farm Thru Tycoon today and grow your own countryside empire!
From chickens to cheese, from milk to millions—your farm, your story, your fortune!

bluejetty:00179333:ios.description:
WeatherGraph is a simple but powerful weather app for iPhone, iPad, and Apple Watch which displays weather forecasts in the United States from the National Weather Service (NWS) in an easy to read graphical format. 
WeatherGraph uses the highest quality weather data available - the same forecast and observations used by academic researchers and meteorologists.
WeatherGraph features 24 hours of observations and 7 days of forecasts for the locations you choose and has the ability to display record highs and lows for each weather station you follow. WeatherGraph also has Home Screen and Lock Screen Widgets showing a graph of upcoming weather conditions and an Apple Watch app with complications showing the highs and lows and rain probability for the next 2 days.
Due to the fact that all data comes from NWS/NOAA, this app will only provide weather forecasts for the United States of America.

bluejetty:00024734:ios.name: Smart NFC Tools: Read & Write
bluejetty:00024734:ios.developer: Arthur Eduardo Skaetta Alvarez Desenvolvimento de Software LTDA.
bluejetty:00024734:ios.summary:
Smart NFC Tools is the most accessible and easy to use NFC Reader and Writer for mobile devices! With a simple user interface and powerful tools you can interact with NDEF-Formatted NFC cards without any external hardware!
- Read, Inspect
bluejetty:00024734:ios.description:
Smart NFC Tools is the most accessible and easy to use NFC Reader and Writer for mobile devices! With a simple user interface and powerful tools you can interact with NDEF-Formatted NFC cards without any external hardware!
- Read, Inspect and modify:
Read a tag by touching the back of your device against it and Smart NFC Tools will show you a full report on the tag's content and give you options such as erase, lock and copy. It's super easy!
- Write in many formats:
Smart NFC Tools enables you to write NFC tags in popular formats that allow for custom interactions such as opening a website or triggering a phone call just by touching the tag with a compatible device!
- Note about privacy:
Smart NFC Tools works 100% offline, without any personal or content data being sent to an external server or third party server. Your privacy is our priority!
Embrace the world of NFC technologies using your phone or tablet! Smart NFC Tools is now available for all iOS devices!

bluejetty:00126645:ios.name: Easy to Read Bible KJV
bluejetty:00126645:ios.summary: This easy to use King James Version Bible app for The Chosen will allow you to read, share, study, and save your favorite verses with ease. With this app version of the King James Bible, you can easily and quickly switch between the Old Tes
bluejetty:00126645:ios.description:
This easy to use King James Version Bible app for The Chosen will allow you to read, share, study, and save your favorite verses with ease. With this app version of the King James Bible, you can easily and quickly switch between the Old Testament and the New Testament, navigate directly to the book, chapter, or verse you want to read, and bookmark where you left off in reading the Holy King James Version Bible. This app's design makes it easy to read aloud, quote, and study new verses and chapters in the King James Bible. You can learn the King James Bible with your study guide, or you can create your own reading plan to help you memorize or just peruse the Bible at your own pace. You will not need a glorified tutorial or complicated video on how to use any of the tools featured in this app, which many Christians and those studying The Holy Bible have long desired. You can also highlight portions of text, again making it easy to copy/paste text, share, learn, memorize, and study different sections of The Holy King James Bible. You'll be amazed at how easy it is to use offline or online. This King James Version Bible app is a great and easy way for you and others to devote part of your day to Jesus. The offline feature helps you study or read God's Word anytime and anywhere you want. Spending this time with Jesus will enhance your journey with God and make you a better Christian and a better person all around!
- Save your favorite verses
- Share verses through text messages and many other platforms
- Go directly to books, chapters, or verses via the find tool
- Includes both the New and Old Testaments 
- Read different translations for each verse such as American Standard Translation (ASA) which is a simple way to read the Bible
This app offers a free trial. After trial period, features require a paid a subscription.
Privacy Policy: http://www.bluedoorsystems.com/privacy.html
Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula

bluejetty:00015138:ios.description:
Explore dozens of art, coloring, and educational activities with Crayola Create and Play, the official Crayola app for curious kids to learn through fun, creative play! Discover interactive digital learning experiences built in collaboration with experts from the world-famous Smithsonian Institution, where curiosity and exploration is brought to life! Get unlimited access with your 7-day free trial. Cancel anytime.
*5 STARS PARENT-TESTED PARENT APPROVED APP*
*GOOD PLAY GUIDE APPROVED*
*EDUCATIONAL APP STORE CERTIFIED*
*ACADEMICS CHOICE AWARD WINNER*
SPARK IMAGINATION WITH ART, COLORING & DRAWING ACTIVITIES
• Explore unlimited coloring pages for your little artist 
• Create pixel art unicorns, dogs, cats, dinosaurs, and pets
• Spark bright ideas with glow art
• Craft and customize dinosaurs, rocket ships, and other 3D designs 
ENCOURAGE CRITICAL THINKING & LEARN EDUCATIONAL CLASSROOM SKILLS
• Inspired by STEAM and STEM education techniques, kids can learn through creativity
• Basic coding exercises help your child grasp complex concepts in science and math
• Practice spelling, number recognition, creative problem-solving, and fine motor skills
• Kids can solve puzzles they create from their own art!
CREATE DIGITAL MASTERPIECES WITH CRAYOLA ART TOOLS
• Use digital Crayola art tools and crayons to color, draw, paint, stamp, sticker, glitter, and create
• Encourage creativity with coloring and drawing for kids, featuring unlimited possibilities 
PRACTICE KINDNESS & EMPATHY BY CARING FOR PETS
• Hatch, design, color, and interact with personalized pets
• Combine coloring with practicing empathy through pet care like washing and feeding 
PARENT & TEACHER APPROVED ART APP
• Designed to encourage kids' creative growth and align with age-appropriate child development milestones
• COPPA and PRIVO certified, and GDPR compliant so you can be sure the app is safe for the whole family
• Play with your children to watch them grow and learn
NEW KIDS GAMES & ART ACTIVITIES MONTHLY
• For toddlers, preschool age, pre- kindergarten age, and young children
• Ever-evolving content updates to keep kids inspired
JOIN PARENTS WHO LOVE OUR APP!
"The best kids app out there! Educational, creative and fun! Well worth an annual pass." - Jen, Mom of preschool girl
"We are in love with this app! So many exciting games, excellent graphics, fun coloring pages, and runs smoothly! We love all the updates and events! It has helped him learn his colors and letters, and improved his fine motor skills and technology skills. I’m a former teacher and I approve!” - Lisa, Mom of toddler boy
WHY SUBSCRIBE?
Unlock full access to all kids coloring and drawing games, new educational activities and features, and monthly content updates! Each activity and game is developed to achieve our mission to help parents and educators raise inspired kids. Content updates stay relevant with your child as they grow, to foster artistic expression and development over time.
SUBSCRIPTION DETAILS
Yearly subscriptions are charged once per year. Subscriptions are charged at the beginning of the current period and auto-renewed 24 hours before the next period. All subscriptions include a 7-day free trial. Cancel anytime.
• Payment will be charged to iTunes Account at time of purchase
• Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period
• Account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period
• With a 7-day free trial, your account is charged on the 7th day for the period which will begin on the 8th day 
• Subscriptions may be managed by the user and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user's Account Settings
Privacy Policy: https://www.redgames.co/crayola-create-and-play-privacy-policy
Terms of Service: https://aut.crayocom.cloud.sitefinity.com/company/app-terms-of-use
Support: support@createandplay.zendesk.com

bluejetty:00077220:ios.summary:

- No maps to download or use within this app (this is not a navigation or mappi
bluejetty:00077220:ios.description:
Track Your Adventures with ExplorOz Tracker!
Explore the world with confidence using your iPhone or iPad! Track your trips anywhere, even offline.
KEY FEATURES
- No maps to download or use within this app (this is not a navigation or mapping app)
- No account needed to view another person's trip progress
- Membership license required to enable device tracking on your own device - follow the in-app link for details.
DEVICE TRACKING
With a Member account, the app detects your device's movement and records GPS readings to collect highly accurate "position data" as you travel. This data can be recorded without a WiFi or mobile data connection and automatically syncs to your account on our server when your device connects to the internet. Your traveled path is displayed as a route line on a map, and privacy options let you decide who can view your map. Your map will also appear in the app for your own use.
Share your Tracker map link with selected friends and family so they can view your tracking on any device using the Tracker app or on the ExplorOz website. Ask them to download this app - it's free!
Install Tracker on other family devices to monitor their movements (e.g., ensuring children reach school safely, tracking a partner who runs or cycles, or monitoring a family member on holiday). Simply log in to the app with your Member account to control the settings. Each app download is free!
APP FEATURES
-Tracks online & offline
-Automatically syncs & updates your personal map
-Uses Geofences to hide your movement in sensitive areas
-Includes Save/Edit tools
-Allows viewing of tracking from multiple devices within one app
-No maps to download or use within this app (this is not a navigation or mapping app)
GPS OPERATION:
For Tracking, your device must have an inbuilt or external GPS to show the current position and use navigation features. If you have a WiFi-only iPad, connect an external GPS receiver.
NETWORK CONNECTION:
While tracking can occur without an internet connection, a network connection is required to sync all stored position data to your personal Tracking map.
BATTERY USAGE:
Tracking can be done while the app runs in the background and with the screen-saver on. Note that GPS usage may decrease battery life.
Download ExplorOz Tracker now and start your adventure!

bluejetty:00184682:ios.summary: Ben is a retired chemistry professor who likes his quiet comfortable life of eating, drinking and reading newspapers. To make him responsive, you will have to bother him long enough that he will fold his newspaper. Then you can talk to him,
bluejetty:00184682:ios.description:
Ben is a retired chemistry professor who likes his quiet comfortable life of eating, drinking and reading newspapers. To make him responsive, you will have to bother him long enough that he will fold his newspaper. Then you can talk to him, poke or tickle him or even have a telephone conversation with him.
If you get Ben to his laboratory however, he becomes as happy as a puppy. There you can do chemistry experiments by mixing a combination of two test tubes together and see the hilarious reactions.
HINT: Record a funny video of your telephone conversation with Ben and send it to your friends.
HOW TO PLAY:
- Poke Ben's newspaper to make him fold it.
- Then you can talk to Ben and he will repeat.
- Poke or slap Ben's face, belly, feet or hands.
- Tickle Ben's belly.
- Poke or swipe Ben's graduation picture.
- Press the phone button and have a conversation with Ben.
- Record a funny video of your telephone conversation with Ben.
- Press buttons to make Ben eat, drink or belch.
- Press the chemistry button to switch Ben to the laboratory.
- Mix any two test tubes together and see the hilarious chemical reaction.
- Record videos and share them on YouTube or send them to your friends and family by email.
This app is PRIVO certified. The PRIVO safe harbor seal indicates Outfit7 has established COPPA compliant privacy practices to protect your child’s personal information. Our apps do not allow younger children to share their information.
This app contains:
- Promotion of Outfit7's products and contextual advertising
- Links that direct customers to our websites and other Outfit7 apps
- Personalization of content to entice users to play the app again
- Watching videos of Outfit7's animated characters via YouTube integration
- The option to make in-app purchases
Terms of use: https://talkingtomandfriends.com/eula/en/
Privacy policy for games: https://talkingtomandfriends.com/privacy-policy-games/en
Customer support: support@outfit7.com

bluejetty:00123353:ios.description:
Our People are the difference makers at Antonio's Pizza. We stress consistency in quality, service, and food, offered in a unique environment by a staff that is committed to one another, our customers, and our community. We are a family-owned company that values honesty, teamwork, dedication and loyalty. It all began in a basement on West 117th Street in 1967 when Tony LoSchiavo worked for a few weeks to get the pizza dough recipe just right for the pizzeria he was about to launch. Now, over 50 years and four generations later, the LoSchiavo family – led by Fred, Anthony and Vincent – has built a pizza empire with 14 locations that stretch from Avon to North Canton – and more on the way. 
Features:
• The Full Antonio’s Menu includes: 
o Special Deals
o Pizza
o Pasta
o Subs
o Chicken
o Wings 
o Salads
o Beverages
• Guest Check-Out allows you to checkout without creating an account.
• Push Notifications are delivered directly to your mobile device.

Triple Match Bubble 3D: Immerse yourself in a relaxing 3D match game designed to captivate and entertain even the busiest minds. Transform your free moments into valuable relaxation with familiar 3D objects inspired by everyday life, all rendered in vibrant colors.
How to Play:
Rotate the transparent bubble to view objects from all angles. Locate and match three identical objects to clear them from the bubble ball, mastering the tile puzzle as you go.
Progress through the game to unlock hundreds of delightful 3D objects and animated themes, adding to your collection with each level you conquer.
Hone your observation skills as you search diligently within the bubble ball for matching pairs. Race against time, but rest assured, you can pause and resume whenever you wish, thanks to the auto-save feature.
Much like traditional triple match games, the objective here is to identify and pair up all the presented elements. What sets this game apart is the 360 view of the items, facilitated by the rotatable transparent bubble. If the objects get a bit too tricky to differentiate, don't hesitate to use the hint feature to smooth your way forward.

bluejetty:00153639:ios.description:
BibleFocus: Faith Over Screen Time
Trade scrolling for soul-care. BibleFocus rewards every minute you spend praying, meditating, studying scripture, and going to church — and uses those rewards to unlock the apps eating your day.
Tired of opening your phone to "check one thing" and losing an hour? BibleFocus flips the script. The apps you mindlessly open are locked by default, and the only currency that unlocks them is time spent with God. Pray for two minutes, earn coins. Take a Bible study quiz, earn coins. Walk into your church, earn coins. Spend coins to unlock Instagram, TikTok, X — whatever you've decided is stealing your attention.
It's not a willpower app. It's a habit redesign.
HOW TO USE BIBLEFOCUS:
Pick the apps you want to spend less time in — BibleFocus locks them.
Earn coins by praying, meditating, scanning your Bible, taking daily quizzes, and checking into church.
Spend coins to unlock screen time when you need it. The longer you go without spending, the more it costs — so the math always favors faith.
Ready to take your time back? BibleFocus turns every distraction into an invitation to grow.
Faith-Building Challenges*
Guided prayer and meditation timers, Bible study quizzes at four difficulty levels, daily verse reflections, scripture scans, and church check-ins. Every action that draws you closer to God earns coins.
Smart App Locking*
Choose the apps that drain your day. BibleFocus uses Apple's Screen Time framework to lock them until you've earned your time. Nothing is sent to a server — your block list stays on your device.
Streaks, Stats & Faith Journey*
Track your daily streak, total coins earned, and time reclaimed. Watch your faith habits compound week over week with personal stats and milestones.
Light Therapy & Wind-Down*
A built-in light-therapy meditation mode helps you slow down at the end of the day — phone down, eyes closed, light on, peace restored.
Features Designed for Faith*
Prayer and meditation timers with per-minute coin rewards
Bible study quizzes (Beginner → Elite difficulty)
Daily verse and daily quiz, refreshed every morning
Church check-in via Maps for in-person attendance
Bible scan for capturing your daily reading
Private & Secure — block list and faith data stay on your device
Embark on your faith journey today.
For feedback or questions, contact us at team@crackedllc.com.
NOTE: The content in BibleFocus is intended for spiritual and educational purposes only and is not a substitute for professional counseling or pastoral guidance. For personal advice, please consult a licensed professional or clergy member.

bluejetty:00151794:ios.name: Warriors and Dungeons
bluejetty:00151794:ios.summary:
A swirling spacetime gate suddenly appeared at the edge of the sea, and before you could react, you were swallowed by endless darkness... glug glug glug...
You slowly wake up in a small town, where the locals tell you that a girl named Min
bluejetty:00151794:ios.description:
A swirling spacetime gate suddenly appeared at the edge of the sea, and before you could react, you were swallowed by endless darkness... glug glug glug...
You slowly wake up in a small town, where the locals tell you that a girl named Mina saved you. You learn that the town was built by adventurers who, like you, were pulled through the spacetime gate into this strange new world. But the real adventure is only just beginning.
Outside the village, there are angry mermaids, enchanting sirens, and vicious great white sharks. And beyond—farther and deeper—lie countless unknown dangers and untold opportunities waiting to be uncovered.
[Retro Pixel]
Dive into thrilling co-op dungeons and team battles—or hire mercenaries to take on mighty World Bosses. Guilds are where comrades share stories and forge bonds. Adventure awaits!
[Multiple Classes]
Three unique base classes have own multiple advanced paths. Will you be an unbreakable tank or a relentless berserker? A life-saving healer or an armor-shredding damage dealer? Specialize in devastating AoE attacks or lethal single-target bursts—your build, your rules.
[Treasure Hunting]
Woah. What wonders lie hidden in this treasure map? Team up to take on legendary bosses and loot their epic rewards.
[Various Outfits]
A completely free fashion system! Every piece of gear has its own unique look—from a simple hatchet and elegant hat to flashy glow sticks, T-shirts, and jeans. With over a thousand possible combinations, whether you're a rugged warrior or a cute adventurer, there's a style just for you. Don't miss out!
Thank you for playing!
We hope you'll stick around and enjoy the game—it's perfect for long-term, laid-back idle play! Sure, the early stages might feel a tiny bit challenging, but trust us, it's worth pushing through. Our goal? To keep you hooked for a whole year of fun.
Let's be honest. No one likes a game that is too easy and without any challenge. We prefer to bring out the satisfying path—slow progression, meaningful challenges, and the sweet victory of toppling one boss after another.
Gold, Skycrystals, and refinement stones are the game's core resources. Imagine landing a full "Lucky Crit"—the damage will blow your mind! As for difficulty? Well... that depends entirely on your luck. (This is more of an endgame goal—if you somehow get it early, you might just be breaking the game's balance!)
Finally, enough words. Let the benefits rewards do the speaking to show our sincerity.
More questions? Reach out to our official customer service!
Facebook Page: https://www.facebook.com/profile.php?id=61577774177465
Discord: https://discord.gg/kjBrCW4WYm

Developed specifically for Tennessee, Arkansas a
bluejetty:00131468:ios.description:
Chief Meteorologist Joey Sulipeck and The Severe Weather Center 13 Team of certified meteorologists have helped develop the Mid-South’s most accurate local weather app, The FOX13 Weather App.
Developed specifically for Tennessee, Arkansas and Mississippi, the FOX13 Weather App provides the most accurate local forecasts, to keep you and your family safe. The Mid-South’s most powerful local weather app includes:
Summary of Features:
- There is a new radar in the weather app that matches the radar found on other digital platforms and also includes future radar to provide you with a likely path and outlook of storms. The radar has 250 meter resolution, the highest available.
- New tracks - We added earthquakes and storm tracks as layers in the radar. Now you can track the location and magnitude of earthquakes as well for storms the speed, direction and type. Tap the “storm symbols” icon in the radar to see the list.
- Push alerts are FREE for more than 25 alert types including everything from tornado warnings to winter storm warnings and tropical storm alert types. 
- Now you can scroll through the home screen to access most of what you need or want on one tab. 
- Place a location pin precisely where you want it for a specific address or any position on a map. When saving a location you can name it exactly how you want it. 
- The app works with identical features on tablet and handset.
- Additional items added seasonally
The weather app also has these critical benefits and features:
- The radar zooms down to your neighborhood or zooms out to check radar anywhere in the country.
- The app provides Location-Based alerts. While many other apps offer alerts based on your county, This app supports a more precise type of alert issued for the most dangerous types of weather threats. More precision means you get alerts that matter to you, not false alarms.
- Current conditions, hourly and daily forecasts for any location you enter.
- High resolution satellite cloud imagery
- Ability to add and save locations
- A fully integrated GPS for current location awareness
- Additional items added seasonally
*Data and alerting available for the United States only.

Developed specifically for Tennessee, Arkansas and Mississippi, the FOX13 Weather App provides the most accurate local forecasts, to keep you and your family safe. The Mid-South’s most powerful local weather app includes:

Summary of Features:
-	There is a new radar in the weather app that matches the radar found on other digital platforms and also includes future radar to provide you with a likely path and outlook of storms. The radar has 250 meter resolution, the highest available.
-	New tracks - We added earthquakes and storm tracks as layers in the radar. Now you can track the location and magnitude of earthquakes as well for storms the speed, direction and type. Tap the “storm symbols” icon in the radar to see the list.
-	Push alerts are FREE for more than 25 alert types including everything from tornado warnings to winter storm warnings and tropical storm alert types. 
-	Now you can scroll through the home screen to access most of what you need or want on one tab. 
-	Place a location pin precisely where you want it for a specific address or any position on a map. When saving a location you can name it exactly how you want it. 
-	The app works with identical features on tablet and handset.
-	Additional items added seasonally

The weather app also has these critical benefits and features:
-	The radar zooms down to your neighborhood or zooms out to check radar anywhere in the country.
-	The app provides Location-Based alerts. While many other apps offer alerts based on your county, This app supports a more precise type of alert issued for the most dangerous types of weather threats. More precision means you get alerts that matter to you, not false alarms.
-	Current conditions, hourly and daily forecasts for any location you enter.
-	High resolution satellite cloud imagery
-	Ability to add and save locations
-	A fully integrated GPS for current location awareness
-	Additional items added seasonally

*Data and alerting available for the United States only.

Search 1000 verbs across 20 tenses — from presente to subjuntivo imperfecto — with results available offline. Exact matches always surface first. Audio pronunciation, example sentences, and translations in 14+ languages make it a complete learning tool.

● Ad-free experience
● 1000 verbs across 20 tenses — indicative, subjunctive, conditional, imperative, and more

● Example sentences — see how verbs are used in real-world context

● Favourites & history — bookmark verbs you use often and quickly revisit recent lookups
● Translations in 14+ languages — see translations in your native language
● Export, copy & print — share conjugation tables via email, clipboard, or print
● Works offline — conjugation data is stored on your device
● iPad optimised — full support for iPad including landscape split-screen view
● Regular & irregular verb indicators — quickly see whether a verb follows standard patterns
WHAT USERS SAY
"Definitely the best of the Spanish verb conjugating apps out there. Easy on the eye, simple to use, very effective."
Thank you for supporting the app!

bluejetty:00120182:ios.summary: **NOTICE: In order to use the app, your school district must have a contract with Synovia Solutions and make Here Comes the Bus® and/or Student Ridership available to parents. Please contact your school district or visit www.herecomesthebus
bluejetty:00120182:ios.description:
**NOTICE: In order to use the app, your school district must have a contract with Synovia Solutions and make Here Comes the Bus® and/or Student Ridership available to parents. Please contact your school district or visit www.herecomesthebus.com for more information.** 
Here Comes the Bus is an easy-to-use app that gives you the real-time location of your child’s bus, and alerts you when the bus is near. With Here Comes the Bus, your children will get to the bus stop not a minute too early – or a minute too late. And with Student Ridership, you’ll not only know your child got on the right bus at the right time, but that they got off the bus at the right stop.
All of this equals safety for your children, and peace of mind for you.
KEY FEATURES:
Find your bus quickly and easily
See the exact location of your child’s school bus using your own customizable map.
Receive alerts via push notification
-Be notified when the bus is within 2 miles of your stop, has a schedule change, and more
-Receive notifications when your child gets on/off the bus, including the bus number, location and time
Access arrival & departure info
Confirm your child’s bus has arrived at the bus stop and at school, both before and after school.
Track all of your children
Have children that ride different buses? See each child's bus information within one account.
App and notifications in three languages
The app and notifications are available in English, Spanish and French.
Know your privacy is protected
Parents must obtain a private ID number, which grants access to their child’s bus only.

bluejetty:00138649:ios.description:
Help Emily Smith solve the cold case murder and the secret of the lighthouse in this mystery detective game. 
Play the hidden object game, find lost items and solve crime mysteries!
________________________________________________________________________
Will you manage to uncover the mystery of It Happened Here: Beacon of Truth? Immerse yourself in the detective hidden object game, solve puzzles, explore unusual locations and find out what small town mystery Emily Smith has to solve.
Emily gets a call from her friend Catherine Malcolm. She says that her husband's murder case, which occurred at the old lighthouse, has just been shelved as unsolved. Emily travels to a small seaside town and learns about the myths and legends associated with the old lighthouse. How might these legends be connected to an unsolved case? Will Emily be able to find the killer? Find out the truth in this detective hidden object game!
EXPLORE THE SEASIDE TOWN AND FIND NEW LEADS
The police found no clues to identify the murderer. Emily will have to examine the places the police missed and try to solve crime mysteries.
LEARN THE MYSTERIOUS HISTORY OF THE OLD LIGHTHOUSE
Some people believe that there are treasures hidden at the lighthouse. Solve mystery puzzles and complete exciting mini-games to find out if treasure hunting can be deadly.
LEARN IF YOU MANAGE TO FIND THE MURDERER AND MAKE IT OUT ALIVE
Complete engaging HO scenes and feel the thrill caused by the unexpected plot twists.
FIND OUT WHAT HAPPENED TO YOUNG EMILY IN THE BONUS CHAPTER!
It’s the day before Emily and Sean’s wedding a long time ago. Emily visits the florist to take the bridal bouquet but finds her dead body instead. Help Emily investigate the crime mysteries and enjoy the bonuses of Collector’s Edition! 
Enjoy replayable HOPs and mini-games, soundtrack, concept art, and more!

bluejetty:00035828:ios.description:
HealthGuard: Your Personal Health Companion — Every Heartbeat Matters
In the hustle of daily life, do you ever pause to listen to your own heartbeat? Health isn’t just a distant goal—it’s the state of every moment. With HealthGuard, managing your well-being has never been simpler or more intuitive.
Heart Health at Your Fingertips, Anytime, Anywhere
No extra devices needed. With just your iPhone, measure your heart rate in real time. Place your fingertip gently over the camera, and get accurate heart rate results in under 60 seconds. Whether tracking post-workout recovery or daily stress levels, monitor your heart anytime, anywhere—and make caring for your health a natural habit.
Breakthrough Feature: Precision GLP-1 Medication Management
Designed especially for the growing number of GLP-1 medication users, we offer industry-leading tracking tools:
- Complete Medication Log: Record date, time, drug name, dosage strength, and injection site
- Visual Injection Site Selector: An intuitive body map to mark injection points and avoid overuse of the same spot
- Smart Reminders: Get timely alerts based on your dosage schedule—never miss a dose again
- Outcome Tracking: Correlate medication data with health metrics to visualize treatment progress
Historical Data: Your Health Journey, Documented
Health is a continuous story—every data point is a meaningful chapter:
- Smart Trend Charts: Automatically generated for heart rate, blood pressure, glucose, and more
- Timeline Views: Review your health history by day, week, or month
Designed for Every Lifestyle
- Fitness Enthusiasts: Monitor workout heart rate and optimize training intensity
- Health-Conscious Individuals: Track chronic health indicators and proactively manage risks
- GLP-1 Users: Systematically manage medication routines for more precise treatment
- Everyday Wellness Seekers: Build awareness of your body and cultivate healthy habits
Disclaimer: This application is a non-medical product and should not be used to diagnose and treat any disease. Themeasured and recorded results should only be recorded as data and cannot be used in medical applications!
The app includes the following subscription options:
Annual subscription: $39.99/year
Weekly subscription:$9.99/week
Payment will be charged to your iTunes account at confirmation of purchase
-Subscription will automatically renew unless you cancel at least 24 hours before the end of the current subscription period- If you need to cancel your subscription, please go to your account settings to turn off auto-renewal.
Privacy:https://www.diwayc-tech.com/health-privacy
Terms of use:https://www.diwayc-tech.com/health/Terms
Subscription Terms:https://www.diwayc-tech.com/health/subscribe
Contact us:clean_heart23@outlook.com

Discover trending products with personalized recommendations. Nichebay's AI-driven engine suggests products tailored to your store’s niche, helping you stay ahead of market trends.

Personalize products with your logo, colors, and packaging using Nichebay’s intuitive branding tools, helping you build a unique and memorable brand identity.

Let Nichebay handle everything from order processing to packaging and shipping, allowing you to focus on scaling your business without the hassle.

Save time by processing multiple orders simultaneously. Nichebay’s bulk processing feature lets you manage large volumes of orders with just a few clicks.

Monitor your business on the go with real-time notifications for orders and inventory, giving you full control from your iPhone.

Easily connect your Shopify store with Nichebay. Sync products, orders, and inventory in real time to maintain a smooth and efficient workflow.
7.Full PC Client Features on Mobile:
Manage your entire dropshipping business from your iPhone. The Nichebay app includes almost all the functionalities of the PC client, allowing you to run your business anywhere, anytime.
8.User-Friendly Interface:
Nichebay is designed for simplicity and ease of use. Even if you’re new to dropshipping, the app’s intuitive interface makes managing your business straightforward and hassle-free.

bluejetty:00169666:ios.name: Crayola Adventures
bluejetty:00169666:ios.summary:
Step into the world of Crayola Adventures, where open-ended storytelling and adventure-style gameplay merge for ever-evolving experiences that bring your creativity and ideas to life. Your stories. Your rules.
*Winner of the Apple Design A
bluejetty:00169666:ios.description:
Step into the world of Crayola Adventures, where open-ended storytelling and adventure-style gameplay merge for ever-evolving experiences that bring your creativity and ideas to life. Your stories. Your rules.
*Winner of the Apple Design Awards 2024 for Inclusivity and 2024 NYX Game Awards in Mobile Games*
STORIES AS BIG AS YOUR IMAGINATION
Start a rock band. Or a pop band. Not your jam? Then go explore the outer limits of space on a rocket ship you create instead. Or do all of it! Challenge an evil genie. No wait… become his friend. Or turn him into a majestic blue giraffe! Design your ultimate bedroom to hang out with friends, or turn it into an evil lair. Rescue a robot and make him the hero. Or should the purple dragon who eats your dad’s stinky socks be the hero? Or maybe it’s the ice-cream headed lizard! Only you get to decide! After all, YOU are the mastermind behind stories only you can dream up.
Color, draw, paint, and craft your way through unique worlds: Real Life, Fantasy, Sci-Fi, and more. Create your own one-of-a-kind characters, personalize their journey, customize the scenes with your art, and determine how the narrative unfolds. Build your dream treehouse, fill your bookshelf with stories you write, collect trophies from your adventures, and unlock new rooms and items to tell even more tales!
DESIGN CHARACTERS & STORIES THAT ARE UNDENIABLY YOURS
• You’re the author, the illustrator, and the hero!
• Your creativity, art, and choices inspire the adventures you go on
• Create books from a variety of genres, settings, and story arcs… or invent your own
• Personalize your hero and their sidekicks to make them are as unique as you are – choose from thousands of combinations of hairstyles, skin color, accessories, and outfits
SAFE, SECURE & FUN FOR THE WHOLE FAMILY
• Players of all ages can be free to explore, create, and play with no in-app purchases
• Bond as a family imagining, creating, and reading stories together
• Use Share Play to share your adventures with friends and family
• Committed to ensuring children’s online privacy and safety, Crayola Adventures is COPPA and GDPR compliant
• Recommended by parents, loved by their kids
LEARN THROUGH GAMEPLAY
• Practice problem-solving and creative expression while having fun
• Build confidence in reading, writing and storytelling skills
• Support cognitive and fine motor development (grown-ups love that kind of stuff!)
• Dynamic voiceover brings players' inputs directly into the narration, empowering players of all reading levels
EXPRESS YOURSELF WITH UNLIMITED CREATIVE CHOICE
• Decide if your characters go to space, decorate their bedroom, fight dragons all day, or… The options are endless!
• Your choices mean every session can have a different ending. The princess gets eaten by the giant… or… the magical clouds give you flying powers?
• Design a world where your protagonist (whether it’s the alien or your best friend) feels at home in their cozy treehouse
SHOWCASE YOUR IDEAS WITH BEST-IN-CLASS DIGITAL CREATIVE TOOLS
• Craft extraordinary characters and illustrate customized worlds with an array of digital Crayola art tools
• Design your logo for your electro pop band, start a new fashion trend with your t-shirt design, draw the wallpaper for your bedroom… It’s your world to create!
CHECK OUT NEW CONTENT EACH MONTH
• Continue the never-ending excitement – ever-evolving content updates keep your inspiration flowing and ensure there’s something for everyone!
DEVELOPED IN PARTNERSHIP WITH RED GAMES CO.
• Red Games Co. is a boutique studio filled with a team of parents and educators who have a passion for providing players with the most polished, fun and engaging apps
• Named #7 on Fast Company’s Most Innovative Companies in Gaming for 2024
Privacy Policy: https://www.redgames.co/crayola-adventures-privacy-policy
Terms of Service: https://aut.crayocom.cloud.sitefinity.com/company/app-terms-of-use
Support: https://crayolaadventures.zendesk.com/hc/en-us

bluejetty:00154549:ios.description:
What Makes DeepEat AI Special?
1. Snap Once, Know It All: Full Meal Intel in 3 Seconds 
“What’s in this meal—and does it fit my goals?” → One snap tells all.
Scan any dish → instantly see calories, protein, carbs, fats + every key ingredient’s role.
Real-Life Magic:
- Scan a burger → “650 cal, 40g protein. Beef (300 cal，100g), bun (200 cal，70g).”
- Check a salad → “Chicken (200 cal,50g), lettuce (30 cal,40g), croutons (150 cal,60g).”
No second guesses—get the what and why in one tap.
2. Effortless Tracking with AI Smarts
“How do I improve?” → Let data guide your choices.
AI tracks your meals, exercise, and hydration—spots trends you’d never notice alone. Sync with Apple Health to track exercise, water intake, and weight trends on a sleek dashboard. Check your dashboard after lunch to see your meal’s calories, hydration progress, and steps all in one glance—no more app hopping.
3. “How Healthy Is This?” from Food Health Score
Get a 1-5 health score for every meal, powered by nutritional science. Your kale salad might score a 4.8, while that office donut barely hits 2.3—no bias, just facts.
4. Sustainable Weight Loss, Backed by Science
Track meals, exercise, and hydration in one tap—no spreadsheets, no stress. AI quietly maps your habits, showing how your choices add up over time.
 Here’s the magic:
 - Notice how swapping soda for sparkling water trims 500 calories a week—effortless wins add up.
 - Spot when your morning walks sync with lower dessert cravings—small changes, real impact.
 - Learn that adding 10g of protein to breakfast keeps you fuller longer.
 - With every insight, you’ll tweak smarter not harder.
5. All-in-One Wellness Dashboard
Widgets for weight, hydration, steps, and exercise sync seamlessly. Watch your progress unfold—whether it’s hitting your water goal 5 days straight or seeing your daily steps climb toward a new personal best.
---
How It Works
1. Snap: Take a photo of your meal.
2. Scan: AI detects food items and portions.
3. See:Get calories, nutrients, and a health score instantly
4. Sync: Connect apple Heath for holistic tracking.
5. Succeed: Hit health goals faster with AI-powered habits
---
Perfect For:
 Busy professionals | Fitness enthusiasts
 Parents managing family meals | Anyone tired of confusing nutrition labels!
Get Started Today—Your

bluejetty:00117673:ios.description:
The real experience to fly an airplane on Flight Simulator Xtreme! 
Prepare for more than 120 hours of game play including 5 different aircrafts and amazing Rio de Janeiro sightseeing!!! 
- 50 missions to play! 
- Exclusive missions depending on your aircraft! 
- 5 realistic airplanes 
- Cezna 172
- Boing 747 
- Boing 767 
- Aibus A380 
- Leerjet 45 
- Real airplane physics and instruments 
- 6 airports from International airports to small airports 
- International Airport of Antônio Carlos Jobim (SBGL) - Rio de Janeiro 
- International Airport of Santos Dumont (SBRJ) - Rio de Janeiro 
- Airport of Jacarepaguá (SBJR) - Rio de Janeiro 
- Airport of Cabo Frio (SBCB) - Cabo Frio 
- Airport of Maricá (SDMC) - Maricá 
- Airport of Saquarema (SDSK) - Saquarema 
- 5 different views: 
- Full plane 
- Cockpit 
- Passenger view, or "Wing view" 
- Nose view 
- Tower view 
Some technology provided by Nasa: 
- Realist terrain using Nasa’s photos and elevation. 
- Using Nasa’s utility FoilSim 3 to calculate the physics of the airplane (really realistic). 
- Scenario to play is really huge with more than 25,000 km square 
Play along 50 missions! 
- landing mission 
- take passengers from one airport to another. 
- Improved audio and controls. 
- Realistic graphics, environment and performance. 
- Enhanced shadows, more realistic game. 
The plane explodes when it crashes.. so be careful during your flight! 
Nice flight!

bluejetty:00026973:ios.summary:
Accurate. Powerful. Built for Truckers, RV, and Car.
Toll Calculator: Truck, RV & Car is built for professional drivers who need accurate toll estimates and streamlined International Fuel Tax Agreement (IFTA) compliance across the United S
bluejetty:00026973:ios.description:
Accurate. Powerful. Built for Truckers, RV, and Car.
Toll Calculator: Truck, RV & Car is built for professional drivers who need accurate toll estimates and streamlined International Fuel Tax Agreement (IFTA) compliance across the United States and Canada. Compare toll costs on up to three routes using Apple and Google routing data. Enter two addresses to instantly see toll fees, travel time, and distance.
Built for Commercial Trucks
• Enter detailed vehicle information including weight, height, axle count, trailer type, and dual tires
• Supports trucks up to 9 axles
• Also supports bus, RV, motorcycle, and passenger vehicles
• Multi-axle toll calculation for accurate commercial pricing
IFTA Compliance Hub
• Centralized dashboard for Equipment, Trips, Fuel Purchases, and Quarterly Reports
• One-tap import from route results to log Apple route mileage into IFTA
• Automatic state boundary detection and cross-quarter trip splitting
• Per-jurisdiction quarterly metrics: Miles, TG, TPG, and NTG
• Tap any jurisdiction to view detailed mileage and fuel records
HOS Trip Planner
• Plan route feasibility with your current Cycle, On-Duty, and Drive clocks
• Compare multiple planning strategies with reserve buffer controls
• See day-by-day plans and required recap guidance for non-reset scenarios
Route Weather Intelligence
• Weather score by route with checkpoint-level timeline
• Time-aware weather based on your planned departure time
• Surface risk factors like wind, precipitation, visibility, and severe conditions
Invoice Module
• Create and manage freight invoices with customer profiles
• Track line items, payments, totals, and balances
• Export professional PDF invoices from the app
Maximize Profit on Every Load
• Built-in load board calculator to evaluate profitability quickly
• Compare toll costs across multiple route options
• Choose different time slots for time-based toll roads
Complete US & Canada Toll Coverage
• Covers all toll roads in the United States and Canada, including 407 ETR
• Supports multiple payment methods and transponders such as E-ZPass, SunPass, FasTrak, TxTag, ExpressToll, KTag, EZ-Tag, TollTag, and Pay-By-Plate
Route Details at a Glance
• View toll booths directly on the map
• See distance and travel time for each route
• Calculate routes from your current location
• Send selected routes to Apple Maps or Google Maps for navigation
Important Disclaimer
Routes are generated using Apple and Google routing services. Some routes may include roads not suitable for large commercial vehicles. Always verify road restrictions before travel. Toll rates are estimates and may vary. This app is not affiliated with any tolling agency.
Terms of the in-app purchases:
Payment for in-app upgrades will be charged to your iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase. Subscriptions automatically renew unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period. Your iTunes Account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period, at the original subscription amount. Subscriptions may be managed by you and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to your iTunes Account Settings after purchase. Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription to that publication. Privacy Policy and Terms of Service are located at: http://www.infotalkcorporation.com/privacypolicy.html.

bluejetty:00182398:ios.description:
Playing Zen Match for 10 minutes a day sharpens your mind and prepares you for your daily life and challenges!

Sharpen your mind with a series of tile matching levels that gradually increase puzzle difficulty. Come back to it every day, as there are always new daily tile matching mahjong puzzles to explore, which allows you to care for your very own house plant and become a mahjong master!

bluejetty:00078994:ios.description:
Do you have access to Castlight through your employee benefits plan? If so, you and your dependents can download Castlight Mobile: a personal healthcare dashboard that helps you find affordable and high quality care, anytime, anywhere.
Key features:
Find care - Search for a doctor near you. Results are always in-network and include personalized cost estimates and quality data so you can make choices that are right for you.
Past care - Track your health care spending and claims with at-a-glance information about what you’ve spent and why.
Plan status - Track how much of your deductible you’ve met, see your HSA balance, and review basic information about your health coverage all in one place.
eCard - A medical insurance card is part of the app so you’ll never be without your insurance card again.
Please note:
The Castlight Mobile app is available exclusively to individuals and their dependents who have access to Castlight’s services through their employee benefits program. If you’re not sure if Castlight is part of your employee benefits, contact your employer’s HR or Benefits leader.
If available through employer, Castlight Health supports all major activity trackers including Apple Health, Fitbit, and Jawbone to conveniently synchronize your steps, food, and sleep data.
About Castlight:
Castlight Health is a trusted third party that connects directly to your insurance plan and does not share your personal information with your employer. Your health information is always confidential and secure.

bluejetty:00062778:ios.description:
#1 Music Practice Tool — trusted by Yamaha, Kawai, and ABRSM. Used by over 2 million musicians and hundreds of music schools worldwide.
Learn and Play your favorite pieces with Tomplay! Access thousands of sheet music titles with professional backing tracks for all instruments and levels.
——————————
WHY MUSICIANS PRACTICE WITH TOMPLAY
• Never play alone! Play along with high-quality audio recordings from professional musicians
• Mute your instrument, and play while the sheet music scrolls automatically on your screen with the music
• Slow down or speed up the tempo to adjust it to your level
• Note by note practice: The score advances only when you play the right note
• Smart page-turn mode: The app listens to your playing and turns the pages automatically (for piano)
• Record yourself and play back your performance to track your progress
• Add your own annotations directly on the score
• Print your music scores with annotations
• Loop a section until you’ve mastered it
• Integrated metronome and tuner
• And much more…
——————————
ALSO IDEAL FOR COMPLETE BEGINNERS
• Can’t read music notes yet? No problem — follow our Visual Guide to see the right notes and fingerings in real time
• Learn the notes at your own pace with real-time feedback
NEW — Learn piano or saxophone from scratch with your favourite songs: Tomplay Learn guides you step by step with short videos and interactive exercises.
——————————
ACCESS THOUSANDS OF MUSIC SHEETS WITH BACKING TRACKS
• Get instant access to 100,000+ sheet music titles and tabs
• Carefully arranged in 8 difficulty levels — from complete beginner to virtuoso
• Play music for 26 instruments: Piano, Violin, Flute, Saxophone (Alto, Tenor, Soprano, Baritone), Drums, Guitar (acoustic & electric), Bass, Cello, Trumpet (in B-flat, in C), Clarinet (in B-flat, in A, in C), Viola, Double Bass, Percussion, Ukulele, Accordion, Trombone (F-Clef, G-Clef), French Horn, Oboe, Harp, Bassoon, Tuba, Euphonium, Tenor Horn, Recorder (Soprano, Alto, Tenor), and Singing (including Choir). Also available for Bands & Ensembles
• Explore a vast selection of pieces across all genres — Classical, Pop, Rock, Metal, Folk, Jazz, Reggae, Rap & HipHop, R&B, Electro & House, Chrisitan Worship, Film & TV, Video Games, and more
• Play solo, in duet, trio, quartet, or with full orchestra or band accompaniment!
• Learn the basics of music theory with TomTheory, practice scales with professional accompaniments with the TomScales, and explore countless music exercises, lessons, and courses to improve your skills. 
• Play by ear and improvise with the TomImprov Mode, which shows only the chords on the music score
——————————
PRICING AND TERMS
Discover Tomplay with a 14-day free trial. During the trial, you’ll enjoy unlimited access to the entire catalogue — all instruments, all levels, on all your devices (smartphone, tablet, and computer).
Tomplay offers two subscription options:
• Auto-renewing monthly plan
• Auto-renewing yearly plan (includes the 14-day free trial)
Payment will be charged to the credit card connected to your iTunes Account when you confirm the initial subscription purchase. Subscriptions automatically renew unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current subscription period. Your account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period, and the cost of the renewal will be specified. You may manage your subscription and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to your Account Settings after the purchase. Any unused portion of a free trial period will be forfeited when you purchase a subscription, where applicable.
Terms of service: https://tomplay.com/ims/AppleTerms
Privacy policy: https://tomplay.com/ims/ApplePrivacy

Assign unique labels, manage contacts, customize settings, and stay on top of conversations without mixing messages. STAY CONNECTED ANYWHERE
Your DoCall phone number works from anywhere. Make international calls, send virtual SMS, or chat locally without worrying about carrier limitations. Perfect for travelers, online sellers, remote workers, or anyone who needs reliable communication that stays separate from their personal number.

bluejetty:00093524:ios.description:
Turn any photo of your room or backyard into a magazine-worthy redesign in seconds with Decor AI
Decor AI is the fastest way to visualize how your space could look before you spend a dime on furniture, renovation, or landscaping. Snap a picture, pick a style, and watch your home transform — inside and out.
Perfect for:
- Homeowners planning a renovation or full home remodel
- Renters looking for small-space decor ideas
- Backyard & garden lovers redesigning outdoor living
- First-time buyers visualizing an empty house
- DIY decorators who want to see it before they buy it
KEY FEATURES
- Instant AI Redesign — Interior
Upload a photo of any room — bedroom, living room, kitchen, bathroom, home office — and get a complete restyle in seconds.
- Instant AI Redesign — Exterior & Garden
Transform your backyard, front yard, patio, garden, or home facade. Try landscaping styles, outdoor furniture, pool decks, and planting layouts before a single shovel hits the ground.
- 30+ Design Styles, Indoor & Outdoor
Modern, minimalist, rustic, boho, Scandinavian, Japandi, industrial, mid-century, Mediterranean garden, tropical landscape, English cottage — find the aesthetic that fits your life.
- AI Design Chat (NEW)
Describe exactly what you want in plain English. Ask for a "cozy reading nook with warm lighting" or a "low-maintenance succulent garden" and watch the AI build it.
- Custom Prompts & Smart Recommendations
Dial in the exact colors, furniture, plants, and layouts you love. Save multiple versions and compare side by side.
- Save & Share
Build a moodboard, send designs to your partner, contractor, or landscaper, and get buy-in before you buy anything.
Subscription Information
Payment will be charged to your iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase. Subscriptions automatically renew unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can manage your subscription and turn off auto-renewal in your Account Settings.
Privacy Policy: https://www.fenixmobile.com/decor/privacy-policy
Terms of Use: https://www.fenixmobile.com/decor/terms-of-use

bluejetty:00088049:ios.summary: In Egypt Pyramid temple, there are lost treasure that full of gems and jewels. It's time for you to have a quest to find lost diamond and jewel in the ancient Pyramid with over 20 missions. Don't worry about hearts or Internet connection, i
bluejetty:00088049:ios.description:
In Egypt Pyramid temple, there are lost treasure that full of gems and jewels. It's time for you to have a quest to find lost diamond and jewel in the ancient Pyramid with over 20 missions. Don't worry about hearts or Internet connection, it's a simple rule brain classic game, so just enjoy match 3 jewelry fun with over 1200 levels and more to come!
HOW TO PLAY
* Match 3 jewels have the same color to collect them.
* Match 4 jewels to create lightning thunder gems. It can make a blast to destroy all jewel in a row or column.
* Match 5 jewels with T or L shape to create bomb gems. It can destroy all jewel around it.
* Match 5 jewels in a line to create special color diamond. It can destroy all jewel with the same color of selected gem.
* Combine 2 special booster diamonds together to make a big blast explosion!
FEATURES
* Fun and challenging quest in ancient Egypt Pyramid temple
* Addictive gameplay with over 500 levels in a legend world
* No heart life limits. Just enjoy the quest as much as you want!
* Easy to play, but later stages will challenge you.
* You can play this match 3 game without Internet.
* Colorful mysterious graphics, beautiful jewel and effect.
* Breaking the diamond and gems with nice sound!
* Take journey with the legend lion - a mythical Pharaoh character.
* A classic free game with new gameplay that anyone can play!
If you have any feedback about this match 3 game, please contact us: creativejoygames@gmail.com

bluejetty:00120175:ios.description:
How about opening a sandwich shop with chef Louie?
Use your favorite ingredients and make your very own original sandwiches! Make your shop popular by serving many sandwiches or decorating the shop as well as enjoy the story! Many addicting elements that keep you playing!
------------------
FEATURES
------------------
● A fun sandwich shop game with cute illustrations!
● Design a sandwich with your favorite ingredients!
● Plenty of seasonings to enrich your sandwiches!
● Get some decorations to add your personality to your shop!
● Improve your skill to make the best sandwich ever!
● Deliver your sandwiches to the farmer or grocery store to get new ingredients!
● Participate in the contest and win an item!
* Your original sandwiches
Choose the bread and fillings to design your original sandwiches! Tomato, lettuce, cheese, bacon, etc. Combination of your choice. Try the different variations! Put the sandwiches in a display case, and serve them to your customers!
* Customize your shop with decorations
Purchase window or signboard parts to decorate your store! Then, paint the walls with your favorite color! Combine your favorite parts to personalize your store!
* Train your skill with mini games!
Practice to improve your skill. The better you become, the more varieties of sandwiches you can cook!
* Challenge the quests and contests 
Go to the quest to deliver your sandwiches to the farmer or grocery store. You can unlock new ingredients if they like your sandwiches!
Win the sandwich contest and get gorgeous items that help your shop management!

bluejetty:00186589:ios.summary:
ATTENTION: Hello-Hello Complete is a free download exclusively to Hello-Hello subscribers to access the content from their mobile devices. Only Hello-Hello subscribers have access to our courses from this app.
Hello-Hello Complete offers:
bluejetty:00186589:ios.description:
ATTENTION: Hello-Hello Complete is a free download exclusively to Hello-Hello subscribers to access the content from their mobile devices. Only Hello-Hello subscribers have access to our courses from this app.
Hello-Hello Complete offers: 
Conversational Course: 30 conversational lessons based on real-life situations that will enable you to start communicating effectively from Lesson 1! 
Vocabulary: More then 1,000 vocabulary words with exercises to practice all skills you need: Read, Write, Speak, Listen! 
Access to both courses in 13 Languages: Spanish, English, French, Italian, German, Dutch, Portuguese, Hungarian, Chinese, Japanese, Russian, Indonesian and Hindi. 
Access to your courses from any mobile device and from the Web! 
Unique Mobile Immersion methodology developed in collaboration with The American Council on the Teaching of Foreign Languages - ACTFL 
LEARN FAST! 
Put your new language to use today! With Hello-Hello you can learn fast because it is: 
CONVENIENT: learn from your mobile device anytime, anywhere. 
EFFECTIVE: research-based innovative mobile immersion methodology that develops all skills you need at your own pace. 
RELEVANT: learn to communicate about real world topics. 
FUN: animated videos and interactive exercises. 
UNIQUE MOBILE IMMERSIONTM 
Hello-Hello’s innovative Mobile ImmersionTM methodology engages and encourages learners of all ages to acquire usable language skills quickly! 
Mobile ImmersionTM creates a unique VIRTUAL environment that GUIDES the learner VISUALLY to develop FUNCTIONAL language skills. 
Mobile Immersion is: 
VIRTUAL: Creates real-world animated situations in the new language. 
GUIDED: Builds new vocabulary and phrases to develop language skills. 
VISUAL: Conveys meaning with animation and game-like activities 
FUNCTIONAL: Develops the foundation for learners to put their new language skills to use in the real-world fast. 
________________________________________________________________________ 
App features: 
2 COURSES: Conversational and Vocabulary
13 LANGUAGES: All languages included: Spanish, English, French, Italian, German, Chinese, Japanese, Russian, Portuguese, Dutch, Hungarian, Hindi and Indonesian .
WORKS ON ALL DEVICES: Access the course from any mobile device & on the Web. 
RESEARCH-BASED METHODOLOGY: Developed in collaboration with ACTFL - The American Council on the Teaching of Foreign Languages, which is the largest and most respected association for language teachers and professionals. ACTFL's proficiency guidelines are followed by all major schools and universities in the U.S. 
LEARN TO COMMUNICATE: Learn to communicate effectively from LESSON 1! Hello-Hello offers 30 conversational lessons based on real-life situations rather then a collection of out-of-context words and phrases. 
INTERACTIVE ANIMATIONS AND COMIC STRIPS: Beautiful, fun animated lessons! Meet Paul, Mark and Ann! Follow them on a trip and have fun learning! 
PRACTICE ALL SKILLS: Games and exercises to practice Speaking, Writing, Reading and Listening skills! 
VOCABULARY BUILDING: Practice vocabulary with our innovative “Build Your Vocabulary” exercise where you can practice vocabulary in the context of a dialogue. Receive “WORD OF THE DAY” notifications to help you memorizing throughout the day. Practice individual words with our Basic Course featuring 7 different modules for learning. 
NOTES: Save your own notes from within the lessons to review later! 
LESSON REMINDERS: Don't worry about remembering to study. We will do that for you! 
TRACK YOUR PROGRESS: Track your lesson and course progress. 
USER-FRIENDLY INTERFACE: Intuitive interface with beautifully designed graphics.

bluejetty:00166364:ios.name: Screw up!
bluejetty:00166364:ios.summary:
Want to exercise your brain and solve challenging puzzles in a screw-themed game? Welcome to Screw Up! – the ultimate nuts and bolts puzzle adventure!
Test your puzzle-solving skills with complex screw challenges in the new Screw Up! It’s n
bluejetty:00166364:ios.description:
Want to exercise your brain and solve challenging puzzles in a screw-themed game? Welcome to Screw Up! – the ultimate nuts and bolts puzzle adventure!
Test your puzzle-solving skills with complex screw challenges in the new Screw Up! It’s not just about removing screws—it’s a test of your IQ, strategy, and patience.
Ready to become the master of screw puzzles? Take on the challenge now and explore this colorful and engaging screw puzzle world!
Challenge your mind with Screw Up!, an exciting logic puzzle game. Navigate through puzzles filled with screws and boxes, strategically deciding which screws to remove first. Plan carefully, as each move affects the game’s layout, ensuring smooth progression in this unique puzzle experience.
As you advance, face increasingly complex puzzles that will test your timing and strategic thinking. Master each level by placing every screw correctly, and unlock exciting new challenges along the way!
FEATURES 
Diverse Puzzle Layouts: • Progress through levels that ramp up in difficulty for a thrilling challenge! • Encounter a variety of screws and boxes—only the sharpest minds can solve these screw puzzles!
Helpful boosters: Use boosters to tackle the toughest puzzles when faced with tricky challenges.
User-Friendly Interface: Enjoy vibrant visuals, seamless animations, and immersive gameplay as you work through screw puzzle levels.
ASMR Experience: Beautiful design paired with satisfying sounds of screws and boxes. Immerse yourself in the tactile joy of unscrewing and solving each puzzle.
Test Your IQ: Challenge your brain with Screw Up! Strategize your moves and unlock rewards as you progress through intricate levels. Prove your puzzle-solving prowess today!
HOW TO PLAY 
• Unscrew each board in the correct sequence to clear the layers. 
• Strategically plan your moves to handle screws and boxes, and overcome all puzzle challenges. 
• Fill each box with screws of the same color to complete the levels and win. 
• Use boosters to unlock tough screws and handle challenging puzzles.
Experience the thrill of Screw Up!, where quick thinking and precise moves are key to solving each puzzle. Master the art of removing screws and maneuvering your way through challenging levels. Whether you’re testing your skills or enjoying casual play, this puzzle game offers fun for everyone. Download Screw Up! now and start unraveling puzzles!
