bluejetty:00071560:ios.name: The Game of Life 2
bluejetty:00071560:ios.summary: Prepare to live a thousand lives in The Game of Life 2, the award-winning official sequel to the classic board game played by millions around the world. Gather your friends and family and dive into a bright, fun 3D world bursting with adven
bluejetty:00071560:ios.description:
Prepare to live a thousand lives in The Game of Life 2, the award-winning official sequel to the classic board game played by millions around the world. Gather your friends and family and dive into a bright, fun 3D world bursting with adventure!
The Game of Life 2 base game has everything you need to get started: 
The Classic World board
3 x outfits unlocked
3 x avatars unlocked
2 x vehicles unlocked 
3 x additional outfits to unlock
3 x additional avatars to unlock
2 x additional vehicles to unlock 
Spin the iconic spinner and set off on your life journey. You’ll be presented with decisions at every turn, altering your life path. Will you go to college immediately or drive straight into a career? Will you get married or stay single? Have kids or adopt a pet? Buy a house? Make a career change? It’s up to you! 
Earn points for choices that bring you Knowledge, Wealth and Happiness. Win rich, maximise your Knowledge or Happiness, or go for a healthy mix of all three and come out on top!
HOW TO PLAY THE GAME OF LIFE 2:
1. When it’s your turn, spin the spinner to travel along your life path.
2. Depending on the space you land on, you’ll experience different life events and choices, such as buying a house, collecting your salary, or drawing an Action card! 
3. At crossroads, you’ll have to make big life decisions, so choose wisely!
4. Your turn ends; it’s the next player’s chance to spin the spinner!
FEATURES
- CUSTOMISE YOUR CHARACTER – Choose between the pink, blue or the purple peg. Select an outfit and make your peg your own. Browse a selection of cars, bikes and scooters and find a ride to suit your style. 
- NEW WORLDS – Live life in enchanted worlds! Every new world features new outfits, vehicles, jobs, properties and more! Buy worlds separately in-game, or buy the Ultimate Life Collection to unlock them all!
- UNLOCK NEW ITEMS – Unlock new outfits and vehicles by playing the game and earning rewards! 
- CROSS-PLATFORM – Join your friends and family, whichever platform they play on!
Live every life you’ve ever dreamed of in The Game of Life 2 – play today!

bluejetty:00174748:ios.name: Shape: Lose Weight, Fast
bluejetty:00174748:ios.summary:
Losing weight for good doesn’t need to be complex. A simple fasting guide in your pocket, Shape helps you conquer emotional eating and embrace simple fasting so you can lose weight naturally and be more aware of the food you eat.
Integrati
bluejetty:00174748:ios.description:
Losing weight for good doesn’t need to be complex. A simple fasting guide in your pocket, Shape helps you conquer emotional eating and embrace simple fasting so you can lose weight naturally and be more aware of the food you eat.
Integrative health and sustainable weight loss are about understanding the relationship between:
- Your body transformation
- Your mental health
- Your daily eating habits
Whether you want to stop stress eating, achieve holistic weight loss, explore intermittent fasting, or simply boost your vitality — reach your goals by making small, sustainable changes to your routine.
It’s not about punishing crash diets or obsessing over calories to achieve a weight loss goal. With Shape, you learn how to fast safely and naturally, aligning your eating windows with your body's rhythm. Build healthy habits and discover the freedom of time restricted eating to lose weight without feeling deprived.
Use the innovative in-app food diary to track your fasting windows and meals. Identify patterns between what you eat, your food cravings, and your weight loss progress. Make more mindful decisions and get practical binge eating help through a lens of self-compassion.
Making a true lifestyle change to support weight loss can feel overwhelming. We guide you through simple ways to integrate mindful eating and fasting into your daily life. Shedding weight and balanced eating becomes easy.
Listen to Your Body
Understand your body’s true cues of hunger and satiety so you can practice intuitive eating and respect what your body needs to feel its best. Move away from emotional eating, honor your fasting windows, and support both your physical and mental health.
Anchor Your Awareness
Recognize how various foods and fasting schedules impact your weight and mood by logging in your food journal and tracking patterns. Reconnect with your true appetite through mindful eating exercises. Add more awareness to your fasting routine and encourage yourself to make conscious choices.
Nourish Yourself Wisely
Discover the core pillars of a healthy lifestyle, even exploring concepts like biohacking your metabolism for weight loss. With Shape as your guide, fast and eat to nurture who you truly are. Take a holistic approach to your body transformation by finding ways to practice self-compassion daily.
Shape is from the creators of Fabulous, an award-winning app featured on Lifehacker, the New York Times, Self, Forbes, GirlBoss, and more. We’ve helped millions of people worldwide achieve their goals through the power of habits and routines. Now we are helping people adjust how they approach fasting and weight loss. By using behavior science, it becomes impossible not to succeed!
Fasting and eating “perfectly” is impossible. Instead, learn to make conscious, proactive choices toward a lighter, healthier you. We guide you on your weight loss journey toward nourishing yourself wisely with:
Fasting tracker and food journal: Stay accountable for your choices and identify patterns in your food diary. Explore your relationship with food, track your fasting timers, and become mindful of what’s supporting your weight loss and what needs to change. Appreciate the variety and beauty of the foods you eat with our innovative photo journal.
You are constantly evolving; it’s time to open the door of possibilities with Shape.
Go beyond simple weight loss: replace judgment with curiosity and exchange comparison for compassion. You do not need to be a certain weight or have a certain body type to deserve self-kindness. You already have a body to treasure.
Fast and eat well, but not to become worthy. Because you are already worthy, choose to nourish yourself well.
*add-on premium
------------------------------
Read our full terms and conditions and our privacy policy at: https://www.thefabulous.co/terms.html

bluejetty:00174924:ios.name: Forest Golf Planner
bluejetty:00174924:ios.summary:
Somewhere in suburbia is an unspoiled patch of greenery, a little slice of paradise... And starting today, it's your very own golf course!
No experience in golf or business? No problem! It's easy to get started building new fixtures and at
bluejetty:00174924:ios.description:
Somewhere in suburbia is an unspoiled patch of greenery, a little slice of paradise... And starting today, it's your very own golf course!
No experience in golf or business? No problem! It's easy to get started building new fixtures and attracting your first customers.
Rise through the ranks, and you'll be able to expand your course to include new holes. Change the landscape and add unique decorations to make the course your own!
Every year, courses from across the country are ranked from worst to best - can you come out on top?
As time goes on, you'll get approached by teams of golfers looking for a place to hold their next tournament. Do a good job, and they might just stick around and become regular customers!
When it comes to creating something really engaging, challenge is the name of the game. A tricky hole can be just what your golfers need to improve their skills. Really satisfied customers may even sign up for club membership, and who knows what will happen if you fulfill all your members' special requests?
No golf course is complete without its clubhouse. Install gift shops, eateries, and more - you'll be running a large-scale operation before you know it. Create the perfect place for customers to relax after playing a few rounds. Maybe you'll attract new customers and make master golfers of them!
The sun is shining, the grass is green, and the fairway is calling. Get out there and build the course of your dreams. Fore!
Supports drag to scroll and pinch to zoom.
Try searching for "Kairosoft" to see all of our games, or visit us at https://kairopark.jp
Be sure to check out both our free-to-play and our paid games!
Kairosoft's pixel art game series continues!
Follow us on Twitter for the latest Kairosoft news and information.
https://twitter.com/kairokun2010

bluejetty:00024854:ios.description:
Jigsaw Puzzles Hexa is a fun, addictive, and challenging new brain game you can play at home or on the go! Simply drag hexagon blocks to solve jigsaw puzzles across a variety of beautiful high-quality images. It's easy to play but hard to master. Think you're up to the challenge?
Jigsaw Puzzles Hexa is a new take on the jigsaw picture puzzle, and so far, everyone is loving it! Your goal is simple: move hexa blocks on the screen to match picture pieces on the board. Fit the right shapes and you'll complete the level, but keep in mind it won't always be easy!
There are tons of beautiful HD jigsaw puzzles to solve in this addictive game, including animal jigsaw puzzle packs, nature images, abstract shapes, and so much more. Jigsaw Puzzles Hexa is suitable for kids and adults alike, so you can download this free block puzzle game and enjoy it with the whole family!
Here are just a few reasons why you'll love this game:
- Easy and relaxing puzzles to solve
- Challenging levels when you want to train your brain
- Multiple different gameplay modes to try out
- New free jigsaw puzzles every day
- Multiple achievements to unlock and earn
- Real-time online multiplayer jigsaw puzzles
- Hints to help you in case you get stuck
- Offline game mode
- No time limit options
Playing puzzle game is an excellent way to sharpen your brain or simply to relax! With over 1,000 jigsaw puzzles to choose from and free daily jigsaw puzzles, the possibilities are endless. You can also participate in our weekly jigsaw puzzle tournaments for free prizes, free jigsaw puzzles, free coins, and more!
Jigsaw Puzzles Hexa is addictive and loads of fun for everyone. Play, drag, and solve hexa block puzzles all day long. It's free, after all!

bluejetty:00066007:ios.name: Grim Soul: Survival Magic RPG
bluejetty:00066007:ios.summary:
STEP INTO THE DARKNESS
• Explore a Dark and Mysterious World
Step into the Plaguelands – a cursed realm where death is never far. Every forest hides a threat, every ruin breathes with old magic, and no path is truly safe. Discover long-aba
bluejetty:00066007:ios.description:
STEP INTO THE DARKNESS
• Explore a Dark and Mysterious World
Step into the Plaguelands – a cursed realm where death is never far. Every forest hides a threat, every ruin breathes with old magic, and no path is truly safe. Discover long-abandoned castles, forbidden temples, and ancient altars buried in shadow.
• Enter the Challenging Dungeons
Beneath the surface lie ever-changing dungeons filled with traps, cursed guardians, and powerful relics. Each descent is a risk – few return, and none return unchanged.
• Follow Quests and Uncover Secrets
Ravens bring whispers of danger and reward. Track forgotten letters and torn scrolls to uncover the truth behind the Gray Decay – but beware, some truths are guarded for a reason.
SURVIVE AND BUILD
• Survive and Craft
Gather resources, hunt, and craft everything from weapons and armor to tools and supplies. Hunt wild beasts before they hunt you, and scavenge ruins for rare components. Each crafted item is a small step toward survival.
• Build a Fortress
Raise your walls high – this world will try to break them. Fortify your shelter against waves of the undead, enemy raiders, and things that roam the night. Only the well-prepared survive.
FIGHT AND JOIN FORCES
• Engage in Tactical Combat
Fight for your life with weapons forged by your own hands. Every swing counts. Time your strikes, dodge with precision, and face enemies who don’t feel pain or fear.
• Join a Clan
Face the Plaguelands alone and you’ll fall. Join forces with others, share strength and supplies, and stand together against the darkness. Some battles can’t be won alone.
Grim Soul is a free-to-play action game, but it contains in-game items that can be purchased. You must be at least 13 years of age to download this game and begin your adventures in Grim Soul. Your strategy for survival will determine everything. Begin your journey and become a hero in a brutal game for fearless warriors.
Terms of Use: https://brickworksgames.com/terms-of-service

bluejetty:00149663:ios.description:
Upromise is the free cash back shopping and rewards app that lets you earn cash for college. Get a $5.29 bonus just for joining. Link any 529 college savings plan to your Upromise account and get an additional $25 bonus. 
Additionally, every month Upromise awards a free $529 college scholarship to five lucky members.
Shop Online. 
Shop at your favorite stores. Upromise offers cash back at hundreds of popular retailers brands, including Kohl's, Macy's, Home Depot, and all your other favorite stores. On top of the cash back rewards, you can save up to 60% on your online retail purchase with exclusive coupon codes and promo codes. 
Scan those Sales Slips. 
Scan your store receipts, earn cash back rewards. Shopping trips at the mall. Gas station runs. Supermarket hauls. Earn cash back bonuses for purchasing featured products or brands. Get paid for the shopping you're already doing. You'll never toss your receipt again. 
Save Easy, Sleep Easy. 
Upromise makes it painless and easy to save for college. Eligible funds in your Upromise account are automatically transferred to your 529 college savings account every month (subject to a minimum transfer requirement). So easy. But it's definitely not set it and forget it. You'll love watching your college savings grow.
UPROMISE APP FUNCTIONALITY 
If you're already a Upromise member, you'll want to download the app. Rewards at your fingertips. Track your pending rewards, online store visits, and total rewards balance right from your phone. 
ABOUT UPROMISE 
Founded in 2000, Upromise helps families save money for college. Members who join the free Upromise rewards program can accrue cash rewards on eligible purchases that are applied to their linked college savings account. 
Since 2000, families have saved over $1 billion for college using Upromise. And every month, Upromise awards thousands of dollars in college scholarship money. 
WHICH 529 PLANS ARE COMPATIBLE WITH UPROMISE? 
All of them. You can link any 529 college savings plan to the Upromise rewards platform. Upromise is the only rewards service that can be linked to every single 529 savings plan. You can also link ABLE (special needs) plans to the Upromise platform as well. 
WHAT IF I DON'T HAVE A 529 PLAN? CAN I STILL JOIN AND BENEFIT FROM UPROMISE? 
Yes. If you don't have a 529 plan, think about opening one -- they are a great way to save for college with tax advantages. But if you don't have a 529 plan and don't want to open one, no problem! You can still join and participate in Upromise's rewards program just by linking to any U.S. checking or savings account. 
WHAT STORES GIVE CASH BACK REWARDS FOR UPROMISE? 
There are hundreds of online stores that participate in Upromise to offer cash back on your shopping. Some of the more popular retailers include: 
Home Depot
Old Navy
Kohl's
Staples
Best Buy
eBay
Chewy.com
Orbitz

Macy's
Aerie 
Bed Bath & Beyond
Bloomingdale's 
Dick's Sporting Goods
GameStop
J. Crew
Janie and Jack 
Shutterfly 
LEGO 
PetSmart 
ULTA Beauty
Minted 
...and hundreds more! 
IS UPROMISE WORTH IT? 
Absolutely. Upromise has helped families save over $1 billion for college. Read about Upromise in the news. Forbes, Clark Howard, The Dough Roller, New York Times, Nerd Wallet, Boston Globe, and U.S. News & World Report all rave about Upromise as a simple way to save for college. 
WHAT OTHER APPS ARE LIKE UPROMISE? 
Upromise is similar to other cash back and savings apps like Drop, Rakuten, Swagbucks, InboxDollars, Tada, Ibotta, Shopkick, Ascensus READYSAVE 529, CalSavers, Cashback for College, Digit, and Gift 529. If you use any of these other apps, give Upromise a try. You'll get $25 for free just for linking your 529 savings plan.

bluejetty:00149474:ios.name: Off Road Champion
bluejetty:00149474:ios.summary: Off Road Champion is an exhilarating and action packed off road racing mobile game that puts intense competition right at your fingertips. Strap yourself in and prepare to conquer extreme terrain, race against players from around the world,
bluejetty:00149474:ios.description:
Off Road Champion is an exhilarating and action packed off road racing mobile game that puts intense competition right at your fingertips. Strap yourself in and prepare to conquer extreme terrain, race against players from around the world, and compete in daily tournaments where you can win real cash and crypto rewards.
One of the core features of Off Road Champion is the ability to select and customize your own off road 4x4 vehicle. From monster trucks to rugged SUVs, you have a wide range of machines built for domination. Upgrade engine performance, suspension systems, tires, boost power, and visual styles to create a vehicle perfectly tuned for brutal conditions and high stakes racing.
When you launch the game, you can choose the country you represent and race under your national flag. Test your skills against a global community of drivers as you battle for leaderboard rankings and tournament victories. Prove your precision, timing, and control as you climb toward becoming the ultimate off road champion.
With more than 40 thrilling levels, Off Road Champion delivers a diverse lineup of environments designed to challenge every aspect of your driving ability. Tear through dense jungles, cross scorching deserts, maneuver around lava fields, carve through snowy mountain passes, blast through forests, and survive hazardous obstacle filled tracks that demand both speed and strategy.
Real time multiplayer racing lets you go head to head with competitors across the world. Enter daily tournaments, bracket style competitions, and skill based matchups to earn rewards and climb global rankings. Victories can translate into real world payouts, giving every race real consequences and serious excitement.
Stay connected with the community through in game chat. Share strategies, trade tips, celebrate victories, and challenge rivals as you build your reputation among off road racers worldwide.
Off Road Champion features an innovative rewards system that allows top performers to win real cash and crypto on a daily basis through tournaments and competitive events. Out drive your opponents, dominate the dirt, and turn your racing talent into tangible prizes.
Get behind the wheel and prepare for the ride of a lifetime in Off Road Champion. Master extreme terrain, compete in daily tournaments, race players across the globe, and prove you have what it takes to rule the off road racing world.

bluejetty:00095315:ios.name: Crazy 8: Card game
bluejetty:00095315:ios.summary: Relive the timeless fun of Crazy Eights, the beloved classic card game, now on your mobile device! Get ready to shed your cards and outsmart your opponents in this easy-to-learn yet surprisingly strategic game. Perfect for quick plays, fami
bluejetty:00095315:ios.description:
Relive the timeless fun of Crazy Eights, the beloved classic card game, now on your mobile device! Get ready to shed your cards and outsmart your opponents in this easy-to-learn yet surprisingly strategic game. Perfect for quick plays, family game nights, or challenging AI opponents anytime, anywhere.
The Goal is Simple: Be the first player to empty your hand by matching the rank (number) or suit (color) of the previous card on the discard pile. But watch out for those tricky Eights!
Why You'll Love Crazy Eights - Classic Card Fun:
- Classic & Intuitive Gameplay: If you know Crazy Eights, you'll feel right at home. If you're new, you'll pick it up in minutes!
- Play Your Way:
- Challenge our smart AI opponents with adjustable difficulty levels. Perfect for practicing your strategy or a quick solo game.
The Power of Eights: Play an Eight at any time and declare the next suit to be played – a game-changing move!
- Special Action Cards (Optional Rules): Spice things up with popular action cards like Skip, Reverse, and Draw Two to add an extra layer of excitement and strategy. (Customize which action cards are in play!)
- Customisable Experience
- Choose from different card deck designs.
- Select beautiful backgrounds and themes.
- Adjust game rules to your preferred way of playing (e.g., penalty points for leftover cards).
- Clean & Clear Visuals: Enjoy large, easy-to-read cards and a user-friendly interface, making gameplay smooth and enjoyable for everyone.
- Track Your Progress: Monitor your stats, achievements, and climb the leaderboards (when online multiplayer is active).
- Fun for Everyone: A fantastic game for kids, adults, and families to enjoy together.
- Regular Updates: We're committed to bringing you new features, themes, and improvements!
How to Play:
- Each player is dealt a hand of cards (typically 7 or 8).
- The remaining cards form the draw pile, and one card is flipped face-up to start the discard pile.
- Players take turns matching the top card on the discard pile by either rank or suit.
- If a player cannot play a card, they must draw one card from the draw pile.
Eights are wild! Play an Eight and choose the suit for the next player.
The first player to get rid of all their cards wins the round!
Whether you're a seasoned pro or new to the game, Crazy Eights - Classic Card Fun offers endless entertainment.
Download NOW and get ready to shout "Crazy Eight!"

bluejetty:00132393:ios.description:
ProDex is the ultimate Pokédex companion, offering fast, offline access to all data from all games, from Pokémon Red & Blue up to the latest releases, including Pokémon Legends: Z-A and Pokémon Champions. With everything in one place and always up-to-date, ProDex ensures you are ready to catch 'em all and lead the most epic battles. Use our advanced features, such as the Team Builder and customizable Checklists, and enjoy a deeper, more fun way to play.
ADVANCED FEATURES
————————————
ProDex is a Pokédex, and much more. Enjoy exclusive features, whether you're battling competitively or hunting every rare Pokémon and Shiny:
→ Ultimate Team Builder
Design, analyze, and save teams for VGC, single-player, or casual play. Check type weaknesses and stat spreads instantly for your entire team.
→ Catch Checklists (Including Shinies)
Track your Pokédex progress across all Pokémon games and never lose sight of your Shiny Hunts and collection goals.
→ Regional or National Pokédex
Choose the game you are currently playing to only see data specific to that game, or browse all data from all games without switching between versions using the National Pokédex mode.
→ Complete Offline Mode
Access all application data, even without an Internet connection. Perfect for playing on the go.
→ Advanced Filters
Find any Pokémon, Attack, TM, or Item instantly using highly customized search filters.
→ Advanced Type Chart
Complete analysis tool for every single-type and double-type matchup.
→ iOS Optimized Design
Enjoy a native and beautiful user interface, optimized for the latest Apple devices and style guidelines.
→ Dark Mode
Optimized UI for comfortable, late-night gaming sessions.
ALL GAMES, ALL DATA
————————————
ProDex provides all Regional Pokédexes and a Complete National Pokédex with easy-to-read information on all these elements:
→ Pokémon
→ Stats
→ Evolutions
→ Moves
→ Locations
→ Catch Rates
→ TMs (Technical Machines)
→ Abilities
→ Natures
→ Items (Held, Battle, Key)
→ Egg Groups
→ Move Tutors
→ Gym Leaders, Elite 4, and Champions Battle Teams
→ Tera Raid information
→ And more…

Over 10 million foresters have chosen the idle relaxing game [ Forest Island ], a sanctuary for animal and nature lovers. 
Beautiful nature and cute animals are always by your side,
whenever your exhausted heart by anxiety and stress needs rest.
Relax and chill with the cute baby animals,
and experience stress relief, happiness growing various natural habitats at your own pace.
With all the adorable animals and birds that live in the sky, the sea, and the forest,
we hope you find joy and peace in this relaxing idle relaxing games created especially for you.
[ Game Features ]
1. Over 100 types of animals and birds including rabbits, cats, ducks, and raccoons.
Collect and bond with over 100 different animals and birds, such as rabbits, cats, ducks, and raccoons, from all natural environments including the sky, sea, and forest, to create precious memories.
(Continual updates will introduce new types of animals and birds.)
2. Our precious natural world is threatened by climate change, environmental pollution, and the risk of animal extinction.
Clear debris washed up by the sea and gather hearts and vitality from animals, birds, and forests to grow your island.
Add a variety of natural habitats like forests, lakes, meadows, boulders, coastlines, plateaus, cliffs, and jungles to enrich your own island.
3. Relaxing peaceful BGM music and natural ASMR sounds that calm the mind.
Enjoy a relaxation mode with comfortable healing background music and natural ASMR sounds like the ocean, rain, wind, water, and bird calls, which help alleviate stress and provide mental stability.
Escape the hustle and stress of city life and take a moment to heal with the scenery of flowers and trees bathed in warm sunlight.
4. An idle relaxing simulation game that is easy for anyone to play and continues to grow even when left alone.
An easy-to-play idle calming cozy games that lets you enjoy the beautiful scenery of a growing forest and island at your own pace, even when you're not actively playing.
■ Official Instagram
Follow Forest Island's official Instagram for special events, the latest news, and various animal relaxing content.

bluejetty:00031828:ios.name: Block Match - Blast Game
bluejetty:00031828:ios.summary: Tired of ads interrupting your gameplay? Say hello to Block Match - An addictive and totally ad-free block puzzle game that you can enjoy anytime, anywhere. Sit back, relax and blast colorful blocks in this simple yet challenging game desig
bluejetty:00031828:ios.description:
Tired of ads interrupting your gameplay? Say hello to Block Match - An addictive and totally ad-free block puzzle game that you can enjoy anytime, anywhere. Sit back, relax and blast colorful blocks in this simple yet challenging game designed to sharpen your mind and give you endless fun. 
It is one of the most popular yet challenging fun games that doesn’t need internet connection to play. Block Match can surely be your perfect companion! Match and combine blocks, clear multiple lines at once, and set unbeatable high scores. Block Match is a game for everyone, combining fun, strategy, and relaxation into one colorful, addictive experience. Whether you're commuting, relaxing at home, or looking for a quick break, this game will keep you entertained for hours. 
How to Play: 
 - Drag and drop blocks onto the grid. 
 - Complete a row or column to clear it. 
 - Meet the level requirements, such as number of blocks to blast, stars/gems to collect. 
 - Collect puzzle pieces to complete the canvas and receive the rewards. 
 - Make combos by clearing multiple rows and columns for extra points. 
 - Use powerup’s whenever you need to clear some obstacles. 
 - Play endlessly to see how high you can score! 
Game Features:
 - No Ads: Enjoy uninterrupted gameplay with zero ads. 
 - Completely Free: Play offline or online without any costs. 
 - Simple Controls: Just drag, drop, and blast the blocks! 
 - No Time Pressure: Play at your own pace—perfect for relaxation or a quick mental challenge. 
 - Brain Training: Keep your mind sharp with this strategic puzzle game. 
 - Fun for All Ages: Designed for everyone, from casual players to puzzle masters. 
 - Powerups: Use them to clear your way to the finish point.

bluejetty:00200195:ios.description:
Requires an iPhone running iOS 18 or later, paired with Apple Watch running watchOS 11 or later.
Turn wrist motion into music.
Pretend Piano lets you play your music on Apple Watch with gestures. Strum for guitar, move your wrist like a bow for violin, or gently tap a tabletop to play piano.
THREE WAYS TO PLAY
• Guitar: gently move your wrist up and down to strum chords.
• Violin: move your wrist side to side to play notes with bow-like gestures.
• Piano: gently tap a tabletop near your watch wrist to play the next note.
MAKE AND SEND SONGS
Use iPhone to enter numbered notation, arrange notes and chords, Check and edit the result, then send your song to Apple Watch.
PLAY ON YOUR WRIST
Motion processing and instrument sounds run locally on Apple Watch. No account is required. Your iPhone does not need to be nearby while you play.
Use gentle movements and taps, and keep a steady rhythm.

bluejetty:00061614:ios.description:
We are pleased to offer you an effortless tool that makes it even easier to manage your account! Our free app provides you convenience at your fingertips. With just a few, simple clicks of a button, you can instantly view and pay your bill, report an outage and submit a meter read – and that’s not all!
Designed for you...
- Pay your bill with just the click of a button!
- With secure, Touch or Face ID access, you‘ll be able to view your real-time account balance, payment due date and balance details without entering your account number every time!
- Easily report an outage, see your estimated time of restoration and access outage lists and maps to stay informed.
- Submit a meter read at your convenience – there’s even a flashlight to help you read the meter!
On the go...
- Enroll in eBill for online access and convenience and view up to 13 months of bills!
- Sign up for AutoPay so your payments can be made automatically, securely, and on time every month.
- Enroll in Budget Billing so you’ll always know how much your bill will be!
-Sign up for Outage Alerts and stay informed if your power goes out. You will also receive notifications with the latest information about your power outage so you can plan.
-Enroll in Meter Read Reminder Alerts and receive a convenient reminder to read your meter on months we’re scheduled to estimate your energy usage. 
- Update your account profile (email address, mailing address and phone number) and manage your personal preferences.

bluejetty:00156612:ios.description:
WOSU Public Media App: 
The WOSU App allows you to watch and listen to all of WOSU’s programs, Radio and TV!
The app provides On-Demand content of all your favorite shows, live streaming of the radio channels, PBS Kids! content with parental controls, easy access to the live Radio and TV program schedule plus the ability to explore additional content!
Live Streaming
• DVR-like controls (pause, rewind, and fast forward). You can pause the live stream to have a conversation and pick up right where you left off. Or rewind to catch a comment you just missed!
• Listen to live streams from WOSU even while traveling! Start the app and your favorite station starts playing. Watch PBS programs easily from your device, no matter where you are.
• Integrated WOSU TV and Radio program schedules
• One click stream switching – flip over to the program you noticed on another channel with a single click.
• Listen to WOSU in the background while browsing the web or catching up on your emails!
On Demand
• Access WOSU’s programs easily and quickly.
• DVR-like controls. Pause, rewind and fast forward your program with ease. 
• When accessing programs, individual segments (when available) are listed so you can review and choose one or listen/watch the entire program.
• Easy to access past programs.
• The WOSU Public Media App displays the web page associated with the program or program segment you are listening to On Demand so you can explore for more information.
Additional features
• Easily share stories and programs with family and friends via the “Share” button.
• A built in Sleep Timer and Alarm Clock allows you to go to sleep and wake up to your favorite station.
The WOSU Public Media App is brought to you by the people at WOSU and Public Media Apps. We work to provide our valued listeners with great solutions to find what you want, when you want it, and where you want it.
Please support WOSU Public Media by becoming a member today!
http://www.wosu.org
http://www.publicmediaapps.com

bluejetty:00139819:ios.summary:

The following functions are available in the IONOS Mobile App:
• Use and manage your IONOS prod
bluejetty:00139819:ios.description:
With the IONOS Mobile App, you always have an eye on the success of your website and can access your IONOS products at any time from anywhere.
The following functions are available in the IONOS Mobile App:
• Use and manage your IONOS products from your mobile device
• Register new domains and manage your existing domains
• Edit your MyWebsite directly in the app
• Check the performance of your website with IONOS WebAnalytics (if available in your contract)
• Keep track of your invoices
• Check and update your user settings
• Protect your IONOS account with 2-Step Verification
• Answer all of your questions in the extensive IONOS Help Center. 
Right from the start, you can find everything you need to know about succeeding online. In addition to tips and tricks from the IONOS world and information about your contracts, you can also view the visitor statistics of your website at any time. From the home page, you can log in directly to my IONOS or edit your MyWebsite.
UPDATE CONTACT DETAILS
———
You can check and update your contact information right in the app so you don't miss any important information we send you.
MANAGE INVOICES
———
In the Invoice Overview, you can view your invoices and save them directly onto your device, send them by email, or print them out.
EDIT YOUR MYWEBSITE
———
Wherever you are, your website editor is always with you and ready to go. Take a picture with your smartphone, upload it to your website, enter any relevant text, and publish it. It's never been easier.
REGISTERING & ADMINISTRATING DOMAINS
———
You have an idea for a new project and want to secure your domain? Use the IONOS Domain Checker to check the availability of your desired domain name. If you have already registered your desired domain, you can manage it right after logging in at IONOS.
MORE SECURITY THROUGH 2-STEP VERIFICATION
———
Activate in your IONOS account the “2-Step Verification through the IONOS Mobile App”. We will then send you a one-time notification each time you log in through the app. Simply confirm and you will be securely logged in. This is how you conveniently and effectively protect your IONOS account against cybercriminals.
HELP & SUPPORT
———
Need help using your IONOS product or have any additional questions? Search for solutions in our comprehensive Help Center or contact us directly.
WE IMPROVE OUR PRODUCTS AND THE OUTPUT OF OUR PRODUCTS
———
Unfortunately, not all functions have been optimized for mobile use yet. We are working hard to make more IONOS products available for you on the app!
Please Note: The functionality of the app depends on the IONOS products you are using.

bluejetty:00072611:ios.name: Assembly Line 2
bluejetty:00072611:ios.summary:
Welcome to Assembly Line 2, the sequel to the factory-building and managing game.
Assembly Line 2 combines elements from idle and tycoon games. Make the most money by using different types of machines to build an assembly line to craft res
bluejetty:00072611:ios.description:
Welcome to Assembly Line 2, the sequel to the factory-building and managing game.
Assembly Line 2 combines elements from idle and tycoon games. Make the most money by using different types of machines to build an assembly line to craft resources and sell them. Unlock upgrades to make it more efficient and expand your factory.
The goal is simple, build resources and sell them. Starting with a few machines and very basic resources, and using them with more advanced machines to craft and create more complex resources.
Your factory will continue generating money even when you are offline. When you return to the game you will have piles of money waiting for you, but don't spend it all in one place!
While Assembly Line 2 is an idle game, because you make the layout of your factory, it is up to you to optimize it to make the most money possible.
Don't worry if you get lost with all those machines to build, the game offers an information menu so you can see what each machine does at any time. It also offers information on each resource price, so you can make decisions on what to craft. You can also see stats on the amount you are producing.
Features:
- 21 different machines to build and optimize the best factory.
- Tons of upgrades to increase productivity.
- Around 50 different unique resources to craft.
- Multi-language support.
- Backup your progress.
- No internet required.

bluejetty:00164519:ios.description:
Simplify Your Weight Loss Journey – Track Smarter with ProTracker! Your health starts with what you eat, and ProTracker makes it easier than ever to stay on track with your goals. Whether you're counting calories, setting macronutrient goals, or managing food scores, ProTracker gives you all the tools you need to achieve lasting results.
Did you know that consistently logging your meals is one of the most effective ways to manage your weight? Download ProTracker now and take the guesswork out of your health journey with features that simplify tracking, keep you motivated, and help you reach your goals—faster!
• • •
Why ProTracker?
• COMPREHENSIVE FOOD DIARY: Log meals, snacks, and drinks with ease using our intuitive food diary. Track using Calories, Kilojoules, and other Food Score systems.
• PERSONALIZED NUTRITION GOALS: Set and track custom macronutrient (fat, carbs, and protein) and micronutrient goals to fit your unique diet, whether your diet is keto, high-protein, low-carb, fasting, or just counting calories. Visually compare your daily tracking against your goals.
• APPLE HEALTH DATA EXPORT: Sync your daily nutrient data straight to Apple Health.
• SEAMLESS INTEGRATIONS: Sync effortlessly with Apple Health, Apple Watch, Fitbit, and more to keep all your health data in one place.
• EXTENSIVE FOOD DATABASE: Search for groceries and restaurant meals, or scan barcodes for instant tracking.
• QUICK ADD FOR BUSY DAYS: Short on time? Use Quick Add to log calories or macros directly—no detailed entry needed!
• ADVANCED WEIGHT TRACKING: Track your weight loss or gain with easy-to-read progress charts and trend analyses.
• CREATE & SHARE RECIPES: Build recipes and meals from scratch, group ingredients, and share them with family and friends.
• SUPPORT FOR NURSING MOTHERS: Tailor your nutrition and calorie tracking with options specifically designed for nursing and supplemental nursing mothers, helping all women meet their dietary needs while supporting their baby's health.
• DARK MODE SUPPORT: Customize your app experience with Dark Mode.
• CUSTOM REMINDERS: Stay consistent with personalized reminders to track meals, log weight, or stay hydrated.
• SECURE MULTI-DEVICE SYNC: Automatically back up and sync your data across all your devices for added convenience.
ProTracker is not just easy to use—it's your all-in-one solution for smarter, more accurate food tracking, designed for lasting results. With customizable settings and flexible tracking options, ProTracker adapts to your lifestyle, whether you’re counting calories, following a specific diet, or simply aiming for better health.
Download now and start your journey toward a healthier you!
• • •
Questions or feedback? We’d love to hear from you! Reach out at support@protrackerapp.com or follow us on X @protrackerapp.
About Premium plan billing:
If you upgrade to Pro plan, payment will be charged to your iTunes account, and your account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period. You can choose to be billed monthly or yearly. You can turn off auto-renew in your Apple ID Account Settings any time after purchase.
• Family Sharing: Share your premium subscription with up to five family members for no extra cost!
• Priority Support: Get faster responses and premium support from our customer service team.
View our full terms & conditions at https://www.protrackerapp.com/terms-of-use

FFPC offers STANDARD, BEST BALL, VICTORY POINTS and SUPERFLEX formats in both REDRAFT and DYNASTY leagues with LIVE and SLOW drafts available daily.

bluejetty:00086538:ios.description:
كاشف الارقام — التطبيق الأذكى لكشف هوية المتصل ومعرفة صاحب أي رقم مجهول
مرحباً بك في "كاشف الارقام"، التطبيق الأسرع والأدق لكشف هوية المتصل ومعرفة من يقف خلف أي رقم مجهول. هل سئمت من المكالمات المزعجة، أرقام التسويق، ومحاولات الاحتيال الهاتفي؟ مع كاشف الارقام أصبح بإمكانك معرفة هوية المتصل، لتبقى دائماً في أمان وسيطرة كاملة على هاتفك.
تطبيق كاشف الارقام يوفّر لك بحثاً شاملاً وفورياً عبر جميع شبكات الاتصالات الرئيسية، ليمنحك أدق نتيجة خلال ثوانٍ معدودة. سواء كان الرقم تجارياً، شخصياً، أو مصدراً للإزعاج، فإن كاشف الارقام يكشفه لك بكل سهولة ووضوح.
لماذا يختار آلاف المستخدمين كاشف الارقام؟
• كشف فوري لهوية المتصل
أدخل أي رقم ويعرض لك كاشف الارقام اسم صاحبه فوراً، لن تحتار بعد اليوم أمام رقم مجهول.
• كاشف الأرقام المزعجة 
يضم كاشف الارقام نظام حماية متقدماً يعرض لك تقييم موثوقية كل رقم، ويحذّرك من أرقام الاحتيال، النصب، والتسويق الهاتفي قبل أن تردّ عليها.
• سجل بحث محلي ذكي
يحفظ كاشف الارقام جميع عمليات بحثك السابقة في سجل منظم يمكنك الرجوع إليه في أي وقت.
• تصميم عصري وداكن مريح للعين
يتميز كاشف الارقام بواجهة استخدام احترافية وأنيقة تدعم الوضع الداكن (Dark Mode) المتوافق تماماً مع نظام iOS، لتجربة سلسة ومريحة في كل الأوقات.
• مشاركة مجتمعية فعّالة
كن جزءاً من مجتمع كاشف الارقام وساهم في حماية الآخرين عبر الإبلاغ الفوري عن أي رقم مزعج أو احتيالي بضغطة زر واحدة. كل بلاغ يجعل كاشف الارقام أقوى وأكثر دقة للجميع.
• سرعة وأداء عالٍ
صُمّم كاشف الارقام ليعمل بسرعة فائقة وخفّة في الاستهلاك، فلا يستهلك بطارية هاتفك ولا يبطئ أداءه، مع نتائج تظهر في لحظات.
خصوصيتك أولويتنا القصوى (لا نسحب جهات الاتصال)
على عكس التطبيقات الأخرى، يحترم كاشف الارقام خصوصيتك. لا يطلب كاشف الارقام صلاحية الوصول إلى جهات الاتصال الخاصة بك . يعتمد كاشف الارقام كلياً على الدلائل العامة وبلاغات المجتمع اليدوية، لنقدّم لك خدمة آمنة وموثوقة وشفّافة تماماً.
كاشف الارقام ليس مجرد تطبيق لكشف الأرقام، بل هو درعك الأول ضد الإزعاج والاحتيال الهاتفي. مع كل تحديث، يصبح كاشف الارقام أذكى وأسرع وأكثر دقة، بفضل مجتمع النشط من المستخدمين.
لا تدع الأرقام المجهولة تزعجك بعد اليوم. حمّل كاشف الارقام الآن، وانضم إلى آلاف المستخدمين الذين يثقون به يومياً لحماية هواتفهم ومعرفة هوية كل متصل. كاشف الارقام — راحتك وأمانك في تطبيق واحد.
You can contact us via email: 
support@getkashif.com

bluejetty:00114289:ios.summary: Luvu is the #1 app for controlling screen time and supercharging your productivity, mental health, and day-to-day clarity. This emotional little marshmallow blocks distracting apps, launches focus sessions, negotiates when you try to cheat,
bluejetty:00114289:ios.description:
Luvu is the #1 app for controlling screen time and supercharging your productivity, mental health, and day-to-day clarity. This emotional little marshmallow blocks distracting apps, launches focus sessions, negotiates when you try to cheat, and rewards you for reclaiming your life, one mindful moment at a time.
You’ll spend over 25 years of your life on your phone!
With Luvu, you start getting that time back.
Using a mix of distraction blocking, gamification, social accountability, and emotional coaching, Luvu helps you break doomscroll habits, stay present, and build healthier routines that finally stick.
Thousands of people have already transformed their digital lives and Luvu is ready to help you do the same.
What you get with Luvu:
• Auto-enforced focus sessions – Set a goal, start a session, and Luvu locks down your distracting apps. If you try to leave early, you’ll… have to negotiate with him.
• Distraction blocking – Block social media (TikTok, Instagram, YouTube Shorts, ...), games, messages, or any apps you choose—instantly or on a schedule.
• Personalized habit building – Luvu learns your patterns, strengths, and weak moments, then adjusts difficulty and support to help you reduce screen time day by day.
• Game-like retention – Earn XP for staying focused, unlock emotes, activate “Ultra Focus Mode,” and save your streak with clever streak-savers.
• Emotional accountability – Luvu can be supportive, snarky, disappointed-in-you, or full chaotic gremlin. Whatever keeps you off TikTok.
• Daily rituals and wins – Tiny dopamine hits for staying present, avoiding doomscroll spirals, and building intentional routines.
• Friendly rivalries & milestones – Compare today’s screen time vs your past self (and optionally friends), and earn badges for big victories .
• Customizable experience – Choose Luvu’s vibe, strictness level, negotiation style, and celebration energy.
Whether you’re starting fresh, trying to reclaim your attention, or chasing your best digital self, Luvu makes staying focused weirdly fun.
Why Luvu?
• Built to stick. Smart pacing, adaptive difficulty, and reward momentum help you stay focused more days in a row than you ever have.
• A personality that motivates. Luvu isn’t just a blocker—he’s your needy, dramatic accountability buddy who really wants you to succeed.
• Effortless protection. Once you set your boundaries, Luvu enforces them. You just show up.
• Progress you can feel. Watch your screen time drop, your habits strengthen, and your sense of control return.
Try Luvu Plus
Upgrade to Luvu Plus for premium perks: unlimited streak savers, advanced blocking rules, exclusive coaching voices, deeper customization, and faster progression. Start with a free trial to unlock the full power of your tiny digital bodyguard.
Subscription details:
If you choose to purchase Luvu Plus, payment will be charged to your Apple account, and your account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period. Auto-renewal can be turned off anytime from your account settings. Any unused portion of a free trial, if offered, will be forfeited when you purchase a subscription.
Privacy Policy: luvufit.com/privacy
Terms of Service: luvufit.com/tos

bluejetty:00179968:ios.description:

네이버앱은 콘텐츠 유형에 따라 5개의 공간을 제공합니다.
내가 좋아하는 건 주제별로 ‘홈피드’에서, 짧고 빠르게 즐기는 숏폼은 ‘클립’에서, 뉴스와 각종 읽을 거리는 ‘콘텐츠’에서, 나의 쇼핑 흐름에 맞춰 깎고, 받고, 쌓는 경험은 ‘네이버플러스 스토어’에서, 인증과 결제뿐 아니라 내 활동 내역을 확인할 수 있는 ‘마이’까지. 일상의 편리함을 더해주는 네이버앱, 지금 다운로드하세요!
1. 내 취향 콘텐츠를 주제별로 탐색해 보세요.
검색홈 하단에서 내가 좋아하는 주제를 선택하고 다양한 콘텐츠를 탐색할 수 있어요. 스포츠, 엔터, 패션·뷰티, 건강까지! 관심사에 맞춘 콘텐츠를 끊임없이 추천해 드려요.
2. 짧아서 더 빠져드는 숏폼, 보고 만들고 즐기는 클립
짧은 휴식 시간이나 잠들기 전, 클립을 감상하며 즐거운 시간을 보내보세요. 일상의 소중한 순간들을 쉽고 빠르게 클립으로 만들고, 친구들과 공유할 수 있어요. 또한 ‘내클립판’에서 내가 좋아한 클립을 한곳에 모아볼 수 있어요.
3. 더 깎아주고 더 쌓아주는 네이버플러스 스토어
홈 하단에서 나에게 꼭 맞는 상품과 혜택이 가득한 쇼핑 콘텐츠를 만나보세요. 오늘의 할인 혜택, 다양한 프로모션, 인기 트렌드까지 초개인화 추천으로 탐색과 발견의 즐거움을 더해드립니다.
4. 인증, 결제, 활동 내역까지 마이에서 한눈에
현장에서 지갑 대신 사용할 수 있는 인증·결제 기능부터 결제·예약·주문 내역, 찜한 상품, 저장한 장소까지. 흩어져 있던 내 활동 내역을 마이에서 한눈에 확인할 수 있어요.
5. 검색창에서 AI탭부터 다양한 인식 도구까지 더 편리하게
검색창에 새롭게 추가된 AI탭 버튼으로 궁금한 것을 바로 물어보세요. AI탭에서 이미지로 검색하는 렌즈와 음악검색을 바로 이용할 수 있어요. 검색창에서 음성검색과 내 주변 검색도 더욱 편리하게 이용할 수 있어요.
※ 참고 사항
네이버앱을 쾌적하게 이용하기 위해 iOS 17.0 이상 환경에서의 설치를 권장합니다. 앱 이용 중 문제가 발생한 경우 네이버앱 설정 > 고객센터로 문의해 주세요.
웹사이트에서 음성 인식 기능 이용 시 ‘음성인식’ 권한이 필요할 수 있습니다. 권한 허용 후 기능을 사용하는 경우, Apple 정책에 따라 음성 데이터가 Apple로 전송되며 그 외 정보는 전송되지 않습니다.
A wealth of information optimized for mobile! Experience the NAVER app, refreshed daily.
The NAVER app offers five spaces tailored to different content types. Explore your interests in “Home Feed,” enjoy quick and entertaining short-form videos in “Clip,” discover news and articles in “Content,” experience personalized shopping benefits in “NAVER Plus Store,” and manage authentication, payments, and activity history in “MY.” Download the NAVER app now to make everyday life more convenient!
1. Explore personalized content by topic
Choose your favorite topics at the bottom of the Search Home and discover content tailored to your interests. From sports and entertainment to fashion, beauty, and health, NAVER continuously recommends content you’ll love.
2. Clip: Watch, create, and enjoy short-form content
Take a break and enjoy entertaining clips anytime, anywhere. Easily capture special moments from your daily life, create clips in seconds, and share them with friends. You can also save and revisit your favorite clips in “My Clip Board.”
3. NAVER Plus Store: Save more and earn more
Discover shopping content filled with personalized products and benefits at the bottom of Home. Enjoy a smarter shopping experience with hyper-personalized recommendations featuring today’s deals, promotions, and trending products.
4. Authentication, payments, and activity history — all in MY
Use authentication and payment features conveniently in place of your wallet, and easily check your payment, reservation, and order history, favorite items, and saved places — all in one place with MY.
5. From the AI tab to a variety of recognition tools — all easier from the search bar
Ask whatever you're curious about right away with the new AI tab button in the search bar. Right from the AI tab, you can use Lens to search by image and search for music in an instant. Voice search and Around Me search are now even easier to use from the search bar, too.
* NOTE
 For the best experience, we recommend installing the NAVER app on iOS 17.0 or later. If you experience any issues while using the app, please contact us via NAVER app Settings > Customer Center.
Some speech recognition features on websites may require Speech Recognition permission. When enabled, voice data may be transmitted to Apple in accordance with Apple’s policies, and no other information will be shared.

bluejetty:00169949:ios.description:
Sindibad App
The number one choice of Iraqis for online flight bookings and the easiest application to plan trips in one place. From booking flight tickets and hotels inside and outside Iraq, to buying eSIM, and applying for visas online — all this in simple and fast steps through one app that makes travel easier for everyone.
App Features
Sindibad offers a clear and user-friendly experience. Search flights from all local and international airlines, compare prices, and choose the most suitable option based on schedule, cost, and services.
Flight booking
Book flights easily with Iraqi Airways, Turkish Airlines, Qatar Airways, Emirates, and more. Just select your destination, compare, and book your ticket from anywhere in minutes.
Price calendar
The smart price calendar shows the cheapest travel days so you can pick the best time to fly. The app supports one-way, round-trip, and multi-city bookings.
Hotel booking
Search, compare, and book hotels across cities and countries. See real guest reviews and always-updated prices to find the best hotel for comfort, cost, and location — all within a simple and organized interface.
24/7 support
Get help anytime through the support team. You can also modify or cancel bookings quickly and easily.
Flexible payments
Choose from multiple payment options:
* Cash at the Baghdad office
* “Sindi Cash” (cash pickup service)
* Sindibad Wallet, Zain Cash, Qi Card, First Iraqi Bank (FIB)
* MasterCard, Visa, or Zain Cash transfer
 All designed to make payment secure and convenient.
eSIM
Stay connected wherever you travel. Choose your destination, pick from available packages, and activate your eSIM instantly at affordable prices.
Visa application
Apply for travel visas directly through the app. Select your country, upload documents, and track your application easily — no need to visit offices.
Sindibad brings everything a traveller needs into one reliable app — from search and comparison to booking, with real-time notifications and clear confirmations. Thousands of travellers in Iraq use Sindibad confidently for tourism, Umrah, business, family, and student travel because every detail is simplified.
Covering every stage of your trip from planning to arrival, Sindibad offers a complete travel experience combining speed, comfort, and reliability.
With ongoing updates and improvements, the app continues to evolve to provide faster and smoother usability.
Start your journey today.
Download the Sindibad App and travel with confidence and comfort.

bluejetty:00148901:ios.description:

bluejetty:00153357:ios.description:
The Coach For Her is a personal growth app that helps women build healthier relationships, communicate with confidence, and feel more connected — to themselves and to the people they love.
Through short, structured programs created with relationship coaches and educators, you'll learn practical skills for everyday life: expressing your needs clearly, handling difficult conversations calmly, and building trust and closeness with your partner.
WHAT YOU'LL FIND INSIDE
Reconnect with Yourself
Take time to reflect on your emotions, values, and needs. Guided exercises and journaling prompts help you build self-awareness, self-confidence, and a calmer, more grounded mindset.
Communicate with Confidence
Get simple frameworks and conversation guides that help you say what you feel and need — kindly and clearly. From daily check-ins to bigger conversations, you'll build openness and mutual understanding.
Strengthen Your Relationship
Discover small, practical ideas for spending quality time together, creating shared rituals, and bringing more warmth and appreciation into your everyday routine.
Understand Your Emotional Needs
Reflective prompts and activities help you notice your communication style, what helps you feel supported, and what builds trust in your relationships.
Expert Knowledge, Made Simple
Lessons turn professional relationship insights into clear, bite-sized steps you can apply right away — at your own pace, without pressure.
WHY WOMEN CHOOSE THE COACH FOR HER
A few minutes a day: short lessons that fit into a busy schedule
Learn at your own pace and revisit lessons anytime
Supportive, encouraging tone with no judgment
New programs and content added regularly
The Coach for her is an educational self-development app. It does not provide medical, psychological, or therapeutic treatment.

bluejetty:00062933:ios.description:
Uncover the secrets of the magical East in the new hidden object game! 
Guide noble Prince through the lively and colorful locations of the luxurious palace, the medieval eastern city, the desert, the ancient temple, and many more on his way to his dream! You see, he needs the Magic Lamp that makes his wishes come true for the most noble goals. On your way, you will encounter cunning and friendship, obstacles and riddles, clues and amazing finds. 
Unexpected plot twists are guaranteed! Is it okay to trust a fellow traveler? Is this Jinn cunning? Will a vagrant you meet become a reliable friend? Complete the tasks, solve the riddles, work your way out of the traps, and find all your answers in this exciting game! Get some equipment and supplies, grab the map and go!
The game is TRULY FREE, the whole adventure is open to you without any additional purchases - it's entirely up to you to buy optional tools.
Game features:
- Look for items in 360-degree panoramic scenes
- Unusual 3D effects and colorful animations.
- A variety of tasks: searching for items, spotting the differences, puzzles, restoration of disassembled objects
- All that is accompanied by the colorful atmosphere of the magical East and thrilling background music
- Build your collection of rewards!
We'll be happy to stay in touch with you at www.facebook.com/CrispApp - make comments, ask questions, get news about coming games!

firefox-addons:3134968.name: Evenpath – Accessibility & SEO Fixer
firefox-addons:3134968.summary: Find and fix accessibility and SEO issues on any page, with code fixes for Shopify, WordPress, React and HTML.
firefox-addons:3134968.description:
Find and fix accessibility issues.
Evenpath runs automated accessibility and SEO checks on the page you're on, explains each issue in plain language and shows you how to fix it in your code.
Click the Evenpath icon and press "Scan this page". Open an issue and Evenpath outlines the element on the page, so you see exactly where it is.
WHAT IT CHECKS
• Accessibility against WCAG 2.2 level A and AA, with the matching EN 301 549 clause. Evenpath uses axe-core plus its own checks, such as keyboard focus you can't see.
• On-page SEO: page title, meta description, headings, canonical link, noindex, Open Graph tags and image sizes.
CHECK AGAINST YOUR STANDARD
Choose the standard your work is measured against: EU (EN 301 549), UK public sector, US Section 508 or US ADA Title II. Evenpath maps the same scan to it straight away and lists findings outside that standard separately.
UNDERSTAND WHAT IT MEANS
Every issue is explained in plain language: who it affects and how, and which WCAG rule it relates to. Severity is shown with a shape, a label and a colour.
FIX IT IN THE CODE
For the most common issues, such as missing alt text, buttons and links without a name, form fields without a label, low contrast and a missing page language, Evenpath writes the code fix, with the likely file where it can tell. For every issue you can copy a ready prompt for your AI coding agent. Fixes and prompts are tailored to Shopify (Liquid), WordPress and WooCommerce (PHP), React and Next.js, and plain HTML. You review, you ship.
MORE CHECKS, FREE
• Keyboard walk: the Tab order drawn on the page, with focus you can't see and possible keyboard traps.
• What a screen reader would announce, in reading order.
• Form error check: grouped options, specific error messages and errors linked to their fields. It never submits a form.
• Tools: see the page as people with colour blindness or low vision do, try wider text spacing, pause motion, and check the contrast of any two colours. They change only your own tab, never the live site.
• Export the results to Excel or CSV.
NO OVERLAY WIDGET
Nothing is added to your live site. Evenpath shows the problem and the fix; you or your AI agent apply it in your code.
PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Scans run in your browser and nothing from the page is sent anywhere. Evenpath only reads a page after you click its icon on that tab. Settings and results stay on your device. When you copy a prompt for your AI agent, you decide where it goes.
IN YOUR LANGUAGE
English, Dutch and German: the panel, every issue explanation, reports, exports and accessibility statement drafts. Reports can be in your client's language while you work in yours.
TRY IT
Open evenpath.dev/demo, a demo shop with deliberate issues. Scan it, then switch to the fixed version and scan again.
Evenpath shows issues found by automated checks. They find many issues, but not all: a manual review is still needed. Evenpath can't make a site meet the law, and nothing in it is legal advice.
Paid plans add whole-site scans and crawls, fix plans with time estimates, report templates (including an Accessibility Conformance Report in the VPAT layout) and accessibility statement drafts for the EU, UK and US.

fdroid:org.androidlabs.termuxvault.name: Termux Vault: Secure Command Launcher
fdroid:org.androidlabs.termuxvault.summary: Keep sensitive Termux commands encrypted and run them with one tap after unlock.
fdroid:org.androidlabs.termuxvault.description:
Some shell commands carry secrets: a token in a curl header, a VPN password, an rsync line that points at your server. Shell history, notes apps and home-screen shortcuts all leave those in clear text.
Termux Vault keeps each command encrypted with AES-256-GCM. To run, edit or delete one, you unlock your vault with your passphrase, or with an optional strong (Class 3) biometric. Termux Vault then hands the decrypted command straight to Termux and wipes its own copy from memory.
 What you can do 
• Run a command on demand: tap it, unlock, and it runs in Termux.
• See the result: every run ends with one clear line, all commands succeeded or at least one failed.
• Choose per command: keep a successful session open, get a notification when it finishes, or hide the output.
• Reorder your commands by dragging.
• Add a home-screen widget, or let Tasker ask for a run. Both only ever show an authentication prompt; nothing runs unattended.
• Back up and restore your whole vault as one line of encrypted text.
 How it protects you 
• Per-command AES-256-GCM keys, wrapped by a vault key, which is wrapped by your passphrase through Argon2id.
• The command never travels in an Intent, a process argument, a file, the clipboard or a log. Termux Vault starts Termux with one-time tokens only, both sides prove they hold them, and only then the command is sent through an anonymous pipe.
• The Termux signing certificate is checked before every run.
• Screenshots and overlays are blocked on sensitive screens.
 Please note 
• You need Termux installed in the same Android profile, with allow-external-apps=true in ~/.termux/termux.properties. The app's first-run guide walks you through it.
• Termux Vault asks for the "Run commands in Termux environment" permission and for notifications.
• The INTERNET permission is used only for a one-time listener bound to 127.0.0.1 on your own device. Termux Vault sends nothing over the network.
• A forgotten passphrase cannot be recovered.
• It does not protect against a compromised phone, root access or a Termux build you chose to trust.
Termux Vault is free software (GPL-3.0-only). It is an independent project and is not affiliated with or endorsed by the Termux project.
